jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview

You’ll be a member of the Engineering Reliability Team that will work closely with Zen’s development, engineering, and operations centre teams. You’ll work alongside the Development and engineering teams, to support, maintain, and consistently improve the development estate so the development teams can focus and innovate constantly to drive Zen’s business and the teams’ priorities.

Reporting to the DevOps team manager, you must have a proven track record in a DevOps or similar engineering role and the drive and attitude to succeed. Zen are committed to investing in and developing you – we believe that everyone can lead and the way we do has a huge impact on our people and play a vital part in our success.

The DevOps team will be responsible for the design and implementation of applications' build, release, deployment and configuration activities. Other responsibilities include working within multi\-functional teams to gather requirements, evaluate tools, implementing/updating solutions, building and executing test plans, provision environments, application performance reviews, assist migration of Legacy systems, and triaging and fixing operational issues.

You’ll support incidents so they are run smoothly and help ensure that operational knowledge is available and shared. You’ll escalate to Senior and Lead DevOps engineers where needed, demonstrating problem solving skills, the ability to learn quickly and adapt your skills and knowledge.

As a service provider we operate many technologies, so you’ll have the skills to work with experienced Senior and Lead DevOps engineers, Systems Engineers and developers leveraging frameworks, standards, and defined operational process to make the unfamiliar comfortable and familiar. Over time we’ll increasingly leverage SRE principles to further optimize and enhance capabilities – it’s a great opportunity to get in at the start and help shape this journey.

Objectives

* Deliver continuous incremental improvement of systems and infrastructure
* Take ownership and responsibility for assigned development infrastructure and systems
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, escalating to Senior DevOps Engineers where required and be part of the 24/7 escalation rota
* Document as you go – enough so your colleagues can follow what’s been done and why
* Drive tasks forward with energy and enthusiasm
* Create proactive monitoring solutions using standard tooling \- mainly Zabbix and Elastic
* Support RCA (Root Cause Analysis) for incidents
* Develop standard operational procedures and documentation
* Develop and maintain self\-managing infrastructure services and dashboards.
* Identify cost\-saving opportunities
* Apply DevOps standards and practices
* Provide support to junior and new team members

Key ResponsibilitiesExperience

* Worked as a DevOps Engineer or in a similar engineering role
* Ideally, experience working in an ISP, Telco or other Managed Services environment or able to demonstrate experience in a complex heterogeneous environment
* Adaptable scripting experience – ideally C\#/JavaScript/typescript/.Net
* Comfortable working with automation tools (Azure DevOps, GitLab, Puppet)
* Worked in networking and firewall environments
* Production use of AWS capabilities and Kubernetes
* Experience in helping to deal with technical debt
* Understanding of SRE principles and lean methodologies

Skills \- Essential

* Strong problem\-solving skills are essential – understanding of DevOps and SRE concepts with the ability to apply key techniques to problems
* Developing the ability to influence others in matters of standards and best practice
* Comfortable working with automation tools (Puppet, Git) and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps) and test frameworks
* Experience using containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes etc)
* Working knowledge of Elasticsearch log standardisation, Kibana dashboard creation and data analysis
* Able to code to a good level \- this isn’t a developer role but you need scripting skills to succeed
* AWS hands on – Cloud formation, Route53, S3, DynamoDB, Cloud\-watch, Lambda, Security, and troubleshooting
* Certificate management and automation
* Good troubleshooting and diagnosis skills
* Able to write documentation that covers what your peers and operations need to know
* Knowledge of Database systems and models
* Windows Server, SQL Server, IIS and Linux

Interpersonal Skills

We value interpersonal skills and responsible teamwork. You should be able to:

* Patient \& friendly with good interpersonal skills \- demonstrate a natural aptitude for dealing with people
* Develop your ability to influence and lead
* Strong attention to detail
* Happy working and supporting a small closeknit team
* Take and give feedback to tune future actions and behaviours
* Work with minimum supervision
* Embrace and demonstrate Zen values
* Be kind, understanding, and listen to others
* Be organized

**\*\*This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have the unrestricted right to work in the UK to be considered\*\***

Pay: £48,000\.00\-£56,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Additional leave
* Bereavement leave
* Company pension
* Cycle to work scheme
* Enhanced maternity leave
* Free parking
* Paid volunteer time
* Sick pay
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Civil Engineer (Water / AMP8)
jobs.description:
**What if you could shape a career as unique as you?**At WSP, you can always find opportunities to grow and do what matters to you. Make the most of our global reach to discover new challenges and chances to work with diverse, talented individuals who will help you expand your horizons.
  

**A little more about your role…**Our Regulated Water Asset Design team serves the municipal water sector both in the UK and internationally. We hold long term framework agreements direct with water companies, including Severn Trent Water and Southwest Water. We also hold excellent relationships and trading agreements with blue chip contractors, including Costain and Galliford Try, for whom we deliver projects across the UK. We deliver a full range of design services across wastewater treatment, water treatment, sewerage and water network schemes.


To find out more about our Water business click on the following link and discover what awaits you at https://www.wsp.com/en\-us/sectors/wastewater


Due to a significant increase in the demand for our services, we are actively recruiting experienced Civil Engineers to help us service the AMP8 water industry capital investment programme. If you have relevant water industry design experience, we can offer you tailored experience to fulfil your career ambitions. Equally, if you are working in a different engineering sector, we can also offer mentoring programmes and training to support you in the transition to the water sector.


**Key Responsibilities**

As a Senior Civil Engineer you will have the opportunity to:


* Take ownership for all aspects of project delivery including health \& safety, technical, quality, schedule and budget
* Manage multi\-disciplinary teams
* Shape the delivery of our services and identify opportunities to deliver complimentary services from the wider WSP business in the UK and overseas
* Build relationships with our Clients to ensure that our services deliver project outcomes and customer satisfaction
* Contribute to the identification and delivery of innovative approaches, new services and digital products
* Contribute to the implementation of our Future Ready and Net Zero programme
* Act as an ambassador for best practice within the Asset Design team and on Client sponsored initiatives
* Undertake bid preparation, resource and budget development
* Line manage and support the professional development of graduate engineers and degree apprentices
* Contribute to recruitment and growth of the civil engineering team
Continue your career journey through the ongoing development of your technical, managerial and leadership skills  
* 

**What we will be looking for you to demonstrate…**

* A degree in Civil Engineering
* Chartered status, or significant progression towards membership of the ICE or CIWEM
* Experience in managing engineering design teams comprising civil engineers and other supporting disciplines
* Experience in delivery of projects to an identified budget and schedule
* Acted in a checking or technical approval role on linear civil engineering infrastructure projects, or industrial / process related design
* Experience in mentoring or coaching junior civil engineering staff to develop their technical skills and professional development
* Client\-facing experience
Good presentation, written, and verbal communication skills  
* 

**Don’t quite meet all the criteria? Or not quite the role you were looking for. Apply and we can see how your experience aligns to other roles we may have available.**

**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**  

  

Work on landmark projects around the world and embrace opportunities to make an even bigger impact in the communities you care about. What if you could do the
best work of your life and create a legacy for yourself?
  

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.****\#LI\-ES1**
  
We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long\-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.


**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?**

**Work\-life balance**

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.


Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.


**Inclusivity \& Belonging**

We welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and experiences. We enable rewarding careers by encouraging people to bring their whole and authentic selves to work so that our work represents the fullest spectrum of society. We celebrate integrity and treat people with respect, supporting each other and embracing a culture of inclusion and belonging at WSP. We have our employee resource groups bring together employees and allies with different backgrounds to promote a culture of inclusivity.


**Health \& Wellbeing**

We are committed to supporting our people, giving you the tools to make improvements to your health and wellbeing through our Thrive programme.


Our Virtual GP service gives you access to an NHS or Irish Medical Council GP at a time and place that suits you – giving you peace of mind and quick access to medical advice when you need it most. We also provide reasonable workplace adjustments for those in need. Additionally, you can benefit from the Gymflex scheme, which offers up to 40% off annual gym memberships through our WSP flexible benefits program, as well as a comprehensive menopause support package.


**Flex your time**

To enhance work\-life balance, WSP offers the “WSP My Hour,” allowing you to take one hour each day for personal activities, with the flexibility to make up the time earlier or later that day.


We also provide part\-time and flexible working arrangements, the option to purchase additional leave, and the ability to use your bank holiday entitlement to suit you.


**Your development**

We understand the importance of development and training to you. That’s why we foster a supportive environment that invests in your growth, whether through training, mentoring, or Chartership.


**\#WeAreWSP**

*Here at WSP we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy or maternity/paternity. As a Disability Confident leader, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria, please let us know if you require any workplace adjustments in support of your application.*

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Salary****: £45,000 to £55,000 per year, dependant on experience**  

**Location: Durham, Northallerton, Otley or Penrith, with hybrid working**  

**Contract: Permanent, Full\-Time, Monday to Friday**


Benefits: 25 days’ holiday, plus bank holidays, company pension and other benefits.


Are you an Electrical Building Services Engineer looking to take the next step in your career at Senior Level?


Due to our continued steady expansion, we now have the opportunity for a Senior Electrical Building Services Engineer to bring their experience, professionalism, and enthusiasm to the Building Services team at Align Property Services.


**What Our Team Has Been Working On**


Our Building Services team has recently delivered a series of rapid‑response mechanical and electrical projects for Durham County Council, supporting their drive toward net‑zero carbon and improved building performance. Working across a diverse estate of schools, leisure facilities, libraries, and community buildings, we’ve managed everything from early‑stage feasibility studies to major electrical and mechanical upgrades.


Through the NEPO Mechanical and Electrical Framework, the team successfully delivered ten projects, including schemes at Consett Branch Library, Coxhoe Active Life, Copeland Road Primary School, Shotton Primary Swimming Pool, Delves Lane Primary, Villa Real School, and Rookhope Primary. These projects involved integrating renewable and energy‑efficient technologies such as solar PV, air source heat pumps, low‑energy lighting, fire alarm upgrades, and modernised heating and electrical systems which were all completed with minimal disruption to essential services.


Every commission was delivered on time and to a high standard, improving building usability, reducing energy consumption, and directly supporting the council’s sustainability objectives. If you’re excited by the opportunity to shape sustainable, impactful building services projects like these, we’d love to hear from you!


**What You’ll be Doing**


You will be responsible for providing a variety of services including those relating to building pathology, design, project management, building surveys and contract administration as well as producing early design advice through to detailed electrical services design. You'll have the opportunity to support and mentor our junior members of the team as they develop their skills and knowledge and look to you for your guidance.


As part of working on large projects, your day\-to\-day work will include:


* Electrical condition surveys
* Electrical design from concept to detail
* Project management and contract administration
* Providing early\-stage design advice and technical consultancy
* Managing complex workloads and promote collaboration across disciplines
* Deliver smart, cost\-effective solutions that meet client expectations.
* Offering advice on Health \& Safety, fire safety, and sustainability throughout the design and construction phases, ensuring compliance with CDM regulations and best practice standards.

**What we are looking for:**


* A degree or HNC in Building Services/Electrical Engineering
* Substantial experience in a senior engineering role
* A commitment to professional development, ideally working towards MCIBSE
* Confidence in conducting in electrical surveys, defect analysis, and feasibility reporting
* High\-quality electrical designs and documentation across RIBA stages
* A supportive leader to mentor colleagues while working collaboratively across disciplines
* Oversee site installations and ensure compliance with NEC/JCT contracts
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, NBS, and Microsoft Office
* A strong understanding of CDM regulations, fire safety, and sustainability principles
* A full UK driving licence and a willingness to travel across the area

For further information, please read the Job description


“Align your career success with delivering our ambitious growth plans”


When you join Align, you will join a team of professionals who feel rewarded for the work they do. Operating in a friendly and professional environment, we want to provide the training and resources to succeed and thrive in your role. Our people are not just numbers, everyone is crucial to the vital services we provide, and we treat everyone in our teams with respect and complete support.


**In return for your commitment, we offer:**


* A Competitive salary up to £55,000 per year, dependent on your skills and experience
* Enrolment on to a company pension scheme which we will contribute up to 6%
* 25 days holiday plus bank holidays with opportunity to purchase up to 10 additional annual leave days per leave year.
* Hybrid working to support you in a healthy work\-life balance.
* Professional development through varying project work

A benefits scheme which includes a good maternity leave package, cycle2work scheme and our online voucher portal giving access to discounts from leading retailers to help you* on shopping, days out, or nights in.
* Stability in your role \- public sector security in a private sector industry

**How to Apply**


To apply, please complete the short application form and attach your CV. If you have any questions please contact our Recruitment and Talent Partner Devon Lowe on devon.lowe@northyorks.gov.uk or 07720869014\.


The deadline for applications is Midnight on **Sunday 25th October 2026\.**


*Interviews are planned to take place throughout the recruitment process, if you would like to apply, please do so now and we will respond to you quickly. We reserve the right to remove this vacancy in the event of the position being filled before the proposed deadline.*


  
Senior Electrical Engineer

Posted: 29/09/2026
Closing date: 25/10/2026
Closing time: 23:59 (GMT)

* Delivered front end cross\-browser functional testing, device testing, exploratory, systems integration and user acceptance testing e.g. manual testing.

* Worked in an agile environment.

* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
* Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat

And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

* Things you need to know
* Apply and further information
**Location**
------------


Bristol, Cardiff, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Leeds, Manchester, Telford, Worthing
**About the job**
-----------------


### **Job summary**


Discover a career in your hands at HMRC. Whether you're seeking purpose, growth, or a workplace that gives you a true sense of belonging, hear from some of our employees as they share their story about what its really like to work at HMRC.

  

Visit our YouTube channel to watch the full series and come and discover your potential.


HMRC is made up of Customer Groups which are working independently towards one common goal. Our role sits within HMRCs Chief Digital \& Information Office (CDIO) Group that deliver in\-house solutions for a broad range of technical and operational issues. Our digital delivery centres are hi\-tech, state\-of\-the\-art facilities that allow our teams to maximise their capabilities.
  

  

CDIO values and empowers the growth of its people and offers the CDIO University. This is a one stop shop for all things learning and development. The comprehensive offer encompassing academic, personal and career related opportunity and learning, ensuring all receive a consistent approach to technical learning. This includes access to subject matter experts, technical learning, professional communities, academies, apprenticeships, talent schemes as well as providing, delivering, encouraging and supporting activities for personal growth and wellbeing.


### **Job description**


As a member of the Quality Assurance and Testing (QAT) Profession, you will be part of a large community of testing professionals working collaboratively with Product Owners, Developers, Architects, Business Analysts and Operations teams to deliver high\-quality, resilient and scalable digital services for HMRC customers.
  

  

We have an inclusive environment and have clear pathways in place to support and build on the roles within the Profession through the use of learning journeys, learning platforms, career journeys and skills assessments. These all work together to allow you to take ownership of your own development and career progression with HMRC as well as supporting you in your daily challenges. Along with this we also have an Academy in place to allow you to find everything to support your needs in an easily accessible format.
  

  

As a Senior Test Engineer within CDIO, Borders \& Trade, You will be responsible for building and enhancing Performance and Non\-Functional Testing capability across cloud\-based applications, platforms and infrastructure. You will primarily lead the delivery of Performance and Volume Testing (PVT), whilst contributing to Operational Acceptance Testing (OAT), Infrastructure Assurance, Resilience and Operational Readiness activities, ensuring solutions are reliable, scalable and fit for live service operation.
  

  

A Senior Test engineer has similar responsibilities to a test engineer but at a more complex level and on a greater scale. At this role level, you will:  

  

  



Lead the planning, design, execution and reporting of Performance \& Volume Testing (PVT), including workload modelling, capacity planning and performance analysis, whilst supporting OAT, infrastructure, resilience and operational readiness testing activities where required.  

* 
Define non\-functional requirements, workload models, acceptance criteria, test strategies and environment validation approaches to identify and mitigate risks early in the delivery lifecycle.  
* 
Analyse test results, infrastructure behaviour and operational metrics to identify bottlenecks, defects, root causes and service risks, providing evidence\-based recommendations for improvement.  
* 
Develop and maintain automated performance testing and validation solutions using tools, scripting languages and CI/CD pipelines to support shift\-left quality engineering practices.  
* 
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring and knowledge sharing across the QAT Profession, supporting continuous improvement of PVT, OAT and infrastructure testing capability within Borders \& Trade.
### **Person specification**


As a Senior Test Engineer within CDIO Borders and Trade, you will primarily lead and deliver Performance and Volume Testing activities across applications, platforms and cloud infrastructure, whilst providing support and assurance for Operational Acceptance Testing (OAT), Infrastructure and Operational Readiness activities.  

  

  



* Develop and maintain Performance and Volume Test artefacts, including strategies, workload models, plans, scenarios, test data requirements, evidence packs and reports, whilst supporting OAT and Infrastructure testing artefacts where required.
Review requirements, architecture designs, infrastructure specifications and operational designs to define appropriate non\-functional test coverage and acceptance criteria.  
* 
Provide estimates, plans, risk assessments and technical advice for projects requiring PVT, OAT, infrastructure assurance or platform validation services.  
* 
Deliver and support performance, volume, resilience, failover, disaster recovery, infrastructure and operational readiness testing across complex enterprise environments.  
* 
Investigate defects, incidents and live\-service issues through root cause analysis, working with engineering, operations and supplier teams to support resolution.  
* 
* Promote automation, quality engineering, knowledge sharing and mentoring to grow the Non\-Functional Testing capability.

**Essential Criteria**


The successful candidate will need to demonstrate practical knowledge and experience in the following:  

  

  



Proven experience leading and delivering Performance and Volume Testing across complex enterprise environments, with awareness and practical exposure to Operational Acceptance Testing (OAT), Infrastructure, Resilience, Availability and Disaster Recovery testing.  

* 
Experience defining non\-functional test strategies, scope, objectives, workload models, acceptance criteria, test plans and test data requirements, ensuring solutions meet performance, scalability, resilience, availability and operational support requirements.  
* 
Experience planning, executing, analysing and reporting Performance and Volume Testing activities, including load, stress, endurance, scalability, resilience, failover and recovery testing, with the ability to identify bottlenecks, root causes and service risks.  
* 
Experience developing and implementing automated testing and validation solutions using tools such as JMeter, Jenkins and GitLab, supported by scripting or programming languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, Java or C\#, and integrated into CI/CD pipelines.  
* 
Experience using and validating observability and monitoring platforms such as AppDynamics, ELK, Grafana, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Kafka or equivalent tools, alongside operating system, infrastructure and database monitoring capabilities.  
* 
Knowledge of Operational Acceptance Testing (OAT), including operational readiness, monitoring, alerting, logging, support procedures, operational runbooks, failover, backup and recovery, and live service support.  
* 
Knowledge of cloud and infrastructure technologies, including AWS/Azure, Linux/RHEL, networking, DNS, load balancing, IAM, security controls, distributed architectures and containerised platforms.  
* 
* Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical findings and risks effectively, influence delivery decisions, and support Agile, DevOps and continuous improvement practices.

**Desirable Criteria**


Ideally, the successful candidate will also demonstrate knowledge and experience in the following:


ISTQB Foundation (or equivalent) and/or relevant Performance Testing, Cloud, Infrastructure, DevOps or Automation certifications.  

* 
Experience testing cloud\-native and containerised solutions using technologies such as AWS, Azure and Kubernetes.  
* 
Experience implementing shift\-left quality engineering practices, including automated non\-functional testing within CI/CD pipelines.  
* 
Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), configuration management and modern DevOps practices.  
* 
* Experience supporting resilience, failover, high availability and disaster recovery testing activities across cloud and enterprise platforms.

**Further Location Information**


Please ensure that you only apply for a location that you are willing and able to work from, as we will only make one offer of employment. Any additional notes included in a Further Location Preferences (optional) field within the application form, will not be considered. Please be aware that you cannot change your location preference after submitting your application.


**Office Closures**


If your location preference is for the following site, its important to note that this is not long\-term site for HMRC and we will require you to move to a new building in the future, subject to our location strategy and the applicable employee policies at that time.


For more information on where you might be working, review this information on our locations


This site is:


* Telford Plaza, Telford \- moving to Parkside Court, Telford

**Leeds Location**


Moves Adjustment Payment will be available for this role, provided the successful applicant is a current HMRC colleague in Bradford and meets the eligibility requirements outlined in the HMRCs Moves Adjustment Payment guidance.


**Benefits**
------------


Alongside your salary of £45,544, HM Revenue and Customs contributes £13,194 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides .

We offer a generous leave allowance, starting at 25 days and increasing by a day for every year of qualifying service up to a maximum of 30 days.


* Pension \- We make contributions to our colleagues Alpha pension equal to at least 28\.97% of their salary.
* Family friendly policies.
* Personal support.
* Coaching and development.

To find out more about HMRC benefits and find out what its really like to work for HMRChear from our insiders or visit Thinking of joining the Civil Service


**Things you need to know**
---------------------------


### **Artificial intelligence**


Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. ### **Selection process details**


**How to Apply**


As part of the application process, you will be asked to provide the following:


A name\-blind CV including your job history and relevant experience. Please provide a brief overview of your responsibilities, contributions, and any key achievements in each role. As a guide, we would expect this section to be around 500 words in total.  

* 
A 750\-word Personal Statement. Your Personal Statement should clearly demonstrate how your skills and experiences meet the essential criteria.  
* 

Please evidence any Desirable Criteria where applicable (up to 250 words max). This is not essential for the role but may be considered by the vacancy holder where candidates have the same score at interview.


Further details around what this will entail are listed on the application form.


**Sift**


In the event of a large number of applications being received, an initial sift may be held on your CV.


At full sift your CV and Personal Statement will be assessed, with the successful candidates being invited to interview.


We may also raise the score required at any stage of the process if we receive a high number of applications.


**Interview**


During the panel interview, your experience will be assessed, to determine your suitability for the role.


Interviews will take place via video link. Sift and interview dates to be confirmed.


Please note that circumstances may arise that require the planned interview format to change. We will endeavour to provide you with as much notice of any change as possible.


**Eligibility**


Please take extra care to tick the correct boxes in the eligibility sections of your application form. Mistakes sometimes happen but if you contact us later than two working days (Monday\-Friday) before the vacancy closes, we may not be able to reopen your application for you. If you do make a mistake with your eligibility form, or have withdrawn yourself in error and need your application reinstated whilst the campaign is still live, please contact us via: unitybusinessservicesrecruitmentresults@hmrc.gov.uk  Use the subject line to insert appropriate wording for example  Please re\-open my application  **\[insert vacancy ref]** \& vacancy closing date **\[insert date].**


To check that you are eligible to apply for this role, please review the eligibility information before submitting your application.


Exceptionally, candidates who are not successful at this grade may be considered for appointment to similar roles at a lower grade where the eligibility criteria are met. If this applies, we will contact you directly.


**Sponsorship**

We have assessed this role against both Home Office and HMRC criteria and we are unable to offer sponsorship for a Skilled Worker Visa. This means the vacancy is not open to applicants who require visa sponsorship.


**The HMRC app can help you with your application**


The HMRC app can provide you with your past 5 years' employment history, making the process of filling in your application quicker and easier.


If successful in your application, you will need your National Insurance number for the onboarding process.


Download the HMRC app now and save your National Insurance number to your digital phone wallet.
  

  

**How to download the HMRC app and sign up for an account**

Download the free HMRC app from the App Store or Google Play store.


If you have an HMRC online account already, sign straight in using your ID and password. If not, you can prove your identity by answering some questions or providing your photo ID.


Youll then be able to access the app quickly and easily by signing in using a 6\-digit PIN, your fingerprint, or facial recognition.


You can find guidance for technical issues on GOV.UK: Technical support with HMRC online services.


**Reserve List**


A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles  if this applies to you, well let you know via your Civil Service Jobs account.


**Merit List**


After interview, a single merit list will be created, and you will only be considered for posts in locations you have expressed a preference for. Appointments will be made in strict merit order in line with the set number of roles in each location.


**Criminal Record Check**


Applications received from candidates with a criminal record are considered fairly in accordance with the DBS Code of Practice and the Recruitment of ex\-offenders Policy.


**Hybrid working at HMRC**


HMRC is an office\-based organisation, and colleagues are expected to spend 60% of their working time in the office. Our offices provide opportunity for interaction, collaboration which aids learning and development and a sense of community. Where the role allows it, and where the home environment is suitable, colleagues can work from home for up to 2 days a week, averaged over a calendar month (or a proportionate amount of time for colleagues who work less than full time).


**Reasonable Adjustments**


We want to make sure no one is put at a disadvantage during our recruitment process. To assist you with this, we will reduce or remove any barriers where possible and provide additional support where appropriate.


If you need a change to be made so that you can make your application, you should:


Contact the UBS Recruitment team via unitybusinessservicesrecruitmentresults@hmrc.gov.uk as soon as possible before the closing date to discuss your needs.


Complete the Assistance required section in the Additional requirements page of your application form to tell us what changes or help you might need further on in the recruitment process. For instance, you may need wheelchair access at interview, or if youre deaf, a Language Service Professional.


**Technical Support**


If you are experiencing problems that cannot be resolved by our help section, then technical support is available. You will receive a reply in 2 working days.


**Additional Security Information**


Please note in addition to the standard pre\-employment checks for appointment into the Civil Service, all candidates must also obtain National Security Vetting at Security Check (SC) clearance level for this vacancy. You will normally need to meet the minimum UK residency period as determined by the level of vetting being undertaken, which for SC is 5 years UK residency prior to your vetting application. If you have any questions about this residency requirement, please speak to the vacancy holder for this post.


From 1 April 2026, applicants will be required to meet updated nationality and residency requirements so that National Security Vetting (NSV) checks can be conducted. If this affects you, we will give you more information at the appropriate time.


**Important information for existing HMRC contractual homeworkers**


This role may be suitable for existing HMRC employees who are contractual homeworkers. Occasional attendance to the office will be required where there is a business need. Please consider the advertised office locations for this role when applying and only select locations from the location preferences section that you can travel to.


**Terms and Conditions**

Customer facing roles in HMRC require the ability to converse at ease with members of the public and provide advice in accurate spoken English and/or Welsh where required. Where this is an essential requirement, this will be tested as part of the selection process.


HMRC has a presence in every region of the UK. For more information on where you might be working, review this information on our locations .


The Civil Service values honesty and integrity and expects all candidates to abide by these principles. The evidence you provide in your application must relate to your own experiences.


Any instances of plagiarism or other forms of cheating will be investigated and, if proven, the relevant application(s) will be withdrawn from the process.


Recording of interviews is prohibited unless explicit agreement is sought in line with the UK General Data Protection Regulations.


Questions relating to an individual application must be emailed as detailed later in this advert.


Applicants who are successful at interview will be, as part of pre\-employment screening, subject to a check on the Internal Fraud Database (IFD). This check will provide information about employees who have been dismissed for fraud or dishonesty offences. This check also applies to employees who resign or otherwise leave before being dismissed for fraud or dishonesty had their employment continued. Any applicants details held on the IFD will be refused employment.


A candidate is not eligible to apply for a role within the Civil Service if the application is made within a 5 year period following a dismissal for carrying out internal fraud against government.


New entrants will join on the minimum of the pay band.


Please note that, if you are applying for roles on a part\-time basis, the salary agreed will be pro\-rata, reflective of the working hours agreed within your contract.


If you experience accessibility problems with any attachments on this advert, please contact the email address in the 'Contact point for applicants' section.


For more Information for people applying for, or thinking of applying for, roles at HM Revenue and Customs, please see link: Working for HMRC: information for applicants \- GOV.UK.

  

  

  

Feedback will only be provided if you attend an interview or assessment.
### **Security**


Successful candidates must undergo a standard (or equivalent) criminal record check.

See our vetting charter .

Further information on nationality requirements

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

jobs.description:

482414

£42,410 \- £47,916

**Location**
------------


Leeds
**About the job**
-----------------


### **Job summary**


We are currently looking for a **Senior Developer (SQ Web)** to join our **Technology and Service Operations** Function within the **Digital and Technology Group**.


This is a **full\-time** opportunity, on a **permanent** basis. The role will be based in 7/8 Wellington Place, Leeds, LS1 4AP.


Government departments and agencies are working towards implementing a minimum 60% attendance in office sites.

  

We are currently implementing a flexible, hybrid way of working, with a minimum of 8 days per month working on site to enable the collaboration and contact with partners and stakeholders needed to deliver MHRA business. Attendance on site is driven by business needs so depending on the nature of the role, this can flex up to 12 days a month, with the remainder of time worked either remotely or in the office. Some roles will need to be on site more regularly. Remote working is potentially available for some specific roles. Please discuss this with the recruiting manager before accepting an appointment.

  

### **Job description**


**Who are we?**


The Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency enhance and improve the health of millions of people every day through the effective regulation of medicines and medical devices, underpinned by science and research.


The MHRA Digital and Technology Group (DTG) exists to help protect and improve public health by enabling the Agency to become a modern, intelligence\-led regulator.


We bring together digital, data, technology, cyber security and artificial intelligence expertise to deliver services, platforms and insights that support the regulation of medicines, medical devices and healthcare technologies across the UK.


Our work goes beyond traditional IT. We design and deliver user\-centred services, harness trusted data, apply advanced analytics and responsible AI, and build secure, resilient digital foundations that help the MHRA make better decisions, work more effectively and respond to a rapidly evolving healthcare landscape.


By joining DTG, you'll help shape the future of regulation while delivering technology that makes a real difference to public health.


The Technology \& Service Operations (TSO) function is responsible for managing the existing IT infrastructure including both software and hardware, databases, and other technology platforms; leading the support and maintenance of applications; development and testing of new applications and platforms; and cyber and information security for the Agency.


The Engineering team, made up of software developers, DevOps engineers, Quality Assurance testers, and data professionals (including engineers, scientists, and visualization experts), is tasked with the creation of applications and services, ensuring quality for both new and existing agency offerings, and developing data visualizations through their expertise in data engineering and science.


### **Person specification**


**Role Purpose**


This Senior Developer role implements web applications and guides the ways in which the team works and provide technical leadership, to deliver cloud native web\-based solutions to our end users. The post holder will be proficient in a wide range of technical systems and be involved in identifying appropriate technology and approaches, deciding when software should be written and will contribute to the developer community and promote knowledge sharing and adoption of good practice.


The post holder will work in cross\-functional product squads on the design and development of creating cloud native (Azure), JavaScript based microservices (node.js) and front end (react) utilising agile (SAFe), paired programming, TDD and DevOps.

  

**Key responsibilities and results areas**


* As an experienced voice in the technical team, you will steer implementation and code design decisions for contingent labour and service providers
* Mentoring more junior members of your team to develop and maintain high\-performance, scalable solutions
* Assist in leading the design and development of site/software projects following best practices, as well as regular status reporting
* Assist in leading in optimising, debugging, and enhancing existing software whilst preventing regression in live systems
* You must have solid JavaScript coding skills, experience of TDD/BDD (jest, enzyme, cucumber, gherkin), be collaborative (Jira, Confluence, GitHub)
* You will establish good engineering practices and have strong ability with Open Source, Cloud First, Microservices and DevOps principles and its associated technology like React, Next.js, Node.js, Rust, Azure services (AKS, CosmosDB, Blob Storage, Functions), Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
* Contribute to a collaborative, dynamic planning process \- prioritising the work that needs to be done against the capacity and capability of the team ensuring the smooth and successful development of sites/software.
  

  

### **Behaviours**


We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:


* Developing Self and Others
* Making Effective Decisions
* Seeing the Big Picture
* Communicating and Influencing

We only ask for evidence of these behaviours on your application form:


* Making Effective Decisions
* Seeing the Big Picture
### **Technical skills**


We'll assess you against these technical skills during the selection process:


* You will hold a Computer Science or similar engineering degree, ideally hold a post\-graduate qualification, or equivalent industry experience.
* You will ideally hold certifications with a major cloud provider (preferably in Azure) and as a microservice based full stack JavaScript developer.
* You will have previous experience as a developer working in a DDaT environment working on workstreams specific to the regulation of medicines/devices data and its subsequent caseworking.
* Substantial experience with certain tools and associated engineering processes.
**Benefits**
------------


Alongside your salary of £42,410, Medicines and Healthcare Products Regulatory Agency contributes £12,286 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides .
* Annual Leave: 25 days annual leave on entry, rising by one day for each completed year of service to a maximum of 30 days and pro\-rata for part\-time staff. PLUS 8 bank holidays
* Privilege Leave: 1 day
* Hours of Work: 37 hours (net) per week for full time staff in all geographical locations, including London and pro rata for part\-time staff
* Occupational Sick Pay (OSP): One month full pay/one month half pay on entry, rising by one month for each completed year of service to a maximum of six months full pay and six months half pay after five years service.
* Mobility: Mobility clause in contracts allowing staff to be mobile across the Civil Service
* Civil Service Pension Scheme. Please see the link for further information http://www.civilservicepensionscheme.org.uk/ For enquiries relating to the Civil Service Pension Schemes please contact MyCSP's Pension Service Centre directly on 0300 123 6666
* Flexible working to ensure staff maintain a healthy work\-life balance
* Interest free season ticket loan or bike loan
* Employee Assistance Services and access to the Civil Service Benevolent Fund
* Eligibility to join Motoring , Boundless by CSMA
* Variety of staff and Civil Service clubs
* On\-going learning and development
  

  

**Things you need to know**
---------------------------


### **Artificial intelligence**


Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.
### **Selection process details**


This vacancy is using Success Profiles , and will assess your Behaviours, Strengths, Experience and Technical skills.
**Key dates** (dates are indicative only and could be subject to change)


* Closing date  11 October 2026 at 23:55
* Sifting  from 16 October 2026
* Main panel interviews  from 26 October 2026

Communications will be electronic via email therefore it is important that you check your Civil Service Jobs account regularly, as well as your spam/junk email folder.


Were committed to being diverse and inclusive, so please make your application anonymous by removing all identifying personal information (such as names and dates) from your employment history and personal statement.


**What will the process look like?**


**1\. Sift Stage**


The main sift, where we'll read and score the rest of your application. This may involve a large number of applications, please bear with us as this can take some time.


* **Anonymised CV** which sets out your career history, previous experience and skills, highlighting specific responsibilities that are relevant for this role.
* **Personal statement:** Write a 500 word personal statement where you demonstrate how you meet the technical skills required for this role, providing examples to evidence your level of skill. In your personal statement we are looking for evidence of how you meet the role criteria and person specification. Your personal statement should aim to make use of the full wordcount and show how you meet the above criteria. Please give clear and specific examples of what you have done personally and the impact it has had.
* **Online application form**, including questions based on the Behaviour, Experience and Technical Success Profiles. Please ensure all application questions are completed in full; your application may not be considered if any responses are left blank.

The panel will look at your application and are looking for evidence of the stated points. We may raise the benchmark score required if we receive a high number of applications.


**2\. Main Panel Interview**


Successful candidates from the sift stage will be invited to attend an interview. We use a blended interview technique, allowing us to find out more about you. We use the Success Profile framework and at interview we will be assessing Behaviours and Experience.


Your interview will include:


* Presentation, to be prepared as part of your interview, with further information being supplied when you reach this stage.

At interview, we will be asking questions relating to the following:


* Behaviours, as listed in the person specification
* Experience, as listed in the person specification
* Strengths, as listed in the person specification

Feedback will only be provided if you attend an interview.


If you require any disability related adjustments at any point during the process, please contact careers@mhra.gov.uk as soon as possible.


Candidates will be subject to UK immigration requirements as well as Civil Service nationality rules. Further information on whether you are able to apply is available here.

* Laboratory\-based roles working directly with known pathogens
* Maintenance roles, particularly those required to work in laboratory settings
* Roles that involve visiting other establishments where vaccination is required

Applicants who are successful at interview will be, as part of pre\-employment screening subject to a check on the Internal Fraud Database (IFD). This check will provide information about employees who have been dismissed for fraud or dishonesty offences. This check also applies to employees who resign or otherwise leave before being dismissed for fraud or dishonesty had their employment continued. Any applicants details held on the IFD will be refused employment. A candidate is not eligible to apply for a role within the Civil Service if the application is made within a 5\-year period following a dismissal for carrying out internal fraud against government.


Any move to the MHRA from another employer will mean you can no longer access childcare vouchers. This includes moves between government departments. You may however be eligible for other government schemes, including Tax\-Free Childcare. Determine your eligibility here.


Individuals appointed on level transfer will retain their existing salary and are responsible for ensuring they fully understand the financial implications of any potential move and the impact (if any) on their terms. If an individual is in any doubt, they should seek clarification before accepting a job offer.


Staff joining on promotion will receive up to a 10% increase of their current basic salary, or the pay band minimum, whichever is the greater.


The individual will not retain any allowances paid by the former department/Agency, unless there are special circumstances, such as a reserved right to those allowances on transfer.


Successful candidates may be subject to annual Occupational Health reviews dependent on role requirements. If you have any queries, please contact careers@mhra.gov.uk.

  

  

  

  

Feedback will only be provided if you attend an interview or assessment.
### **Security**

People working with government assets must complete baseline personnel security standard (opens in new window) checks.
### **Nationality requirements**


This job is broadly open to the following groups:


* UK nationals
* nationals of the Republic of Ireland
* nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
* nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre\-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
* nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre\-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
* individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020

### **Working for the Civil Service**

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles .
The Civil Service embraces diversity and promotes equal opportunities. As such, we run a Disability Confident Scheme (DCS) for candidates with disabilities who meet the minimum selection criteria.
The Civil Service also offers a Redeployment Interview Scheme to civil servants who are at risk of redundancy, and who meet the minimum requirements for the advertised vacancy.

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy .
**Apply and further information**
---------------------------------

In accordance with the Civil Service Commissioners Recruitment Principles our recruitment and selection processes are underpinned by the requirement of selection for appointment on the basis of merit by a fair and open competition. PHP Developer (12\-Month Fixed Term Contract)




**Location:** Hybrid  

**Salary:** Up to £60,000 per annum  

**Contract:** 12\-Month Fixed Term Contract




Join Focus Group and Help Build the Future of Our Internal Platforms


At Focus Group, we're looking for a talented and passionate **PHP Developer** to join our Technology team on a 12\-month fixed\-term contract. This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in developing and enhancing a portfolio of business\-critical applications that support our continued growth and innovation.




Working alongside a collaborative team of developers, QA specialists, and technology professionals, you'll be responsible for building new functionality, improving existing systems, and helping deliver high\-quality software solutions that make a real impact across the business.




What You'll Be Doing


* Developing new features, enhancements, and bug fixes across our bespoke CMS and CRM platforms.
* Writing robust, maintainable code and comprehensive unit tests.
* Collaborating with QA teams to ensure solutions meet acceptance criteria and quality standards.
* Supporting development\-related issues through a rotating support desk function.
* Participating in Agile ceremonies including daily stand\-ups, planning sessions, and team meetings.
* Contributing to a variety of technology projects across the business.
* Working closely with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.




What We're Looking For


Essential Skills \& Experience


* Proven experience in a PHP Developer or similar software development role.
* Strong experience with **Laravel**.
* Solid understanding of **JavaScript**, **jQuery**, and **Vue.js**.
* Experience working with **SQL databases**, ideally MariaDB or MySQL.
* Strong HTML5, CSS, and Bootstrap skills.
* Experience developing and consuming APIs, with knowledge of tools such as Postman.
* Good understanding of unit testing and software quality practices.
* Experience using Git and version control workflows.
* Strong knowledge of the software development lifecycle.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively within a team.
* Customer\-focused mindset with a passion for delivering quality solutions.




Desirable Skills


* Experience within Telecoms, MSP, ICT, or similar industries.
* Exposure to CRM and CMS platforms.
* Knowledge of cloud\-based development environments.
* Understanding of secure development principles and best practices.
* Experience with .NET technologies.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments.
* Awareness of AI technologies and integrations, including Microsoft Copilot, LLMs, and AI\-driven automation solutions.




Why Join Focus Group?


At Focus Group, technology is at the heart of what we do. You'll join a supportive, ambitious team where your ideas are valued, your development is encouraged, and your work has a genuine impact on the business. This role offers the opportunity to work on meaningful projects, utilise modern technologies, and be part of an organisation that is continually evolving.

jobs.title: Automation Test Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly\-skilled test automation engineer to design automation tests. Test automation engineers' duties include designing automation scripts and finding solutions for automation problems. You should also be committed to developing skills in order to provide up\-to\-date solutions.

To be successful as a test automation engineer, you should be exceptionally accurate and possess a superior mathematical aptitude. Ultimately, a top\-notch test automation engineer will be proficient in programming languages and have excellent time management skills.

**Test Automation Engineer Responsibilities:**

* Designing and developing test automation scripts.
* Using test automation guidelines.
* Researching issues in software through testing.
* Collaborating with QA Analysts and Software Developers to develop solutions.
* Keeping updated with the latest industry developments.

**Test Automation Engineer Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, software development, or a related field.
* Previous experience as a test automation engineer.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as C\# and Java.

jobs.title: Software Engineering (Graduate & Internship Opportunites)
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**


Alloyed is a young venture\-funded company of about 300 world\-class metallurgists, engineers, and software developers working across the UK, Japan and the US to build the future of advanced metal components and systems. To do this, Alloyed uses proprietary software packages which combine advanced machine learning and physical modelling to invent better alloys, devise better ways to process them, and design better 3D\-printed components and assemblies.


Alloyed is composed of a range of divisions, enabling metal technology from composition to systems:

* **Core Technology:** Alloyed's internal research and technology hub, focused on creating the new alloys, manufacturing methods, digital tools and intellectual property that will power the company's future products and capabilities.
* **Innovation Services:** Work directly with customers to develop, optimise and qualify materials and manufacturing processes for demanding aerospace, defence, energy and industrial applications.
* **Component Engineering:** Design, manufacture and validate production\-ready components, turning material and process innovations into high\-performance hardware for customer applications.
* **Argive:** Develop and manufacture complete microturbine engine systems under ambitious timelines and customer expectations, enabled by Alloyed’s software stack, proprietary Alloys and AM processing capabilities.


Whether you're a recent graduate or a current university student, we offer exciting opportunities to gain real\-world engineering experience at Alloyed.

* **Graduate Engineers**: Full\-time positions for graduates ready to launch their careers on or before September 2027\.
* **Summer Internships**: 8\-week placements for students looking to apply their learning in an industry environment starting in July 2027\.

**Role Overview**


We're looking for bright, curious candidates to join Alloyed's Software Engineering team. We like solving difficult problems and building software properly before rounding off the day with a little table tennis.


You'll work on production software at the intersection of cloud technology, data and advanced manufacturing. Our platforms support engineers throughout the product lifecycle, from design and process development to manufacturing, inspection and qualification.


No two weeks are the same. You might create a new web application, build a .NET service, work with SQL databases or design an API. You'll gain hands\-on experience with modern software development practices, including automated testing, code review, containerised applications, CI/CD and cloud deployment.


You'll work closely with software engineers, materials scientists and process engineers to build real products from week one. That could mean understanding a user problem, designing and building a new feature, testing it with engineers, or supporting its release into production.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, deploy and maintain Alloyed’s software platforms for: Data management / Traceability / Visualisation and analysis / Process optimisation
* Work within a fast\-paced, agile development team alongside software engineers, process engineers, technicians and materials scientists.
* Participate in the full software development lifecycle, from understanding user requirements and generating user stories through to development, testing and release.
* Work collaboratively to solve complex technical and engineering problems.
* Translate specialised engineering knowledge and workflows into intuitive, reliable software.
* Integrate machine\-learning models into production software for performance prediction and process optimisation.
* Contribute to the ongoing improvement of our software architecture, development practices and engineering standards.

**Essential skills**

* A strong technical background, demonstrated through a completed or expected degree in a quantitative subject such as computer science, engineering, mathematics or the physical sciences (2:1 minimum).
* Experience writing software in at least one object\-oriented programming language through academic, personal or professional projects, for example C\#, C\+\+, Java, Python or Go.
* An interest in applied engineering or science.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly.
* Experience with version control systems, such as Git.
* Understanding of data structures and algorithms.
**Desired skills**

* Good understanding of software design patterns, best practices and principles, e.g. DRY.
* Familiarity with test\-driven development.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines.
* Understanding of concurrent programming principles.
* Experience programming with 3D geometry.
* Experience developing or integrating machine\-learning models.

**Technology Stack:**

* Backend: C\# \| C\+\+ \| ASP.NET Core \| EF Core \| GraphQL \| REST
* Frontend: Blazor \| Next.js \| React \| TypeScript
* Data: Microsoft SQL Server
* Cloud \& DevOps: Azure \| Azure DevOps \| Docker
* AI: Azure AI Foundry

Strictly no recruitment agencies / apply now for immediate consideration / Closing date for applications will be the 1st of November 2026

jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Humanscale is the premier designer and manufacturer of ergonomic products that improve health and comfort at work. **We have a focus on sustainability with over 70% of our products currently certified as having a Net Positive impact on the environment.** Our award\-winning office products – seating, sit/stand desks, technology support and lighting – have led the industry in performance and simplicity for over 40 years.
Overview:

This is temporary cover / fixed\-term contract role to cover maternity leave.  

The role of UK Engineering Operations Coordinator is an administration position whose main role is to organise and assist the Engineers in the department to have the correct parts and information to carry out their customer visits.  

Second to this is dealing directly with our customers and Dealer partners from a customer support point of view. Making sure they are happy with their Humanscale products and if not to assist them with replacement parts orders or booking in our engineers to carry out any repairs.

* Manage and coordinate the UK Support mailbox, ensuring all enquiries are handled efficiently and prioritised appropriately.

* Generate quotations based on engineering audit reports.
* Generate quotations based on customers repair and warranty enquiries.
* Submit customer, warranty, and warehouse stock orders to the Dublin Customer Service team.
* Create and manage defect reports for quality issues relating to Humanscale products.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with Humanscale furniture dealers, partners, and key accounts.
* Maintain the UK Support engineering repair log, ensuring daily repair jobs are accurately recorded and tracked.
* Prepare and issue weekly customer invoices for completed chargeable work, while proactively supporting initiatives to improve financial performance and reduce outstanding balances.
* Schedule and coordinate engineers’ visits, ensuring all work is planned, communicated, and executed efficiently for customers and the engineering team.

* Attend regular operational, progress, and management meetings to provide updates and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
* Act as the primary point of contact for operational matters, resolving issues effectively and ensuring smooth day\-to\-day business operations.


Qualifications:
* Able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously

jobs.title: Senior Animation Engineer | Unity3D | Remote | Stylized Games
jobs.description:
**Senior Animation Engineer \| Unity3D \| Remote \| Stylized Games**
--------------------------------------------------------------------

### **Position Overview**


Beffio is looking for an experienced **Senior Animation Engineer** to join a major game project developed in Unity3D.


This role sits between **Animation, Technical Art, and Engineering**, focusing on the technology, runtime systems, and tools behind high\-quality character animation.


We are looking for someone who understands animation as both a creative workflow and a technical system. You should be comfortable working with animators on controllers, rigs, and pipelines while also discussing runtime architecture, ECS/DOTS, GPU skinning, shaders, performance, and C\# implementation with engineers.


This is a senior individual contributor role with significant **R\&D and technical ownership**, taking ideas from early prototypes through production\-ready systems that can be used and maintained by the wider team.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop and optimize animation runtime systems in Unity.
* Work with state machines, blend trees, layers, masks, root motion, animation events, and compression.
* Develop or integrate data\-oriented animation solutions using ECS/DOTS, Jobs, Burst, and baking workflows.
* Explore GPU skinning, deformation, compute shaders, vertex shaders, and vertex animation techniques.
* Build Unity editor tools, validators, asset processors, and production workflows for animation teams.
* Support rigging, skeleton, skinning, and FBX workflows between Maya or Blender and Unity.
* Profile and optimize animation systems across mobile hardware.
* Collaborate closely with Animators, Technical Artists, Gameplay Engineers, and Rendering Engineers.
* Take technical R\&D from prototype to production\-ready feature.
* Establish clean documentation, workflows, and technical standards for the wider team.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Strong **C\# and Unity** engineering experience.
* Hands\-on experience with **ECS/DOTS**, including Entities, Burst, Jobs, and baking, or deep equivalent data\-oriented engine experience.
* Strong understanding of animation runtimes including state machines, blend trees, layers, masks, root motion, events, and animation compression.
* Experience with GPU skinning and deformation using structured or constant buffers, compute shaders, vertex shaders, or similar techniques.
* Shader development experience in **HLSL** and a node\-based tool such as Shader Graph or Amplify.
* Practical knowledge of character rigs, skeletons, skinning, and FBX pipelines in Maya, Blender, or similar tools.
* Experience creating Unity editor tools such as asset postprocessors, validators, custom inspectors, or editor windows.
* Experience profiling and optimizing mobile graphics workloads, particularly on Adreno and Mali hardware.
* Familiarity with GLES and Vulkan.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with both artists and engineers.
* Fluent English.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with DOTS animation frameworks such as **Rukhanka, Latios Kinemation**, or similar technology.
* Experience building or extending a custom animation runtime.
* Networked animation involving prediction and rollback.
* Netcode for Entities or similar multiplayer technology.
* Procedural animation including IK, secondary motion, or physics\-driven layers.
* Facial animation systems using blendshapes, bones, textures, or hybrid approaches.
* Crowd animation systems including animation LOD, VAT, or update throttling.
* Experience developing animation systems for mobile or other performance\-constrained platforms.

**Ownership**
-------------


We are looking for someone who can:

* Take R\&D from an initial technical spike through to a shipped production feature.
* Independently drive complex technical investigations and make pragmatic architectural decisions.
* Balance animation quality, performance, complexity, and usability.
* Create systems and standards that others can confidently build upon.
* Be equally comfortable reviewing an animator's controller and an engineer's pull request.
* Work closely with artists rather than treating animation as purely an engineering problem.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Meaningful ownership over animation technology on a major Unity3D game project.
* Direct collaboration with experienced Animators, Technical Artists, Engineers, and discipline leads.
* The opportunity to work on complex technical R\&D and turn it into production systems.
* A highly collaborative international team.
* Fully remote work.
* Flexible contract options depending on location.
* Competitive compensation based on experience and contract structure.
* Annual Beffio team retreats.
* The possibility of long\-term collaboration as the project grows.

jobs.title: Senior VFX Engineer | Unity3D | Remote | Stylized Games

**Senior VFX Engineer \| Unity3D \| Remote**
--------------------------------------------

### **Position Overview**


Beffio is looking for an experienced **Senior VFX Engineer** to join a major game project developed in Unity3D.


This role sits between **VFX, Technical Art, Rendering, and Engineering**, focusing on the technology and scalable runtime systems behind real\-time effects.


We are looking for someone who can take a question like *"can we make it look like this?"* and turn the visual idea into a solution that is performant, reusable, artist\-friendly, and scalable across a large game.


You will work closely with VFX Artists and Engineers on shaders, particles, GPU\-driven effects, runtime architecture, tooling, mobile optimization, and gameplay integration.


This is a senior individual contributor role with significant technical ownership, where you will be expected to prototype solutions, make architectural decisions, and take systems through to production.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop scalable runtime systems for high\-frequency gameplay effects.
* Build solutions for pooling, shared emitters, batching, prioritization, and effect budgets.
* Develop shaders using **HLSL**, Shader Graph, Amplify, or similar tools.
* Work with particle systems, mesh particles, trails, flipbooks, procedural effects, and GPU\-driven techniques.
* Build artist\-facing Unity tools, validators, custom inspectors, asset processors, and batch workflows.
* Optimize effects for mobile GPUs, memory, overdraw, shader complexity, and runtime performance.
* Collaborate with VFX Artists, Technical Artists, Gameplay Engineers, and Rendering Engineers.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Strong **HLSL shader programming** experience.
* Fluency with node\-based tools such as Shader Graph, Amplify, or similar.
* Strong understanding of real\-time rendering including blending, transparency, sorting, depth, instancing, and scriptable or custom render pipelines.
* Experience shipping particle\-based effects in Unity using Shuriken or equivalent systems.
* Experience with mesh particles, trails, flipbooks, and shader\-driven effects.
* Experience designing scalable effect runtimes for high\-frequency effects, including pooling, batching, prioritization, or budget management.
* Strong C\# gameplay or engine programming experience.
* Experience with ECS/DOTS, Jobs, Burst, or equivalent performance\-focused architecture is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of mobile GPU optimization including overdraw, half precision, texture budgets, memory, and shader variants.
* Unity editor tooling experience including custom inspectors, drawers, asset processors, or batch tools.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with ECS\-based rendering or instanced material properties.
* Compute shaders and GPU\-driven effects.
* Vertex animation techniques.

* Strong artistic eye and ability to participate in VFX look development.

**Ownership**
-------------


We are looking for someone who can:

* Act as a bridge between **artists and engineers**.
* Independently turn creative requests into workflows and technology that scale.
* Prototype solutions quickly, validate them technically, and take them through to production.
* Make informed technical decisions balancing visual ambition with runtime performance.

**What We Offer**

* Meaningful ownership over the technology powering VFX on a major Unity3D game project.
* Direct collaboration with experienced VFX Artists, Technical Artists, Rendering Engineers, and Gameplay Engineers.
* The opportunity to solve challenging rendering and performance problems.
* A role where engineering directly enables creative ambition.
* A highly collaborative international team.
* Fully remote work.
* Flexible contract options depending on location.
* Competitive compensation based on experience and contract structure.
* Annual Beffio team retreats.
* The possibility of long\-term collaboration as the project grows.
