jobs.title: Platform Engineer - Fintech/ Crypto
jobs.description:
**Hey! Nice to see you!**


At Incubly, we believe that great people want to work with great people, so we started to build a company that attracts great minds and enables us to achieve great things while genuinely enjoying what we do. Our mission is to support tech companies and startups (scaleups) in scaling their teams quickly and with high quality, while boosting product development, testing, and deployment so we can succeed together.


We are currently working with a French company that is a leader in security and infrastructure solutions for cryptocurrencies and blockchain applications. It has a team of more than 400 professionals developing a variety of products and services to safeguard cryptocurrency assets, including worldwide leading hardware wallets.


As a **Platform Engineer,** you will work closely with product engineering teams to improve the developer experience and remove friction from the build, package, and deployment process. You will own and improve developer tooling, self\-service platforms, golden paths, runners, registries, delivery tooling, and observability. You will collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to ensure the platform is fast, reliable, secure, and easy to use, while using automation and strong systems thinking to help teams ship faster and more safely.
  

  

**Your daily responsibilities**


**CI/CD platform \& runner fleet**


* Own and evolve the self\-hosted GitHub Actions runner fleet, including Linux runners managed via Actions Runner Controller (ARC), self\-hosted macOS runners, and the Terraform modules that provision and scale self\-hosted infrastructure.
* Right\-size runner classes (CPU/memory/storage) against real workload profiles, balancing cost efficiency against engineering velocity, and supporting engineering teams in understanding and owning the resource footprint of their own jobs.
* Support the migration away from GitHub\-hosted runners, including evaluating trade\-offs between containerised and VM\-based execution for workloads with special hardware requirements (e.g. KVM access for Android emulators).
* Partner with embedded DevOps engineers on pipeline and dependency\-graph optimisations (build triggers, job fan\-out, monorepo change detection) to reduce queue times and unnecessary CI spend — you own the platform and runner layer these pipelines execute on.
* Investigate and resolve macOS virtualisation performance issues (e.g. Tart) and help evaluate alternative approaches such as remote simulator hosts.

**Artifact \& package management**


* Administer the JFrog Platform (Artifactory, Xray, Curation) as the organization’s primary artifact
  

repository, including repository structure, access control, vulnerability scanning policies, and
  

curation/allow\-listing of upstream dependencies.
* Provide light\-touch, minimal support for GitHub Container Registry (GHCR) and GitHub Packages where teams use them alongside JFrog.
* Operate and maintain ChartMuseum as the organization’s Helm chart repository, hosted on S3,
  

including storage lifecycle, access, and chart promotion workflows.
* Define and enforce container image ownership boundaries — platform\-owned hardened/minimal base images (e.g. Docker Hardened Images, Chainguard) versus engineering\-owned project extensions — and drive Dockerfile build and layer optimisation best practices across teams.

**Progressive delivery \& infrastructure automation**


* Operate two ArgoCD / Argo Rollouts environments, one serving internal tooling and one serving product workloads supporting GitOps\-based, progressive delivery (canary/blue\-green) patterns for engineering teams.
* Author, maintain, and support Helm charts and Kustomize overlays as the standard configuration management approach for Kubernetes workloads, providing golden\-path templates that reduce boilerplate for product teams.
* Design, review, and evolve Terraform and Terragrunt modules for infrastructure\-as\-code, including maintaining a public/internal module registry that product and platform teams can consume in a self\-service manner.

**Observability \& reliability**


* Improve and help unify the observability stack; Grafana, Prometheus, and Alertmanager. Fixing
  

metric accuracy issues, building meaningful dashboards, and defining SLOs/alerting that reflect real platform and pipeline health.
* Work across Datadog and VictoriaLogs/VictoriaMetrics to reduce tool sprawl, and help define a
  

coherent strategy for where metrics, logs, and events should live.
* Provide platform\-level telemetry (runner utilization, build queue times, artifact scan results, deployment health) that gives engineering teams and leadership a single, trustworthy view of pipeline and platform performance.

**Internal developer platform, policy \& modern workloads**


* Evaluate and help operate Crossplane as a control\-plane layer for self\-service, Kubernetes\-native infrastructure provisioning, complementing the existing Terraform/Terragrunt IaC estate.
* Contribute to a developer portal / internal catalogue strategy (e.g. Backstage, Cortex, or Port) so engineers have a single place to discover services, ownership, docs, and golden\-path templates.
* Implement and maintain policy\-as\-code guardrails using Kyverno and/or Open Policy Agent (OPA) across the Kubernetes and CI/CD estate (e.g. image provenance, resource limits, security baselines).
* Support Knative\-based serverless/event\-driven workloads on Kubernetes where teams need
  

scale\-to\-zero or request\-driven compute.
* Roll out OpenTelemetry instrumentation and pipelines to standardise traces, metrics, and logs across services, feeding the Grafana/Prometheus/Datadog/VictoriaLogs stack with consistent, correlated telemetry.

**Developer experience \& enablement**


* Act as the platform’s embedded point of contact for one or more product engineering teams:
  

Understand their day\-to\-day friction, prioritise platform work accordingly, and close the loop on
  

delivery.
* Build self\-service tooling, templates, and documentation (golden paths) so engineers can provision runners, publish artifacts, and deploy without needing deep platform expertise.
* Clearly document ownership boundaries between platform and product teams (e.g. base images vs. application extensions) and help engineering teams operate confidently within them.
* Contribute to the platform roadmap, bringing a developer\-experience lens to prioritisation — and measure success in terms of engineer\-facing outcomes such as build time, queue time, and self\-service adoption, not just infrastructure uptime.

**We need you to have**


**Experience \& technical skills**


* 5\+ years in a Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering role, ideally
  

supporting product engineering teams directly.
* Hands\-on experience with GitHub Actions, including self\-hosted runner architectures (Actions Runner Controller / Kubernetes\-based Linux runners, self\-hosted macOS runners) and provisioning them via Terraform.
* Practical knowledge of the JFrog Platform (Artifactory, Xray, and ideally Curation) for artifact
  

management and dependency security.
* Familiarity with container registries beyond a single vendor (GHCR/GitHub Packages) and Helm chart repositories such as ChartMuseum on object storage (S3\).
* Experience with GitOps continuous delivery using ArgoCD, and ideally Argo Rollouts for progressive delivery (canary/blue\-green) across multiple clusters/environments.
* Strong Kubernetes configuration management skills with Helm and Kustomize.
* Solid Infrastructure\-as\-Code experience with Terraform and Terragrunt, including designing and
  

consuming shared/reusable modules.
* Experience with Crossplane (or a comparable Kubernetes\-native control\-plane approach) for building self\-service infrastructure APIs, alongside deep Terraform proficiency for the underlying IaC.

minimal/hardened base images such as Docker Hardened Images or Chainguard).

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer, Engineering Excellence
jobs.description:
**Make excellent engineering the easy path, for every squad at If CTP**


If is the biggest insurance company in the Nordics: thousands of skilled colleagues keeping everyday life running for millions of customers, their homes, cars, businesses and more. Behind that promise stands modern engineering, and behind our engineers stands Engineering Excellence: a DevOps\-oriented enablement team whose product is the capability of every other squad. We are now looking for a DevOps Engineer who wants to build shared platforms, coach fellow engineers, and shape safe, human\-approved agentic AI ways of working.

  

**About the role**

This is not a feature\-delivery seat, it is a multiplier role. Instead of shipping one product, you make many squads better at shipping theirs, and your definition of done includes adoption: work is finished when another team can use, own and support it.

  

Day to day, you will:


* Build and evolve our shared engineering backbone: reusable CI/CD pipelines and pipeline libraries, repository practices, platform tooling, integrations and automation on Azure and Azure DevOps.
* Establish and enable engineering standards, guardrails, and branching and naming conventions that make the right way the easy way.
* Strengthen quality and security: validation and testing enablement, software scanning, secure\-engineering practice, reliability, and actionable engineering feedback.
* Untangle material cross\-squad blockers in builds, environments, delivery and platform, making dependencies visible and handing over responsibly.
* Coach engineers and squads, support onboarding, and turn hard\-won knowledge into documentation people actually use.
* Use engineering metrics, discovery and evidence to guide continuous improvement, without overstating what the data proves.
  

You will also be hands\-on in our agentic engineering journey. We are building an AI\-assisted operating model for the team that starts deliberately read\-only and follows a strict loop: agents observe and propose, humans approve, and only then are changes applied. You will help design these proposal\-controlled workflows, the guardrails and least\-privilege access behind them, and the evidence that shows what AI adoption genuinely improves.

  

You will work across every squad rather than inside one, side by side with architects, squad technical leads, Product Management and program stakeholders. It is a rare vantage point that grows your platform depth and your influence at the same time. The team runs on Kanban flow rather than sprints: demand is clarified, work is made ready, delivered, validated, documented and handed over, with blockers made visible instead of hidden.

  

**We offer**


In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:

  

* Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
* Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
* An including work environment where everyone is welcome
* Possibility of hybrid workplace
* Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
Great insurance benefits  
* 

  

**About the team**


Engineering Excellence is six engineers with one shared conviction: great enablement means the job is not done until someone else can use, own and support the outcome. We prefer evidence over assumptions, we make dependencies and risks visible instead of hiding them, and we keep egos low and trust high, coaching each other the same way we coach the squads.

  

Human accountability sits at the core of how we adopt AI: our agents may observe and propose, but people approve, and decision rights always stay with the roles that own them. If’s whole business is keeping promises when it matters most, and we hold our engineering to the same standard, reliable, secure, and easy to build on. We also live If’s customer\-centric, “undifficult” mindset internally: our customers are If’s own squads, and our job is to make their best work feel effortless. You will join an international workplace that is genuinely committed to diversity, and a team where your questions on day one are as welcome as your improvements on day one hundred.

  

**Who are you?**


You are an enabler at heart, you get real energy from making other engineers faster, safer and more confident. You communicate clearly and coach as naturally as you commit code. You are curious and evidence\-driven: you would rather measure than assume, and you separate facts from interpretation. When dependencies tangle and priorities shift, you stay calm, make the situation visible, and keep the flow moving. You treat documentation and handover as part of the craft rather than an afterthought. And whenever automation or AI touches real systems, you exercise sound judgement about access, privacy, least privilege and human approval.

  

**You also have:**


* Practical experience in DevOps, platform engineering, developer productivity or engineering enablement
* Hands\-on skills in CI/CD, Git, repository management, automation and pipeline engineering
* Experience with Azure and/or Azure DevOps
* A track record of improving quality, testing, security scanning, reliability or engineering standards
* Comfort working in a flow\-based / Kanban way, with dependencies, blockers and explicit handover
  

**It’s a plus if you also bring:**


* Development experience in .NET, Java, Kotlin or TypeScript, or full\-stack curiosity
* Experience with agentic or AI\-assisted development, and with measuring its adoption responsibly
* Work with DORA or other engineering metrics, discovery or maturity assessments
* Experience building pipeline libraries, reusable templates or repository governance at scale

**Additional facts and the recruitment process**
------------------------------------------------

**Application deadline:** Screening and interviewing will start immediately. However, application deadline is 14th of October.


**To apply for the position:** Please attach your CV.


**Work location:** Bergshamra


**Start:** By agreement

  

For more information, please contact Burhan Öcüt, DevOps Architect, burhan.ocut@if.se

  

Background checks may be conducted as part of the recruitment process in accordance with applicable legislation and internal policies.

  

**We look forward to your application!**

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**Work Schedule**


Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**


As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

 **Location/Division Specific Information:**

**Olink**, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, is dedicated to advancing the understanding of human disease through proteomics. Olink panels provide innovative, high\-quality solutions for human protein biomarker discovery, enabling researchers to measure thousands of proteins simultaneously from just a few microliters of blood. Using highly specific and thoroughly validated assays with a wide dynamic range, Olink’s technology overcomes traditional limitations in protein analysis and supports deeper insights into human biology and disease.  

  

**Job description:**  

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced **Staff Data Engineer**. In this role, you will provide technical leadership and architectural guidance while developing innovative solutions that enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Working in a supportive, multi\-functional environment, you will design and implement sophisticated solutions for our RnD users and processes. You will support the growth of other engineers, drive adoption of best practices, and help shape the technical direction of critical projects. This position offers the opportunity to work with advanced technologies while contributing to groundbreaking scientific discoveries. The role is based in our Uppsala office.  



  

**A Day in the Life:**

* Build and operate on PSX analytical data processing platform in AWS
* Design and build a robust foundation for data pipelines
* Take ownership for the platform architecture, infrastructure and longevity
* Be part of our solution design group and collaborate with other dev leads (Software \& AI Data Science) to secure the best designs and architecture and ensure our tooling eco system is future proof
* Support less senior team members, foster best practices and set high standards.
* Be opportunistiskt, identify and suggest solutions for potential challenges such as performance, scalability, cost and security
* Represent the team in technical and complex cross functional matters

 **Requirements:**

* Master of Science in Molecular Biotechnology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field.
* Several years of working experience, Life Science experience is a plus.
* Strong experience building analytical data \& analytics platforms in cloud environments (AWS knowledge or willingness to learn AWS is required)
* Strong verbal and presentational skills
* Strong Python or C\# programming skills
* Knowledgeable in infrastructure\-as\-code (CDK/Terraform).
* Experience working with Iceberg, versioning etc.
* A product\-oriented mindset, focused on building durable, scalable solutions rather than one\-off pipelines.
* Experience in Ops/Observability, i.e building monitoring solutions.

 **Why Join Us?**


At Olink, Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will be part of a nurturing team that values integrity, innovation, and involvement. We offer an encouraging environment where your diverse experiences and perspectives are appreciated, enabling you to thrive and excel in your career.

  

The final date for submitting applications is on the 20th of October. The role could be filled prior to this deadline.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
* Permanent
* Experienced Professionals
* Software Engineering
* ID 568931\-en\_US
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a workplace where you are empowered to shape your career in the way you envision, where you become part of a supportive and inspiring community of engaged colleagues around the world, and where you have the opportunity to redefine what is possible. Our Cloud \& Custom Applications teams focus on developing tailored, scalable, and secure cloud applications, integrating IT systems, and driving business transformation. AI is a key technology in everything we do and a central part of how we design and build modern systems and solutions. Intelligent AI\-driven ways of working and technologies such as Agentic AI are accelerating innovation and shaping the future. Join us and help shape the next generation of systems together with world\-leading organizations, while contributing to unlocking the full potential of technology in a more sustainable and inclusive world.


**.**
-----


**Your Role**


As a Platform Engineer Specialist at Capgemini, you will help clients design, build, and operate secure, scalable, and self\-service platform solutions. You will combine hands\-on engineering with platform strategy, automation, developer enablement, governance, and operational excellence.
  

Platform Engineering is becoming one of the most important disciplines in modern software development. Organisations are investing heavily in developer platforms, cloud\-native technologies, automation and AI\-enabled engineering to help teams deliver software faster, more securely and at greater scale. We are growing our Platform Engineering capability across Sweden and are looking for Platform Engineers and Senior Platform Engineers who want to help clients solve complex engineering challenges, modernise software delivery and build platforms that enable hundreds, and sometimes thousands, of developers.
  

This is a client\-facing consulting role where you will combine hands\-on engineering with architecture, automation, platform strategy and developer enablement. You will work with leading organisations across multiple industries, helping them establish modern platform capabilities that accelerate innovation while maintaining high standards for security, reliability and governance.


This is a client\-facing consulting role, and your work setup may vary between hybrid, onsite, or client\-based engagements depending on the assignment. You can be based in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Helsingborg, Malmö, Växjö, or Älmhult.  

  

  



**In this role, you will play a key part in:**


* Design, build, and operate cloud\-native platforms across Azure, AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, and OpenShift, enabling modern delivery through CI/CD, self\-service tooling, and internal developer platforms.
* Developing golden paths, reusable templates, platform APIs, and service catalogues that make it easier for engineering teams to build, deploy, and operate services.
* Driving automation and Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Terraform, Bicep, Pulumi, CloudFormation, Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
* Establishing platform standards, reference architectures and governance including platform security, identity and access management, observability, monitoring, and operational excellence.

Support clients in moving AI initiatives from experimentation to secure, scalable, production\-ready solutions.  
* 

**Your profile**


* Hands\-on experience in platform engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, cloud engineering, site reliability engineering, or a closely related field.
* A strong understanding of modern platform engineering principles and how self\-service solutions can improve developer productivity and operational efficiency.
* Programming or scripting experience using Python, Go, C\#, Java, TypeScript, or similar languages.
* Experience in applying security, governance, and responsible AI principles in an enterprise environment.
* Practical experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, Amazon Q, Gemini Code Assist, or similar.
* A practical understanding of modern AI concepts and patterns, including LLMs, prompting, context engineering, RAG, evaluation, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.
* The ability to combine strategic platform thinking with hands\-on technical delivery in complex environments.

Clear communication with technical teams and client stakeholders, and an interest in working in a consulting context.  
* 

*We do not expect you to know about every technology on this list. We are looking for strong engineering fundamentals, hands\-on experience, and the ability to understand how infrastructure, software delivery, security, operations, and developer needs fit together*


**.**
-----


**What we believe you will enjoy about working here**


* Being part of a growing Platform Engineering capability where your expertise and ideas can make a visible impact.
* Working across diverse client environments, industries, technologies, and delivery models.
* Collaborating with skilled colleagues locally and globally, with access to strong technical communities and development opportunities.
* Contributing to initiatives within cloud, platform automation, developer enablement, and AI\-assisted engineering.

Helping clients build solutions that are secure, scalable, sustainable, and valuable in real business contexts.  
* 

**Application**  

  

We look forward to receiving your application. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, please contact the responsible recruiter at Helene.yde@capgemini.com


*As part of our recruitment process, identity verification will be conducted through inspection of your ID card, and background checks may be carried out as required.*
  

\#LI\-HY1


Capgemini is the business transformation partner for enterprises in the age of AI. We help organizations imagine and build an intelligent, sustainable future, combining AI, technology and human ingenuity to transform how they operate, innovate and grow. With unique end\-to\-end capabilities spanning strategy, technology, engineering and intelligent operations, we bring together deep industry expertise and market\-leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data to turn ambition into measurable business outcomes at scale. Supported by a robust ecosystem of partners and nearly 60 years of expertise, Capgemini is a responsible and diverse global organization of over 410,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 revenues of €22\.5 billion.


Make it real \| www.capgemini.com

jobs.title: Senior Backend-utvecklare – .NET & moderna tekniker

Jobbeskrivning Vill du arbeta med modern backendutveckling, AI, komplexa tekniska lösningar och samtidigt vara med och skapa verkligt värde för våra kunder? Sigma i Blekinge söker nu Seniora Backend\-utvecklare inom .NET med stark kompetens inom Microsofts utvecklingsekosystem. Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet av systemutveckling och som trivs i tekniskt utmanande miljöer tillsammans med andra erfarna utvecklare. Du behöver inte kunna allt.
  
  

Vi värdesätter teknisk bredd, nyfikenhet, erfarenhet och förmågan att snabbt sätta dig in i nya tekniker och problemområden. Om rollen Som Senior Backend\-utvecklare inom .NET (helst fullstack) hos Sigma kommer du att arbeta i varierande och utvecklande uppdrag hos våra kunder. Uppdragen kan sträcka sig från utveckling av moderna molnbaserade tjänster och distribuerade system till vidareutveckling av större affärskritiska plattformar. Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med: AI – Agenter, LLM, RAG, MCP och interna LLM\-modeller Design och utveckling av skalbara backendlösningar C\# och .NET\-baserade applikationer och tjänster API, integrationer och microservices Systemarkitektur och tekniska vägval Containerbaserade och molnbaserade miljöer Eventdrivna och distribuerade system Kodgranskning, testning och kvalitetssäkring CI/CD och automatiserade utvecklingsflöden Agila arbetssätt och nära samarbete med utvecklare, arkitekter, produktägare och andra intressenter AI\-baserade verktyg som en naturlig del av utvecklingsprocessen Som senior utvecklare förväntas du vara kommunikativ, bidra i tekniska diskussioner, ta ansvar för lösningar och vid behov stötta och coacha andra utvecklare.
  
  

Du bör ha arbetat MINST 4 år med flera av följande tekniker och områden: C\#, .NET, .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, Web API, REST API, Blazor, Vue, Microservices, Entity Framework Core, SQL Server, PostgreSQL eller andra databaser, Azure, AWS eller annan molnplattform, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Kafka eller andra event\- och meddelandeplattformar, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, DevOps, Testautomatisering, Agila arbetssätt och Scrum. AI som kraftfullt hjälpmedel i utvecklingen Vi ser AI som ett kraftfullt hjälpmedel för att öka effektiviteten och skapa mer värde till våra kunder snabbare – inte som ett facit. Vi vill att du har erfarenhet av AI där vi bland annat använder det till att: Bidra till högre system\- och applikationssäkerhet, identifiera risker och attackytor Snabbare skapa och testa lösningar och korta tiden från idé till konkret kundvärde Effektivisera utveckling, felsökning och dokumentation Förbättra kodkvalitet och testning Analysera och förstå stora eller komplexa kodbaser Automatisera repetitiva delar av utvecklingsprocessen Skapa snabbare iterationer och bättre beslutsunderlag Vem är du? Har flera års professionell erfarenhet av backend\- och systemutveckling Har gedigen erfarenhet av C\# och .NET Är van att arbeta med moderna ramverk, verktyg och utvecklingsmetoder Förstår vikten av kvalitet, säkerhet, prestanda och skalbarhet Kan ta ansvar för tekniska lösningar från idé till produktion Gillar att dela kunskap och diskutera tekniska lösningar med andra Är kommunikativ och trivs med att samarbeta både inom teamet och med kunden Är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och tycker om att lära dig nya saker Har ett intresse för AI och hur tekniken kan användas för att effektivisera och förbättra systemutveckling Som senior utvecklare ser vi gärna att du också är bekväm med att bidra till arkitekturdiskussioner, stötta andra utvecklare och utmana befintliga tekniska lösningar när det finns bättre alternativ.
  
  

Hos Sigma Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta tillsammans med kompetenta kollegor och kunder i tekniskt spännande miljöer. Vi tror på frihet under ansvar, kunskapsdelning och att människor utvecklas bäst när de får möjlighet att ta sig an utmaningar som både stimulerar, utvecklar och skapar nya möjligheter. Gemenskapen är en viktig del av vilka vi är. Vi har roligt tillsammans, umgås och hittar regelbundet på aktiviteter, event och gemensamma äventyr.
  
  

Varje år reser vi utomlands tillsammans. Just nu befinner vi oss i en mycket spännande och expansiv fas i Blekinge. Regionen växer, investeringarna ökar och behovet av teknisk kompetens är stort. Sigmas fortsatta satsning i Blekinge går hand i hand med regionens utveckling, och vi vill fortsätta att vara en aktiv del i att bygga den kompetens och innovationskraft som behövs framåt.

jobs.title: Photonics Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Thorlabs Sweden i Mölndal söker nu ytterligare en ingenjör till vår Tech\-supportavdelning inom fotonik OM JOBBET Som Photonics Support Engineer kommer du att arbeta i ett litet team med erfarna ingenjörer som ansvarar för teknisk support till våra kunder med både rekommendationer före beställning och hjälp med befintlig utrustning. Du kommer ha stort eget ansvar att driva ditt eget arbete framåt, men i mycket tätt samarbete och stöd av övriga medlemmar i gruppen. Du kommer även att samarbeta med ingenjörer från andra delar av koncernen med stor kunskap och erfarenhet inom de specialområden våra kunder jobbar med, som exempelvis optisk mätteknink, optik, lasrar och ljuskällor, optiska fibrer och spektroskopi. Det finns också möjligheter till resor till våra andra kontor för utbildningar och utbyten.
  
  

Här i Mölndal utvecklas och tillverkas optiska system, som exempelvis objektiv och avancerade fiberkollimatorer samt instrument för spektroskopi. Genom nära samarbete med våra egna utvecklingsingenjörer kommer du få möjlighet att bygga specialistkunskap inom dessa produktkategorier. För att utveckla produktförståelsen finns dessutom tid till praktiskt arbete i vårt eget lab. I rollen ingår även att representera Thorlabs på mässor inom fotonikområdet, och till viss del kundbesök.
  
  

OM DIG För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har en högskoleutbildning inom fysik eller motsvarande, gärna med inriktning mot eller examensarbete inom fotonik/optik. Har du praktisk erfarenhet av fotonik/optik\-lab, av optiska simuleringar i Zemax och arbete med kundkontakt är det ett stort plus. Det är även meriterande med kunskaper inom elektronik och programmering i tex Python, C\# eller LabView. Vi söker dig som är kommunikativ och har lätt för att ge förklaringar på ett pedagogiskt sätt.
  
  

Du är intresserad av att lära dig nya saker och tycker det är kul att hitta lösningar på frågor som du från start inte har svaret på. Då kundkontakt är en central del av tjänsten är det viktigt att du har en stor vilja att förstå kundernas utmaningar och ett engagemang i att hitta bästa lösningen för dem. För att trivas hos oss ser vi att du gillar att självständigt finna lösningar och ta egna initiativ, men även aktivt samarbeta med kollegor för att tillsammans nå ett bra resultat. Du trivs med att jobba med internationella kontakter, och har mycket goda kunskaper i engelska och svenska, både i tal och skrift.
  
  

OM ANSTÄLLNINGEN Hos oss på Thorlabs får du möjlighet att bli en del av ett engagerat och sammansvetsat team i en internationell miljö där varje dag bjuder på nya utmaningar och möjligheter. Vi är stolta över att erbjuda en trygg och långsiktig anställning med tekniskt spännande produkter och stor möjlighet till personlig utveckling och stort eget ansvar. Utvecklingsmöjligheter finns både i vår lokala och europeiska organisation. Arbetet sker huvudsakligen på plats i våra lokaler, där vi samarbetar och stöttar varandra för att nå våra gemensamma mål.
  
  

Våra ljusa och moderna lokaler i Mölndal skapar en trivsam arbetsmiljö där vi värnar om både prestation och välmående. Vi erbjuder flexibla arbetstider som gör det lättare att balansera arbete och fritid, tjänstepension för din trygghet på lång sikt, friskvårdsbidrag som uppmuntrar till god hälsa samt sjukvårdsförsäkring som ger dig extra trygghet om du skulle behöva det. Vi är även anslutna till kollektivavtal, vilket innebär att du får bra villkor och rättvisa förmåner. Ansök gärna redan idag!
  
  

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, och tjänsten kan tillsättas före sista ansökningsdatum. OM FÖRETAGET Thorlabs Sweden AB är en del av en global koncern med över 3 000 anställda världen över. Med en produktportfölj som omfattar mer än 20 000 artiklar är vi en ledande leverantör av fotonikprodukter för forskning och utveckling inom akademi, industri och sjukvård. Koncernen bedriver både försäljning, utveckling och tillverkning på flera platser i USA, Europa och Asien.
  
  

Vår verksamhet i Sverige etablerades 2004 och har idag 90 medarbetare i moderna lokaler i Mölndal, strax utanför Göteborg. Med avancerade testmiljöer och ett modernt renrum är Thorlabs Sweden särskilt väl rustat för utveckling och tillverkning av högteknologiska optiska system. Vi ansvarar även för teknisk support av samtliga produkter i Thorlabs katalog samt för försäljningsverksamheten i Skandinavien, Baltikum och Polen.

jobs.title: Software Engineer | Range Operations
jobs.description:
**Job Description** **Hej Software Engineer!**

**Do you want to furnish the future to make room for everyone?**  

  

With us, you can feel at home at work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our Software Engineer, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.  

  

We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer to join our Digital Product Area: “Product Engineering”, a part of Digital Engineering at Inter IKEA, Range. The Product Engineering Area is dedicated to ensuring an attractive, consistent, and efficient way of working for product development and our suppliers. Our goal is to establish a strong foundation for IKEA's product information, enabling its seamless use across the entire value chain. We are growing our team in Malmö, Sweden, but you need to have great communication and collaboration skills to be able to integrate our offshore team.

  



**Your new job**  

We’re looking for a Software Engineer who wants to solve complex, real\-world problems to make life at home simpler. Join us on our journey as we level up our technology to enhance everyday experiences. Your primary focus will be on developing solutions for the handling of materials in our product designers work and you’ll report to a Software Engineering Manager. The impact of your work will touch homes and hearts around the world. On a typical day, you will:

* Build and evolve our material management solution, a core part of IKEA's digital landscape.
* Develop web applications, APIs, and cloud services using Next.js, .NET, and Azure.
* Contribute throughout the product lifecycle, from discovery and design to delivery and continuous improvement.
* Be part of a team that values collaboration, continuous learning, and openness, while actively sharing knowledge and supporting others.
* Bring curiosity and contribute ideas that improve both our products and ways of working.
* Ensure high\-quality software through code reviews, automated testing, and engineering best practices.

 **Qualifications** **What we’d like you to bring to the table**  

  

This role as a Software Engineer requires you to:

* Be highly skilled and experienced within React, NextJs and Typescript, a minimum of 3\-5 years of work life experience
* Be highly skilled and experienced within C\# and .NET framework, a minimum of 3\-5 years of work life experience
* Have good knowledge of Azure.
* Have good interpersonal skills: active listening, coaching and facilitation.
* Be an excellent communicator by communicating in a clear, structured and honest way – both with inhouse and offshore team and colleagues
* Have a deep understanding of IKEA's core values and cultural principles as well as a mindset and way of working that reflects this


It’s a plus if you also:

* Worked with CI/CD, Terraform (IaC), Github Actions and cloud services
* Have knowledge of database technologies like MongoDB, Postgres DB
* Have experience with Jest/Playwright for Frontend testing
* Are skilled in building dynamic and responsive user interfaces with React

 **Additional Information** **Be yourself, a Software Engineer and more!**  

  

Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce, and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives.  

  

Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co\-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down\-to\-earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments, and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you’ll find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career.  



**We welcome your application**  

  

Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 13th of October at the latest.  

  

This is a permanent role based in Malmö; hence, you need to be based in Sweden and be able to work from the office. We believe that your presence with the team and working most of the time in the workplace are important.  

  

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact Vera Bendz, Recruiter, at vera.bendz1@inter.ikea.com. If you have questions about the role, please contact Marie Önnemyr, Hiring Manager, at marie.onnemyr@inter.ikea.com.  

  

At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, or what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers’ dreams and needs.  

  

If you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, just let us know.

*We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. We will first consider co\-workers employed at Inter IKEA Group impacted by organisational changes. For this specific recruitment priority will be given to impacted co\-workers in IKEA of Sweden and Inter IKEA Technology Services AB, provided competence requirements are met for the role.*

Det är även meriterande med kunskaper inom elektronik och programmering i tex Python, C\# eller LabView.


Vi söker dig som är kommunikativ och har lätt för att ge förklaringar på ett pedagogiskt sätt. Du är intresserad av att lära dig nya saker och tycker det är kul att hitta lösningar på frågor som du från start inte har svaret på. Då kundkontakt är en central del av tjänsten är det viktigt att du har en stor vilja att förstå kundernas utmaningar och ett engagemang i att hitta bästa lösningen för dem.


För att trivas hos oss ser vi att du gillar att självständigt finna lösningar och ta egna initiativ, men även aktivt samarbeta med kollegor för att tillsammans nå ett bra resultat. Du trivs med att jobba med internationella kontakter, och har mycket goda kunskaper i engelska och svenska, både i tal och skrift.


***OM ANSTÄLLNINGEN***


Hos oss på Thorlabs får du möjlighet att bli en del av ett engagerat och sammansvetsat team i en internationell miljö där varje dag bjuder på nya utmaningar och möjligheter. Vi är stolta över att erbjuda en trygg och långsiktig anställning med tekniskt spännande produkter och stor möjlighet till personlig utveckling och stort eget ansvar. Utvecklingsmöjligheter finns både i vår lokala och europeiska organisation. Arbetet sker huvudsakligen på plats i våra lokaler, där vi samarbetar och stöttar varandra för att nå våra gemensamma mål.


Våra ljusa och moderna lokaler i Mölndal skapar en trivsam arbetsmiljö där vi värnar om både prestation och välmående. Vi erbjuder flexibla arbetstider som gör det lättare att balansera arbete och fritid, tjänstepension för din trygghet på lång sikt, friskvårdsbidrag som uppmuntrar till god hälsa samt sjukvårdsförsäkring som ger dig extra trygghet om du skulle behöva det. Vi är även anslutna till kollektivavtal, vilket innebär att du får bra villkor och rättvisa förmåner.


***OM FÖRETAGET***

*Thorlabs Sweden AB är en del av en global koncern med över 3 000 anställda världen över. Med en produktportfölj som omfattar mer än 20 000 artiklar är vi en ledande leverantör av fotonikprodukter för forskning och utveckling inom akademi, industri och sjukvård.*

*Koncernen bedriver både försäljning, utveckling och tillverkning på flera platser i USA, Europa och Asien. Vår verksamhet i Sverige etablerades 2004 och har idag 90 medarbetare i moderna lokaler i Mölndal, strax utanför Göteborg.*

*Med avancerade testmiljöer och ett modernt renrum är Thorlabs Sweden särskilt väl rustat för utveckling och tillverkning av högteknologiska optiska system. Vi ansvarar även för teknisk support av samtliga produkter i Thorlabs katalog samt för försäljningsverksamheten i Skandinavien, Baltikum och Polen.*  

  

**Ansök gärna redan idag! Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, och tjänsten kan tillsättas före sista ansökningsdatum.**

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Professional Services (January 2027)
jobs.description:
### **Ongoing is searching for focused and knowledgeable people to strengthen our team of engineers**

#### **Start date: January 2027**

### **About the company**


Headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, Ongoing is a leading cloud\-native WMS for logistics\-intensive companies, including both third\-party logistics (‘3PL’) providers as well as businesses that operate their own warehouses.Designed for organisations with scaling or established warehouse operations with demanding logistics requirements, the platform delivers real\-time inventory control, goods management, customer communication and advanced analytics that reduce manual work and errors. With its user\-friendly interface and scalable platform, Ongoing enables organisations to improve efficiency, enhance order accuracy, and gain full visibility across their supply chain, empowering them to adapt quickly in an increasingly fast\-paced market.


Since July 2026, Ongoing has been a portfolio company of Cinven, a leading pan\-European private equity firm. This marks the beginning of an exciting new growth phase, with continued international expansion and increasing demand for the expertise of our Professional Services team, who work closely with customers to implement, optimise, and develop business\-critical warehouse management solutions.

*Join a team where you'll gain hands\-on experience and contribute to projects that create real value for customers. Here, Jonathan and Eric from Professional Services collaborate on customer solutions and implementation projects.*

#### **About the position**


As an engineer, you will help new and existing customers to develop their businesses by using our web\-based Logistics solution. The work will give you a unique insight into the ever\-changing market of Logistics and its software ecosystem. The work is primarily done from our pleasant office at Johanneberg, Gothenburg, but can also include visits to our customers. The position is full\-time. There are several different ways to continue your career at Ongoing.

*Ongoing WMS handles a large amount of data. Performance, reliability, and security are important. In the role, you will learn how to manage large data quantities using Microsoft SQL Server.*

#### **About you**


Ongoing is looking for engineers who are interested in IT and software and its usage as a tool for developing businesses. We are a company with a strong focus on close collaboration and helping our customers and are therefore looking for a flexible and customer\-oriented person. We think that you can understand and analyze our customers' businesses but also the capacity to learn how a large software solution works. To enjoy working in our team you should be open\-minded and without prestige.

*Learn from experienced colleagues from day one. Here, Gustav from the Integrations team and Måns, Team Lead within Professional Services, discuss a customer solution and share expertise across teams to help customers get the most out of Ongoing.*

*You are expected to know some programming but not C\# specifically. Ongoing WMS is built using C\#.*

#### **Qualifications**


Most importantly, you should be excited about working in a fast\-growing software company where curiosity, ownership, collaboration, and adaptability are key to success. Backed by Cinven, Ongoing is entering an exciting new phase of international growth while maintaining the entrepreneurial culture that has been central to our success. Full professional proficiency in English and a Nordic language is required, and additional language skills are considered an advantage.


We welcome applicants who hold, or are in the final stages of completing, a Master's degree. Our colleagues come from a wide range of engineering disciplines and academic backgrounds, bringing diverse perspectives and expertise to the team. You should have an interest in IT and software development.


*Most of the engineers at Ongoing have a master’s degree from Chalmers equivalent technical university. The office is also located directly next to the Johanneberg campus.*

### **Terms**


At Ongoing, you can expect the employer to challenge as well as care about you. We pay competitive salaries for skilled employees which can help the company to further develop. We also offer a healthy working environment with many other perks. Learn more about how we work at Ongoing.


Start date: January 2027

 *Our top\-floor ping\-pong table is appreciated for breaking off between hard work. Many, but not all, colleagues also like using the health benefits for running, gym, padel, squash, tennis, golf, or other activities.*

jobs.title: Senior Professional Mechanical Engineer - Projects & Overhauls
jobs.description:
Vacancy Number: 29205
Category: Engineering \- Mechanical
Job Type: Full\-time  

The Generation Engineering department in ESB Engineering and Major Projects (EMP) is the centre of engineering for ESB’s generation businesses. The Projects \& Overhauls department function within Generation Engineering is to aide ESB Generation \& Trading (G\&T) in the delivery of overhauls \& outages across the asset portfolio, both thermal \& Hydro focused.  



We currently have an opportunity for Senior Mechanical Engineers within the Projects \& Overhauls Team in Generation Engineering. The successful candidate will support ESB with the management of overhaul projects on existing assets for ESB G\&T.

  

Suitable candidates will lead the technical delivery of plant overhauls across the ESB Generation portfolio. Aligned with same, candidates should have a background in construction, commissioning, maintenance, or operation of:

  

* Gas Turbine Technology.
* Steam Turbine Technology.
* Heat Recovery Steam Generators (HRSGs) \& Boiler technologies.
* High Energy Piping.
* Hydroelectric Turbine Technology.
* Power Generation Balance of Plant Technologies.
  

**Key Responsibilities**


Key responsibilities of the role include, but are not limited to the following:

  

* **Support Overhaul Planning \& Programme:** Aide the Station \& Project Manager in the planning phase through to safe \& efficient delivery of the Overhaul / Outages.
* **Support the Asset Management Process:** Support on technical input, liaison with Asset Specialists \& reporting on assets pre/post overhaul to the aide in the Long\-Term Asset Planning.
* **Inspection \& Test Plans**: Implement Inspection \& Test Plans (ITPs) for mechanical aspects in collaboration with the relevant internal Competent Persons and/or Asset Management Specialists.
* **Advance experience \& knowledge in Generation assets:** In preparation \& delivery of overhauls, develop a thorough understanding of generation asset types applicable to each station, including balance of plant areas. (Plant area knowledge training for specific asset types will be provided)
* **Contract Management \& Procurement**: Manage allocated mechanical contracts and other assigned work scopes, including procurement elements such as specification generation, tendering, evaluations \& awards.
* **Safety Compliance:** Ensure all project works comply with statutory safety, health, and environmental regulations and ESB Technical Standards \& Guidelines. Where required, carry out authorized roles under the safety rules (Safe Systems of Work), training for same \& plant area knowledge development will be provided.
* **Supervision \& Quality Assurance**: Supervise contractors' work daily, review ITP protocol sheets, and ensure work quality aligns with Project Quality Plan. Quality assurance at the work interface will be a key feature of the role.
* **Audits \& Reporting**: Conduct regular safety, environment, and quality audits; report progress against schedule; attend project meetings.
* **Outage Planning \& Execution**: Plan and supervise engineering site works for outages and overhauls on main plant mechanical equipment.
  

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**


* Proven track record of significant experience in the power generation industry. A minimum of 5 years’ relevant experience is required.
* The candidate will possess competence in design, construction, commissioning, maintenance or operation of mechanical systems in power generation or related process industry.
* Strong interpersonal skills, ability to manage stakeholders, to work and share knowledge within a team structure and to make quality decisions and judgements.
* The candidate will possess project engineering and project management skills, strong time management and prioritisation skills.
* Strong communication, report writing skills and proficient computer skills (including MS Office).
* Well versed with health, safety, construction and environment standards and procedures, including risk assessment skills.
* Full clean driving license (B car licence)
  

**Qualifications**


**Essential**


* Primary Degree in Mechanical Engineering (Level 8 NFQ) or equivalent relevant work experience.
  

**Desirable**


* Chartered Engineering status with a recognised engineering institution or demonstrable evidence of progress towards same is preferred.
* Past experience working on an electricity generating power plant.
  

**Location**


ESB Engineering and Major Projects office, The Sidings, Dublin or EMP Eastgate Cork. Due to the nature of the work most time will be spent on site for the preparation and delivery of overhaul works. Flexibility is important in this role as the role will include travel both nationally and internationally.


Smart Working at ESB is designed to make ‘in\-person’ time together as purposeful as possible while also enabling the effective use of digital tools and hybrid arrangements to preserve our commitment to flexibility. The successful candidate may work flexibly within the jurisdiction where they have been employed, with attendance at the workplace for in\-person collaboration **at least two days per week**. All Smart Working arrangements are subject to regular review based on the operational requirements of the role, the team, and the business.

  

**Reporting to**


Overhauls Team Leader \- Mechanical, Projects \& Overhauls Team, Generation Engineering Delivery.

  

**Why Work with Us?**

  

* Opportunity to lead Ireland’s transition to net zero carbon future
* Career development through mentoring and training
* Corporate Social Responsibility Opportunities
* Sports and Social Clubs
* Networking opportunities
* Credit Union
* Generous Pension

**Salary**


€59,000 \- €70,000 Per annum

14th October 2026

  

**Interview**


Candidates who are shortlisted for interview will complete a Behavioural Interview based on each of the following Behaviours, which underpin how we work at ESB and are critical to delivering our strategy:

  

* Accountable and Ethical

We’ve been transforming how we acquire, manage, and distribute travel inventory, moving from fragmented supplier integrations to a unified, scalable platform. While we’ve made great progress, there’s still plenty to optimise.


Our platform powers supplier connectivity, data acquisition, distribution, and booking workflows, ensuring fresh, high\-quality inventory with minimal latency. Built on C\# .NET and AWS, it supports a fast\-moving, high\-traffic environment.

**What you’ll be doing day to day**

* Managing a team of IC Software Engineers up to Staff level and owning up to three domains.
* Empower teams to deliver high\-quality software across the stack, from frontend to platform and data services.
* Drive delivery excellence over multiple release cycles; leverage modern delivery methodologies and team management techniques to help teams achieve their potential.
* Communicate the value of technical work to Product and Business stakeholders helping prioritise investments like refactors, rebuilds, and platform modernisation.
* Support organisational change, including team reorganisation, leadership transitions, and scaling challenges.
* Build, grow, and hire exceptional engineering talent, with a focus on speed, diversity, and quality.
* Handle performance and people processes with empathy and fairness.
* Coach, mentor, and guide career progression for engineers and emerging leaders helping people step into new roles and grow beyond senior levels!
* Foster a culture of self\-awareness, adaptability, and continuous learning articulating and flexing your leadership style as needed.
* Own the team backlog, facilitate tech and product decisions and plan delivery with support from Architects, Designers and Product Managers.

**You’ll be a great addition to our team if you have the following skills, knowledge and experience**

* Experience in engineering management roles, with a strong hands\-on technical foundation.
* Proven experience managing teams of multiple engineers as well as leading managers or tech leads.
* Track record of delivering complex full\-stack systems (web/mobile frontend, backend, data, platform).
* Skilled at balancing delivery, technical quality, and business impact able to make and communicate tough trade\-offs.
* Experience leading through change from reorganisation to leadership transitions.
* Strong communicator able to express the “why” behind technical work in terms that stakeholders value.
* Deep understanding of modern software delivery practices from DORA metrics to team health tracking and tooling.
* Experienced in hiring and building teams quickly, with strong opinions on what makes a great engineering culture.
* Demonstrated ability to coach others with examples of helping people grow into new roles or management careers.
* Self\-aware and reflective, able to articulate your leadership style and how it evolves across situations.

**What to expect from our interview process**


After a call with our Talent Acquisition Team, We will run a 3 stage interview process. Which will consist of:


Hiring Manager meet \& greet \- 30 Minutes  

Behavioural \& ways of working \- 60 Minutes  

System Design \- 60 Minutes


We want to make sure everybody has the opportunity to perform at their best. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the interview process please let the Talent Acquisition team know and they will be happy to assist.


You’ll find diverse teams at OTB, reflective of the world we live in and the customers we serve. We believe strongly that difference, not uniformity, is critical to our success. We know that better decisions happen when they are made by a range of voices, perspectives and experiences. As an equal opportunity employer, we value and welcome applications from all sections of the community.

**Ways of working**  

Our full time hours are 37\.5 per week, but we don't have rigid working hours so you can find the working pattern that's right for you and the team.


The role will be working predominantly remotely, however at the relevant time we will create a collaborative space in Dublin for you to attend as a team.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Dublin)
jobs.description:
We’re On the Beach! Since 2003, we've been rewriting the rules of how people discover, book, and experience their perfect getaway. What started as connecting people to short\-haul beach holidays has evolved into something much bigger \- premium beach destinations, long\-haul adventures, and vibrant city breaks, and that’s just the beginning of our story.


We send around two million holidaymakers on their dream breaks every year. And we're still growing.


Powered by our deep\-rooted entrepreneurial spirit, proprietary tech, curiosity and our incredible people, we’re accelerating \- delivering best in class technology, the ultimate holiday app, and experiences that keep our customers coming back for more.


Ready to build the future of travel with us?

**About the Role**


As a Senior Software Engineer (Backend), you’ll design and build scalable applications, services and platforms across On the Beach.


This is a full\-stack engineering position with a stronger emphasis on backend engineering, distributed systems and cloud\-native architecture.


Our backend engineers solve a wide variety of problems. You could be working on systems responsible for communicating with external travel suppliers, processing large volumes of hotel inventory and pricing information, powering customer search experiences, or ensuring bookings move reliably through complex transactional workflows.


You’ll work across the development lifecycle and collaborate with engineers, product managers and other technical specialists to design, build, deploy and operate reliable software at scale.

**What you’ll be doing day to day**

* Designing and building scalable backend applications and services
* Developing APIs used by customer\-facing applications and internal systems
* Integrating with external suppliers and third\-party platforms
* Building systems that process high volumes of requests and data
* Designing distributed and event\-driven architectures
* Working with asynchronous messaging and streaming technologies
* Solving problems around performance, latency, resilience and availability
* Improving caching and data\-access strategies
* Building reliable transactional workflows
* Developing applications and services within AWS
* Deploying and operating containerised applications
* Improving monitoring, alerting and observability
* Exploring AI\-assisted engineering and modern development tooling


At Senior level, you’ll be expected to understand the wider system rather than only the individual service you are working on.


You should be comfortable considering how systems behave in production, identifying failure scenarios and balancing scalability, resilience, maintainability and delivery speed.


We’re looking for strong full\-stack engineers whose experience leans towards backend and platform engineering.

**You’ll be a great addition to our team if you have the following skills, knowledge and experience**

* Strong commercial backend software engineering
* C\# and .NET or comparable experience building modern backend applications
* Designing and developing APIs
* Building distributed systems and service\-oriented architectures
* Developing cloud\-native applications, ideally within AWS
* Working with messaging, asynchronous processing or event\-driven architecture
* Designing reliable integrations with external or internal systems
* SQL and/or NoSQL data stores
* Building scalable systems handling significant traffic or data volumes
* Performance optimisation, caching and latency reduction
* Designing for resilience and failure
* Containerisation and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
* Observability, monitoring and operating production systems
* Automated testing and modern engineering practices


We don’t expect candidates to have worked with every technology in our stack. Strong engineering fundamentals and evidence of solving comparable problems at scale are more important than matching every individual tool.

**Beyond the technologies themselves, we’re looking for someone who:**

* Can independently solve complex engineering problems
* Thinks about the customer and commercial impact of technical decisions
* Understands the trade\-offs between speed, quality and long\-term maintainability
* Can contribute meaningfully to technical and architectural discussions
* Communicates clearly with both technical and non\-technical colleagues
* Raises engineering standards through collaboration rather than hierarchy
* Helps less experienced engineers develop
* Is comfortable working in an environment where priorities and problems can change quickly

**What to expect from our interview process**


After a call with our Talent Acquisition Team, We will run a 3 stage interview process. Which will consist of:  

Hiring Manager meet \& greet \- 30 Minutes  

Behavioural \& ways of working \- 60 Minutes  

Tech Pairing \& System Design \- 120 Minutes, broken down into two parts (50 minutes each) with a short break and time for your questions at the end.


We want to make sure everybody has the opportunity to perform at their best. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the interview process please let the Talent Acquisition team know and they will be happy to assist.


You’ll find diverse teams at OTB, reflective of the world we live in and the customers we serve. We believe strongly that difference, not uniformity, is critical to our success. We know that better decisions happen when they are made by a range of voices, perspectives and experiences. As an equal opportunity employer, we value and welcome applications from all sections of the community.

**Ways of working**  

Our full time hours are 37\.5 per week, but we don't have rigid working hours so you can find the working pattern that's right for you. We have core working hours between 10am \- 4pm, so we can collaborate and enjoy the social side of work.


We also have hybrid working so we all work from home and a minimum of one day every two weeks in our Dublin workspace.

jobs.description:
**Brief Summary:**  

Join a dynamic team as a Robotics Software Engineer, focusing on advanced fleet management algorithms to enhance efficiency and scalability in robotic systems. This role offers the opportunity to develop innovative solutions in a cutting\-edge environment.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

Design and develop algorithms for robotic fleet management, including task assignment, scheduling, routing, and resource allocation.

Strong background in algorithms, optimization, and operations research, including scheduling, routing, and graph\-based methods.
  
  

Proficiency in Python, C\+\+, or C\#, with experience developing scalable and maintainable software systems.
  
  

Experience developing algorithms for multi\-agent systems, path planning, robotic coordination, and task allocation.
  
  

Familiarity with real\-time systems, control theory, and optimization methods.
  
  

Strong data analysis skills, including analyzing robot telemetry, operational logs, and system performance metrics.
  
  

Experience working with robotic fleets or large\-scale logistics and automation systems, including simulation and operational experimentation.
  
  

Proven ability to translate research or algorithmic innovation into practical production systems; publications or research contributions are a plus.

**Description \-**

We are looking for a Manufacturing Test Software Engineer to join our team and help develop reliable, scalable, and high\-quality manufacturing test solutions for HP products.


In this role, you will work with product development, factory, quality, and external partners to design, implement, validate, and improve test software used in manufacturing. You will support both new product introduction and sustaining programs, helping to ensure product quality, production readiness, and factory efficiency.


This role is ideal for junior\-to\-mid level engineers who enjoy software development, test automation, problem solving, and working closely with both engineering and manufacturing teams. You will also have opportunities to work with emerging technologies such as AI, machine learning, image processing, and advanced automation to improve test coverage, strengthen defect detection, and optimize manufacturing efficiency.


Engineers with strong programming fundamentals and a keen interest in test automation, embedded systems, image processing, or AI/ML applications are also welcome to apply.


Key Responsibilities


* Develop and support manufacturing test solutions with product development and production teams to ensure product quality, performance, and manufacturability.
* Design, implement, and validate test software for new and existing products across mechanical, electrical, firmware, software, and system\-level requirements.
* Work with internal teams and external partners to support project execution, production readiness, and issue resolution.
* Support the creation, validation, and delivery of reliable, cost\-effective, and high\-quality manufacturing test packages.
* Represent the manufacturing test team in project discussions, technical reviews, and issue\-resolution forums.
* Provide training, documentation, and technical support to users within and outside HP.
* Improve test software robustness and support factory and quality teams in troubleshooting production issues.
* Analyze test failures, identify root causes, and recommend improvements to product design, test coverage, and manufacturing quality.
* Optimize test solutions to improve throughput, reduce test cycle time, and enhance factory productivity.

Knowledge and Skills


* Experience or strong interest in software development, test automation, embedded systems, firmware, image processing, AI/ML, and autonomous or agentic solutions.
* Programming knowledge in languages and tools such as Python, SQL, VB, C\#, or equivalent.
* Familiarity with data analysis, software testing methodology, test plan execution, debugging, test scripts, and automation tools.
* Interest or exposure to Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts and related frameworks will be an advantage.
* Ability to understand software, hardware, and system\-level requirements and translate them into practical test solutions.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and adapt to changing requirements.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English and local language.

Scope and Impact


* Supports product quality, manufacturing readiness, delivery timelines, and factory efficiency.

Position Summary:


The Manufacturing Systems Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, integrating, and supporting digital manufacturing solutions across MES, equipment data systems, operational applications, analytics platforms, and AI\-enabled manufacturing capabilities.


This role partners with Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Equipment Engineering, Quality, and OT teams to build and sustain data\-driven manufacturing workflows that improve operational efficiency, equipment reliability, troubleshooting effectiveness, and digital transformation initiatives
  

  

Position Responsibilities:


* Design, develop, and support digital/AI manufacturing solutions that improve operational efficiency, data visibility, and decision\-making across manufacturing operations.
* Design and support system integrations between manufacturing and equipment enterprise systems, equipment data sources and enterprise data platforms.
* Develop and optimize databases, data pipelines, APIs, and reporting solutions to ensure reliable and scalable manufacturing data flows.

* Design, develop, test, and deploy AI\-powered products, applications, and intelligent workflow solutions

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Roles \& Responsibilities
  
  

ABOUT KRISTAL.AI
  
  

Kristal.AI is a digital private bank and wealth\-tech company built for modern investing. We serve accredited investors and high\-net\-worth families across more than 50 countries, and we are regulated by the Monetary Authority of Singapore, the Securities and Futures Commission in Hong Kong, SEBI in India, and the FSRA in Abu Dhabi.
  
  

Our AI product team builds the systems our relationship managers and operations teams use every day: portfolio optimisation engines, document parsing pipelines, and AI agents that answer client and internal questions from our own knowledge base. We are a small team shipping to real users inside a regulated business.
  
  

THE ROLE
  
  

We are hiring an AI Engineer to build and ship production AI applications for our wealth management platform. You will work on large language model applications, retrieval systems, and AI agents that are used by our relationship managers, operations teams, and clients.
  
  

This is a hands\-on building role. You will own features end to end, from scoping the problem with the business team through to running the system in production. You will report to the AI Product Lead and work alongside our data scientists and engineers.
  
  

WHAT YOU WILL DO
  
  

* Build and ship production applications powered by large language models, including retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems over our internal documents, policies, and client communications.
* Design and build AI agent workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain, including tool calling, multi\-step orchestration, and memory.
* Build evaluation harnesses and test sets for AI features, and use them to measure quality before and after every change. We treat evaluation as a first\-class part of the work, not an afterthought.
* Write backend services and APIs in Python to support AI workloads, and integrate with our internal platforms and third\-party systems.
* Work directly with operations and relationship management teams to scope problems, agree what “good” looks like, and deliver solutions that remove real manual effort.
* Monitor accuracy, latency, and cost in production, and improve them over time.
* Apply our controls for data privacy, auditability, and regulatory compliance to every AI feature you build.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
  
  

* A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.
* At least 1 year of hands\-on experience building software or AI applications. This can include internships, contract work, or substantial project work.
* Strong Python. You can write code that other people can read, test, and run in production.
* Practical experience building applications with large language models. You understand prompting, retrieval, embeddings, and where these systems fail.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
* The ability to take an unclear problem, break it down, and come back with a working result. Much of our work starts as a rough business need, not a written spec.
* Clear written and spoken English. You will work directly with non\-technical colleagues.
* A genuine interest in finance, investing, or wealth management. You do not need prior finance experience, but you should want to learn the domain.


GOOD TO HAVE
  
  

* Experience building evaluation or testing frameworks for AI systems (for example RAGAS or similar).
* Experience with vector databases and retrieval pipelines.
* Experience with cloud platforms, particularly Google Cloud Platform.
* Exposure to financial services, fintech, or another regulated industry.
* Experience with data analysis and visualisation.


WHAT WE OFFER
  
  

* Ownership of AI features that go into production and are used by real teams, not proof\-of\-concept work that is shelved.
* A small team where your work is visible and your decisions matter.
* Direct exposure to the wealth management business and to senior stakeholders.
* Structured mentorship from the AI Product Lead, and a clear growth path in AI engineering or AI product.
* Competitive salary, performance bonus, and standard benefits.


We are an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants on merit, regardless of age, race, religion, gender, marital status, family responsibility, or disability.

Every day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.  

**Responsibilities**  

**As a Software Engineering Intern,** you will:* Apply software engineering principles and creative problem\-solving to real technical challenges.
* Partner with engineers and other stakeholders to understand requirements and help turn ideas into working software.
* Design, write, review, test, and debug maintainable code.
* Learn new engineering technologies, methods, and tools and apply them to your project.
* Seek feedback and use engineering best practices to continuously improve your solutions.
* Work collaboratively while owning your deliverables and managing your project effectively.
* Explore opportunities to improve the availability, reliability, efficiency, observability, performance, and security of the systems you work on.
* Learn how modern engineering teams use AI and automation to improve how software is designed, built, tested, and operated.

  

**Qualifications**  

### **✅** **Required Qualifications**

* Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related technical field with least one semester or academic term remaining after completing the internship.
* Programming experience in at least one language such as C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Python, or another object\-oriented programming language.
* Strong foundation in computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles.
* You must be legally authorized to work in Romania to be eligible for this role. (Legally authorized \= has citizenship or has been granted a valid visa or work permit).
* You communicate confidently in English, written and spoken — you'll work every day with teammates across Romania and around the world.
* **Preferred Qualifications**


We're particularly interested in students who bring one or more of the following:* Exposure to cloud computing, distributed systems, operating systems, networking, virtualization, or storage through coursework, research, personal projects, hackathons, open source, or previous internships.
* Experience building software projects individually or as part of a team.
* Exposure to AI/ML or AI\-assisted software development, whether through projects, coursework, APIs, models, or developer tools.
* Curiosity, strong problem\-solving skills, a growth mindset, and enthusiasm for learning how complex systems work.


You don't need to know everything before joining us. We're looking for people with strong fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn.  

  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

**Responsibilities**

* Build and scale robust Cloud and on\-premises environments tailored for complex migration initiatives
