**CIVIL SITE ENGINEER / WORKS SUPERVISOR**


**EGNATIA BULGARIA LTD \| Projects Across Bulgaria**


**www.group\-egnatia.bg**


**Where Engineering Meets Execution.**


**Delivering Projects. Building Careers.**


Egnatia Bulgaria, part of the Egnatia Group, is an international EPC contractor providing Engineering, Procurement, Construction (EPC) and Operation \& Maintenance (O\&M) services across the energy, infrastructure, telecommunications, industrial, commercial and residential sectors.


With more than 25 years of presence in Southeast Europe, we deliver technically demanding projects with a strong focus on quality, safety, reliability and engineering excellence.


As part of our continued growth, we are looking for Civil Site Engineers / Works Supervisors to join our project teams throughout Bulgaria.


The position is suitable both for engineers who already have site supervision experience and for motivated professionals who want to further develop their career in construction and project execution within an international EPC environment.


**The Role**


You will be responsible for the on\-site supervision and coordination of civil works across a variety of Egnatia Bulgaria projects, including energy and renewable energy projects, infrastructure, industrial facilities, buildings and commercial or residential fit\-outs.


**Key Responsibilities**


* On\-site supervision of civil construction activities.
* Supervision of earthworks, excavations, grading and site preparation.
* Supervision of concrete works, foundations and structural works.
* Supervision of roads, drainage systems, fencing and associated infrastructure works.
* Supervision of civil and architectural works in building and fit\-out projects, where applicable.
* Coordination and daily follow\-up of subcontractors, site crews and suppliers.
* Verification that works are executed according to drawings, technical specifications and project requirements.
* Monitoring of quantities, productivity, quality and construction progress.
* Identification and reporting of technical or site\-related issues.
* Coordination with Project Managers, engineers, designers and other project disciplines.
* Monitoring compliance with site HSE and quality requirements.
* Preparation of daily/weekly progress updates, site records, photographic documentation and technical reports.


**Requirements**


* Degree in Civil Engineering or another relevant technical discipline.
* Previous construction/site experience will be considered an advantage; the level of responsibility will be adapted to the candidate’s experience.
* Good command of English, written and spoken, is required.
* Knowledge of Bulgarian will be considered a strong asset.
* Ability to read and understand technical drawings and specifications.
* Good organisational, communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary project team.
* Willingness to work on and travel between project sites throughout Bulgaria.
* Valid Category B driving licence.


**What We Offer**


* Net monthly salary: **€1,500–€2,500**, depending on experience, qualifications and level of responsibility.
* Accommodation provided in the vicinity the projects
* Company vehicle according to the requirements of the position.
* Laptop and mobile phone.
* Access to modern site supervision and engineering tools, including surveying GPS equipment, drones and digital reporting tools.
* Continuous training and hands\-on technical development.
* Strong engineering and technical support from experienced project teams.
* Exposure to different types and scales of EPC projects.
* Opportunities for increased responsibility and long\-term career development within the Egnatia Group.


**Location**


The position is based on project sites throughout **Bulgaria.** Accommodation and transportation support are provided according to project requirements.


**Join Our Team**


If you are interested in developing your career through hands\-on involvement in challenging engineering and construction projects, we would like to hear from you.

  

**ΕΠΙΒΛΕΠΩΝ ΜΗΧΑΝΙΚΟΣ ΕΡΓΟΤΑΞΙΟΥ – ΠΟΛΙΤΙΚΟΣ ΜΗΧΑΝΙΚΟΣ (CIVIL SITE ENGINEER)**


**EGNATIA BULGARIA LTD \| Έργα σε όλη τη Βουλγαρία**


**Where Engineering Meets Execution.**


**Delivering Projects. Building Careers.**


Η **Egnatia Bulgaria**, μέλος του **Egnatia Group**, είναι διεθνής **EPC Contractor**, παρέχοντας ολοκληρωμένες υπηρεσίες Engineering, Procurement \& Construction (EPC) καθώς και Operation \& Maintenance (O\&M) στους τομείς της ενέργειας, των υποδομών, των τηλεπικοινωνιών, των βιομηχανικών, εμπορικών και οικιστικών έργων.


Με περισσότερα από 25 χρόνια παρουσίας στη Νοτιοανατολική Ευρώπη, υλοποιούμε τεχνικά απαιτητικά έργα με ιδιαίτερη έμφαση στην ποιότητα, την ασφάλεια, την αξιοπιστία και την τεχνική αρτιότητα.


Στο πλαίσιο της συνεχούς ανάπτυξής μας, αναζητούμε Πολιτικούς Μηχανικούς για επίβλεψη εργασιών εργοταξίου (Civil Site Engineers / Works Supervisors), οι οποίοι θα ενταχθούν στις ομάδες έργων μας σε όλη τη Βουλγαρία.


Η θέση απευθύνεται τόσο σε μηχανικούς με εμπειρία στην επίβλεψη εργοταξιακών εργασιών όσο και σε μηχανικούς με μικρότερη εμπειρία, οι οποίοι επιθυμούν να εξελιχθούν επαγγελματικά στον τομέα των κατασκευών και της υλοποίησης έργων σε ένα διεθνές EPC περιβάλλον.


**Ο Ρόλος**


Ο/Η μηχανικός θα είναι υπεύθυνος/η για την επιτόπου επίβλεψη και τον συντονισμό εργασιών πολιτικού μηχανικού σε διαφορετικούς τύπους έργων της Egnatia Bulgaria, όπως έργα ενέργειας και Ανανεώσιμων Πηγών Ενέργειας, υποδομών, βιομηχανικών εγκαταστάσεων, κτιριακών έργων καθώς και εμπορικών και οικιστικών fit\-out projects.


**Κύριες Αρμοδιότητες**


* Επιτόπου επίβλεψη εργασιών πολιτικού μηχανικού.
* Επίβλεψη χωματουργικών εργασιών, εκσκαφών, διαμορφώσεων και προετοιμασίας εργοταξίου.
* Επίβλεψη εργασιών σκυροδέματος, θεμελιώσεων και δομικών κατασκευών.
* Επίβλεψη οδοποιίας, αποστραγγιστικών έργων, περιφράξεων και συναφών έργων υποδομής.
* Επίβλεψη οικοδομικών και αρχιτεκτονικών εργασιών σε κτιριακά και fit\-out έργα, όπου απαιτείται.
* Συντονισμός και καθημερινή παρακολούθηση υπεργολάβων, συνεργείων και προμηθευτών.
* Έλεγχος της εκτέλεσης των εργασιών σύμφωνα με τα σχέδια, τις τεχνικές προδιαγραφές και τις απαιτήσεις του έργου.
* Παρακολούθηση ποσοτήτων, παραγωγικότητας, ποιότητας και προόδου των εργασιών.
* Εντοπισμός και αναφορά τεχνικών θεμάτων ή προβλημάτων του εργοταξίου.
* Συνεργασία και συντονισμός με Project Managers, μηχανικούς, μελετητές και τις υπόλοιπες ειδικότητες του έργου.
* Παρακολούθηση της συμμόρφωσης με τις απαιτήσεις Υγείας \& Ασφάλειας (HSE) και Ποιότητας.
* Προετοιμασία ημερήσιων και εβδομαδιαίων αναφορών προόδου, αρχείων εργοταξίου, φωτογραφικής τεκμηρίωσης και τεχνικών reports.


**Απαραίτητα Προσόντα**


* Πτυχίο Πολιτικού Μηχανικού ή συναφούς τεχνικής ειδικότητας.
* Προηγούμενη εμπειρία σε κατασκευαστικά έργα ή/και εργοτάξιο θα θεωρηθεί επιπλέον προσόν. Το επίπεδο ευθύνης της θέσης θα προσαρμόζεται ανάλογα με την εμπειρία του υποψηφίου.
* Απαραίτητη η καλή γνώση Αγγλικών, σε γραπτό και προφορικό επίπεδο.
* Η γνώση Βουλγαρικών θα θεωρηθεί σημαντικό πρόσθετο προσόν.
* Ικανότητα ανάγνωσης και κατανόησης τεχνικών σχεδίων και προδιαγραφών.
* Καλές οργανωτικές, επικοινωνιακές και πρακτικές δεξιότητες επίλυσης προβλημάτων.
* Ικανότητα αποτελεσματικής συνεργασίας στο πλαίσιο διεπιστημονικής ομάδας έργου.
* Δυνατότητα εργασίας και μετακίνησης μεταξύ εργοταξίων σε όλη τη Βουλγαρία.
* Άδεια οδήγησης κατηγορίας Β.


**Τι Προσφέρουμε**


* Καθαρές μηνιαίες αποδοχές **€1\.500–€2\.500**, ανάλογα με την εμπειρία, τα προσόντα και το επίπεδο ευθύνης.
* Παροχή διαμονής στην ευρύτερη περιοχή του εκάστοτε έργου.
* Εταιρικό όχημα, ανάλογα με τις απαιτήσεις της θέσης.
* Laptop και κινητό τηλέφωνο.
* Πρόσβαση σε σύγχρονο εξοπλισμό και τεχνολογίες επίβλεψης έργων, όπως τοπογραφικά GPS, drones και ψηφιακά εργαλεία reporting.
* Συνεχής εκπαίδευση και πρακτική τεχνική εξέλιξη.
* Ισχυρή τεχνική και μηχανολογική υποστήριξη από έμπειρες ομάδες έργων.
* Συμμετοχή σε διαφορετικού τύπου και κλίμακας EPC projects.
* Δυνατότητα ανάληψης αυξημένων αρμοδιοτήτων και μακροχρόνιας επαγγελματικής εξέλιξης εντός του Egnatia Group.


**Τόπος Εργασίας**


Η θέση αφορά εργοτάξια σε όλη τη **Βουλγαρία**. Παρέχεται διαμονή και υποστήριξη μετακίνησης ανάλογα με τις απαιτήσεις και την τοποθεσία του εκάστοτε έργου.


**Join Our Team**


Εάν επιθυμείτε να εξελίξετε την επαγγελματική σας πορεία μέσα από ενεργή συμμετοχή σε απαιτητικά τεχνικά και κατασκευαστικά έργα, θα χαρούμε να σας γνωρίσουμε.


Σας ευχαριστούμε για τον χρόνο σας


#### **Σχετικές Ετικέτες**

jobs.title: BACKEND ENGINEER - SPORTS BETTING (LIEGE - BELGIUM)
jobs.description:
**THE SCOPE**


With 30 years of history, today **Gaming1** is one of the **international leaders in both land\-based and online games of chance** (casino games, sports betting and poker). Its evolution at the heart of innovation is accompanied by a diversification and specialization of positions, with the creation of new cutting\-edge jobs.


\#LI\-DNI
As part of its sustained growth, Gaming1 is looking for a **Backend Engineer** to join its **Sports Betting Area.**

  

  

A **Backend Engineer** at Gaming1 maximizes customer and business value through high\-quality, user\-centric product experiences.

  

  

Engineers operate within small, autonomous product engineering teams in a high\-traffic, regulated environment, where decisions directly impact platform stability, customer trust, compliance, and time\-to\-market. This role sits within our Sports Betting team, where traffic surges around live sporting events and where compliance means jurisdiction\-specific rules such as licensing and responsible\-gambling requirements.

  

  

Because teams are intentionally small and product\-oriented, Engineers are expected to be wide in their skillset, flexible in scope, and comfortable collaborating across disciplines. Backend work is not always isolated from product, operational, or cross\-team concerns — success comes from end\-to\-end ownership and shared accountability, not role silos.

  

  

This role is part of a broader Product Engineering culture focused on autonomy, short feedback loops, experimentation, and continuous improvement.  



  

**YOUR ROLE**

  

  

As a **Backend Engineer**, your mission is to design, build, and evolve backend solutions that power customer experiences and business capabilities in a reliable and sustainable way.

  

  

You do this by:


* Owning solutions across their lifecycle — from design and implementation to release, monitoring, and iterative improvement.
* Collaborating closely with Product Managers, Frontend Engineers, and other stakeholders.
* Applying strong backend craftsmanship while keeping product impact, reliability, and compliance front of mind — including through the traffic peaks that come with live sporting events.
* Continuously improving systems, practices, tooling, and ways of working.
* Your autonomy, scope, and influence are driven by your career ladder level, not by the job title alone.
  

  

**YOUR PROFILE**

  

  

What you bring

  

  

* Experience as a Backend Engineer in product\-oriented environments, ideally at scale and/or in regulated contexts
* Strong backend fundamentals: API design, data modeling, testing, performance, resilience and operability
* Experience building backend services with a statically\-typed language and framework (e.g. C\#/.NET, Java, Kotlin, Go), including event\-driven architectures
* Ability to own solutions end\-to\-end, from design to production and continuous improvement
* Product\-minded, collaborative, and comfortable working in small, autonomous, cross\-functional teams
* Strong sense of ownership, pragmatism, and continuous learning mindset
* Experience working with relational databases (RDBMS), SQL, and ORMs
  

  

Nice to have

  

  

* Hands\-on experience specifically with .NET (C\#) and messaging brokers and frameworks such as RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, or NServiceBus
* Specific experience with PostgreSQL
* Experience containerizing services and deploying them through CI/CD pipelines to Kubernetes (we use GitLab CI/CD and Octopus Deploy)
* Experience with real\-time or high\-concurrency systems (e.g. live odds, in\-play betting, event\-driven traffic spikes), or an interest in the sports betting / iGaming domain

Comfortable owning the observability of what you build — instrumenting, alerting, and monitoring your services in production (we use Datadog)  

* 
**WHAT WE OFFER**


As well as **enjoying a unique experience** – centered around our values of Pleasure, Team Spirit, Performance, Boldness and Integrity – alongside 1\.600 colleagues worldwide, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to the international development of a fast\-growing family company.


Joining Gaming1 means becoming part of a human and entrepreneurial adventure where people are empowered to make an impact, grow and succeed together.


We offer:


* the opportunity to work on ambitious international projects within a **solid and growing group**
* a collaborative and **high\-performing work environment**
* leadership based on **trust**, **autonomy**, **talent** and **shared values**
* continuous **learning and career development** opportunities through training and **internal mobility**
* a **competitive salary and benefits package** aligned with the local market
* a hybrid working model, with the **possibility to work remotely up to 50%** of your working time
* an **international and collaborative environment** where people come first

**THE INTERVIEW PROCESS**

**Education required:** Master of Science/MSc — Engineering: Automation, Robotics, Controls \& Systems, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Computer or Systems Engineering, Manufacturing or Industrial Engineering, Robotics Technology Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Biomedical or related field with modules in automation, robotics, systems, software and/or cybersecurity.  

  



**Language requirement:** Written and spoken fluency in French and English


**Other requirements:** Graduation by August 2027


**Location:** Belgium \- Wavre


**Start date:** September 2027
  

  

**Application information:**  



**Application deadline:** Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and this role will close once we have received enough applications. We recommend you apply as soon as possible.


**Assessment Centre Date:** December 2026 \- February 2027

  

  

See what our graduate programme participants have to say about their experiences in our GSK Graduate Programmes https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=\-ybQQr9HKg8 !

  

  

**Are you a talented, driven student or graduate eager to make an impact on billions of lives? Join the Engineering Multidiscipline Graduate programme at GSK and get ahead with tailored training and career development designed to help you grow.**

  

We manufacture and supply reliable, high\-quality medicines and vaccines to meet patients’ needs and drive our performance.
  

Our network of 33 medicines and vaccines manufacturing sites delivered 1\.64 billion packs of medicines and 389 million vaccine doses in 2025 to help make a positive impact on the health of millions of people. Our supply chain is not just core to our operations; it’s vital to bringing our innovations to patients as quickly, efficiently and effectively as possible. Technology is transforming how we manufacture medicines and vaccines, enabling us to increase the speed, quality and scale of product supply.
  

We welcome people with diverse perspectives and the skills or potential to help us on our journey to make more complex products, harnessing the power of smart manufacturing technologies including robotics, digital solutions and artificial intelligence to deliver for patients.


Start your career by helping deliver medicines and vaccines to patients around the world.
  

On our two\-year Global Supply Chain Graduate Programme, you’ll apply your scientific, engineering or digital knowledge to real manufacturing challenges while developing through rotations, training and mentoring.  



  

**What You’ll Experience:**

  

**Cross\-Functional Exposure** : Spend time at your home site, working on cross\-functional projects and rotations to deepen your expertise and knowledge of the business.


**Kaizen Assignment:** A short\-term breadth assignment, which could include global\-focused opportunities, to expand your skills and experience beyond your home site.


**Tailored Training** : Benefit from role\-specific training and development, supported by a generous training budget and access to enriching resources.


**Professional \& Personal Growth:** Develop in a supportive environment with clear goals, feedback, training and access to reasonable adjustments. You’ll also develop technical expertise through valuable on\-the\-job experience.

  

  

**Key Programme Features:**
  

  

**Digital Data \& Analytics (DDA) Objective:** Each rotation has a DDA focus, reflecting GSK’s commitment to innovation and continuous improvement, helping you to advance pharmaceutical manufacturing processes.
  

**Sustainability Element:** Contribute to GSK’s Net Carbon Zero mission by working on impactful projects that promote environmental sustainability.
  

**Mentoring \& Networking:** Build your professional network and enhance visibility through direct access to senior leaders and mentors who will guide and support your career development
  

  

Join GSK’s GSC Graduate Programme and take the first step toward a rewarding career, where your work makes a difference to patients at the end of our supply chain.

  

  

**What will you do?**  



* **Engineering Excellence:** Design, execute, and validate engineering projects while adhering to industry\-leading standards and regulations.
* **Project Management:** Manage the lifecycle of new equipment, from design to installation and commissioning, ensuring seamless integration into operations, working with suppliers.
* **Equipment Reliability:** Enhance the performance, safety, and reliability of manufacturing equipment \& utilities through predictive maintenance and lifecycle management.
* **Smart Manufacturing Innovation:** Drive efficiency and innovation using AI and digital transformation technologies as part of our digital transformation journey.
* **Automation Expertise:** Define and implement improvements, upgrade systems, and work with control systems and robotics technologies to optimize manufacturing operations.
* **Digital \& Data Expertise:** Use data\-driven approaches \& data visualization techniques to monitor processes, identify trends, and implement solutions to improve decision making \& operational efficiencies.
* **Asset Management:** Utilize techniques e.g. condition\-based monitoring and predictive maintenance, for optimal equipment performance.
* **Problem\-Solving:** Develop analytical and advanced problem\-solving skills (e.g., DMAIC/Six Sigma) to tackle complex challenges to improve processes and drive cross functional collaboration.
* **Sustainability Initiatives:** Contribute to energy management and sustainability projects, supporting GSK’s Net Carbon Zero mission.
  

  

**What skills are we looking for?**  



* **Technical Aptitude:** Interest in engineering and pharmaceutical manufacturing, and willingness to learn how the work supports patients.
* **Continuous Improvement Mindset:** A focus on growth, innovation, and process optimization, using data to make decisions.
* **Communication and Collaboration:** Explains information clearly, listens to others and adapts communication for the audience.
* **Ownership and Support:** Takes ownership of agreed tasks, asks questions and seeks support when needed.
* **Attention to Detail:** Works accurately using agreed checks and applies structured problem\-solving methods.
* **Adaptability:** Responds constructively when priorities change and seeks support or clarification when needed.
* **Priority Management:** Able to manage changing priorities, with clear goals, appropriate support and agreed deadlines.

  

**What do we offer you?**

* A competitive salary
* An annual bonus based on company performance
* Employee recognition programmes, which reward exceptional achievements
* Access to robust healthcare and well\-being programmes
* A tailored, robust development plan aligned to your career aspirations and business needs, delivered by coaching and mentoring by managers and peers, and through virtual and in person courses

On\-the\-job experience

jobs.title: Azure DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Jobomschrijving:
**Azure DevOps Engineer**
**CONTEXT**
=====================================


AXA Belgium wil het team **Relationship and Contact Management** versterken met een **Azure DevOps Engineer**.


De digitale wereld is een sterk groeiende markt en AXA wil haar klantgerichte front\-end\- en mobiele applicaties voortdurend verbeteren via robuuste, kostenefficiënte, gestandaardiseerde en geautomatiseerde platformen die een snelle ondersteuning van de business mogelijk maken.


Binnen specifieke domeinen van de onderneming levert het Relationship and Contact Management\-team dagelijks diensten op gedistribueerde infrastructuuroplossingen binnen de ondersteunde technologieën (Azure, .NET, MSSQL, IIS, Microsoft Dynamics 365, enz.), volgens de ITIL\-methodologie en binnen een Agile werkomgeving.


Ervaring met **Microsoft Dynamics 365**, **Dataverse** en het automatiseren van hun levenscyclus via **Azure DevOps** is een belangrijke troef, met name voor het beheer van omgevingen, deployments, integraties, beveiliging en monitoring.


Dankzij een sterk helikopterzicht op complexe situaties past onze toekomstige Azure DevOps Engineer deze oplossingen toe in lijn met de AXA\-strategie, de lokale standaardarchitectuur, de operationele richtlijnen en de SLA's die met de business werden overeengekomen op het vlak van productiviteit, kwaliteit en dienstverlening.

**FUNCTIEBESCHRIJVING**
-----------------------


Als **Senior DevOps Engineer** draag je bij aan de volgende activiteiten:

* Je werkt voornamelijk als **Ops Engineer**, met verantwoordelijkheden inzake automatiseringsscripting en development.
* Je werkt nauw samen met diverse stakeholders (developers, testers, cross\-department SPOC's, offshore teams, enz.).
* Je bent verantwoordelijk voor Application Lifecycle Management, problem management en release management, conform de beveiligingsrichtlijnen van AXA.
* Je neemt ook een **FinOps**\-rol op en bent in staat de kosten van een implementatie te evalueren vóór deze wordt uitgerold.
* Je ondersteunt je team en onderhoudt rechtstreeks contact met verschillende stakeholders.
* Je beheert incidenten, begrijpt de end\-to\-end processen en analyseert stack traces.
* Je staat in voor de dagelijkse **Business\-as\-Usual** activiteiten binnen jouw expertisegebied.
* Je implementeert **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** end\-to\-end.

**JOUW PROFIEL**
----------------

* Je beschikt over een bacheloropleiding in IT of een gelijkwaardige richting.
* Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie en technische omgeving.
* Je bent oplossingsgericht en beschikt over sterke analytische vaardigheden waarmee je snel de juiste oplossingsrichting kunt bepalen.
* Je leert snel, toont leiderschap en kunt zelfstandig werken met een innovatieve en creatieve mindset.
* Je beschikt over een goede kennis van het Engels.

**TECHNISCHE VAARDIGHEDEN**
---------------------------

* .NET\-serverbeheer (IIS / Windows Server)
* Azure\-beheer (IAM / .NET\-gebaseerde applicaties / networking)
* Azure DevOps (Git, CI/CD\-pipelines, IaC/YAML, rechtenbeheer)
* Azure API Management (APIM)
* Azure Data Factory
* Azure ARM Templates
* Azure Cost Management
* PowerShell en de verschillende Azure\-libraries
* Serverbesturingssystemen (Linux en Windows)
* Webserviceconcepten (SOAP, REST, API Management)
* Webservers (IIS, HAProxy, Reverse Proxy)
* Dataintegraties (MSSQL)
* Beveiligingsconcepten (SSL, certificaten, security gateways, hardening van resources)
* Monitoringtools (Dynatrace, Application Insights)
* Netwerkconcepten (LAN, TCP/IP, load balancing, firewallbeheer)
* Troubleshooting\- en debuggingtools (OpenSSL, Postman, netwerktrace\-analyse, Kudu, Dev Tools, enz.)
* Kennis van het SDLC\-proces en de SDA\-tools die binnen AXA worden gebruikt vormt een belangrijke meerwaarde (Octopus).

### **Gewenste Azure\-certificeringen**

* AZ\-900 \- Microsoft Azure Fundamentals
* AZ\-204 \- Developing Solutions for Microsoft Azure

**FUNCTIONELE EN OPERATIONELE VAARDIGHEDEN**
--------------------------------------------

* Kennis van Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dataverse en hun architectuur.
* Beheer van omgevingen en deployments tussen Development\-, Test\- en Productieomgevingen.
* Automatisering van de solution lifecycle via Azure DevOps en CI/CD\-processen.
* Integraties met Azure, API Management, SQL en andere systemen.
* Beheer van toegangsrechten, service accounts, certificaten en secrets.
* Monitoring, incidentanalyse en dependency analysis.
* Samenwerking met functionele CRM\-teams en Dynamics 365 Developers.
 *AXA wil een weerspiegeling zijn van de diverse samenleving waarin wij leven en voert daarom al jaren een beleid van actieve diversiteit, non\-discriminatie en gelijke kansen. In dit kader garanderen wij een gelijke behandeling en toegang tot selecties, ongeacht leeftijd, afkomst, culturele achtergrond, handicap, geslacht of seksuele geaardheid of andere kenmerken*. *Bij AXA wijzen wij alle vormen van oneerlijke of onwettige discriminatie af.* **AXA Belgium**  

Meer dan 3000 mensen werken bij ons, vanuit onze vooruitstrevende kantoren in Brussel, Antwerpen, Eupen en Luik. We werken samen met 3200 makelaars. We hebben 3 miljoen klanten en zijn nummer 1 in autoverzekeringen. Het is onze ambitie om onze relatie met al onze klanten te transformeren van betaler naar partner om ons echt te onderscheiden. **Onze fundamenten**

**Our Mission: Why Lighthouse?**


At Lighthouse, we’re on a mission to revolutionize commercial strategy as hospitality’s most powerful AI platform. We take the world's largest hotel data network and transform it into real\-time intelligence that drives action. We don't just deliver insights; we empower businesses to make decisions that move revenue.


With $370M in Series C funding and over $100M in ARR, we are scaling at lightspeed. Our 850\+ teammates across 35 countries aren't just building software—they are leveraging cutting\-edge AI to help hoteliers be the first to act. Tens of thousands of hotels across 185 countries trust Lighthouse to execute their commercial strategy, including every one of the top 15 global chains and thousands of independent hotels that consistently outperform their markets. With Lighthouse AI, the intelligence gets deeper. Decisions get smarter. Actions get faster. We help hoteliers be first to act.


**Lighthouse Values: Our guiding light**


We are **Lumineers**. Our shared values keep us on a collaborative path fostering a cultural and customer centric environment


* **Pursuit of greatness**: We’re innovators who care deeply about our customers’ success. Our team brings their best work, stays curious, and delivers excellence through attention to detail
* **Meaningful work matters**: We make every moment count by knowing what to deliver, why it matters, and how it drives Lighthouse forward
* **Elevate each other**: We don’t just work together \- we grow together. What unites us is understanding each other as people and working toward shared goals

We’re more than just a workplace – we’re a community. Collaborative, fun, and deeply committed, we work hard together to revolutionize the hospitality sector. Are you ready to join us and shine brighter in the industry’s most exciting rocket\-ship?


**Job Details**


* Engineering
* Belgium \- Ghent
* Full\-Time/Hybrid

**What you will do**


You'll join our Crawler Engineering team as a Backend Engineer focused on data acquisition. This is a building role: you'll design and develop high\-performance systems, mostly in Rust, that collect billions of data points from the web. The work sits where backend engineering meets how the web works: HTTP stacks, proxies and browser tooling. When a data source blocks an approach, you'll dig into what's happening on the wire and find another way forward. You'll also help make our infrastructure "agent\-friendly", so other teams can safely build on it with AI.


**Where you will have impact**
------------------------------


* Design, build and improve backend systems for data acquisition that handle close to 200 million requests a day.
* Work on our in\-house proxy layer and browser tooling: request routing, connection handling and protocol\-level behaviour.
* Investigate hard crawler problems, test alternative approaches when one gets blocked, and turn what works into robust, reusable systems.
* Build clear interfaces and guardrails so other teams and AI agents can use what you build reliably.
* Own the quality of your code, including code written with AI assistance: tests, observability and maintainability.
* Work closely with crawler engineers, DevOps and Security to ship solutions that are secure and scalable.

**About our team**
------------------


The Crawler engineering team makes sure Lighthouse customers get fresh, high\-quality rates, ranking and supply data. We handle close to 200 million requests a day across 200\+ data sources, so the team carries a big responsibility for keeping our crawling infrastructure reliable, efficient and ahead of a web that keeps changing.

* Net allowance: to support home office related expenses.
* Vouchers: lunch vouchers \& eco vouchers.
* Comprehensive health insurance: Extensive coverage for you and your dependents.
* Pension funding: Group insurance to secure your future.
* Referral bonuses: Earn rewards for bringing in new talent.

**Who you are**


* You have hands on experience building, deploying and running production backend services in a cloud environment.
* You're experienced with a systems language such as **Rust** or **C/C\+\+**, or you have a strong track record in another backend language and a real drive to go deep in Rust.
* You have a solid grasp of how the web works under the hood: HTTP, TCP/IP, TLS and proxies.
* You have an **R\&D mindset**. You're curious about how browsers and network stacks work internally, you're comfortable with ambiguity, and you'd rather prove a hypothesis than assume it.
* You have strong analytical and debugging skills. You're comfortable with packet captures, profilers and reading other people's source code.
* You communicate clearly, share your opinions, welcome feedback and work well in a team.
* You're fluent in English.

**Technologies you will work with**


Rust, TypeScript/Node.js, Python, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana, Claude Code.


**Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging**


Thank you for considering a career with Lighthouse. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that values equal opportunity for all. jobs.description:
Job Description
**Your role**
-------------

We are looking for a passionate and committed Senior Backend .NET Developer.  



You will be part of our internal software development team working in the Aftermarket domain. This surrounds applications for providing technical support, processing warranty, tools for our Field Service Engineer, our back office (planning and order processing), spare part list applications and Serialized Information Management.  



As such you will be responsible for technical application ownership and developments. Next to this you will be involved in the full redesign of our existing applications and creation of new applications as business needs arise in our Customer Centers.  



You will have the opportunity to work with a highly motivated international business and software developer team in a challenging and very dynamic environment.  



You build the back\-end behind our operational applications, not the screens in front of it. Your initial focus is the system that links as\-built documentation, bills of material and product definitions to serialized equipment and the installed base which is used by internal teams, by Customer Centers and by dealers, with a growing number of applications depending on its APIs. From there you work across the rest of our backend landscape: warranty automation and order evaluation, engineering change bulletins, maintenance engines and the shared services the whole portfolio runs on.  



Your working level is domain models, APIs, events and data: what a service owns, what its contract promises, which events it publishes, and how its data is shaped so that it still answers the questions we will ask of it in three years. You work in an agile team with developers, architects and a product owner, shaping design decisions rather than only implementing them.  



The work here is engineering, not configuration. We build on C\# and .NET (8 or later) on Azure: Function Apps and App Services for compute, Kafka and Azure Service Bus for the event streams that feed us, and a deliberately mixed data layer SQL for the queryable subset, a graph store for the relationships between equipment, components and product definitions. Services run behind private endpoints with managed identity and RBAC, ship through Azure DevOps pipelines with infrastructure as code, and are instrumented with Application Insights.


**To succeed, you will need**
-----------------------------

You have built back\-end systems that other teams and other applications depend on, ideally in an operational or business\-critical context where downtime is measured in stopped work rather than a slow page. You think in trade\-offs rather than absolutes, and you keep digging until you know why something failed, not just that it did. You work comfortably in an agile team, have the confidence to say in refinement that something cannot be built the way it is specified, and use AI tooling with the judgement to verify what it produces. This is a senior role: we expect you to own a domain end to end and make decisions the rest of the team builds on.  



You will not have every item on the list below. Cover most of the must\-haves and be genuinely curious about the rest.  



**Must\-have**

* **C\# / .NET (8 or later, moving to .NET 10\):** recent, hands\-on experience building production\-grade applications, not prototypes, at a level where you own a service end to end.
* **Azure:** practical experience with several of: Function Apps, App Services, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Blob Storage, Azure SQL, Key Vault, API Management, Application Insights.
* **REST API design and implementation:** designing and consuming well\-structured, versioned APIs, and thinking about the contract before the code.
* **SQL databases:** data modelling, query performance, and integrating relational data into cloud applications.
* **Testing as part of development:** unit and integration testing as a habit, not a separate phase handed to someone else.
* **Experience migrating .NET Framework systems to modern .NET and retiring what they replaced.**

**Strong plus**

* **Apache Kafka:** consuming event streams from systems you do not control, and living with what they send you.
* **Graph databases:** Neo4j or equivalent, and the modelling instinct for when a relationship belongs in a graph rather than a join table.
* **Secure\-by\-default cloud development:** managed identity, private endpoints, RBAC and secret management as normal practice.
* **Observability:** structured logging, tracing, alerting, and being on the hook for a system you built.
* **Domain\-driven design:** bounded contexts and aggregates applied to a real domain rather than a textbook one.
* **Microservice architecture:** service boundaries, inter\-service contracts, and the operational cost of getting them wrong.
* **Event\-driven and message\-based architecture:** queues, topics, event streams, and the practical problems that come with them: ordering, idempotency, at\-least\-once delivery, replay, poison messages.
* **CI/CD with Azure DevOps:** YAML pipelines, release management, and infrastructure as code (Bicep, Terraform or ARM).
**In return, we offer**
-----------------------

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees' development and well\-being, and we provide a flexible work\-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow. Here, your ideas are embraced, and you never stop learning.  



You will have a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. You will also have access to global job opportunities, as part of the Atlas Copco Group. We offer an interesting compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave and retirement benefits.


**Job location**
----------------

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on\-site at Airpower in Antwerp, Belgium (BE).

Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we are uniting curious minds, and you could be one of them.

jobs.title: Fullstack Developer - Flutter, .NET & Connected Devices (SMARTLINK IoT Mobile)
jobs.description:
Job Description
**Your role**
-------------

SMARTLINK is Atlas Copco's connectivity and monitoring platform for compressed air installations: more than 300,000 connected assets, over 100,000 users worldwide, billions of data points a day. For a large share of those users the mobile app is the connected ecosystem \- commissioning equipment, troubleshooting a gateway that will not come online, acting on an alert \- so it decides how our mobile experience is perceived, often before anyone opens the portal.  



  

A growing part of the roadmap is device onboarding, and that makes this more than a business app: users in the field discover sensors and gateways, connect them over Bluetooth Low Energy, configure WiFi, provision equipment and troubleshoot when communication fails. Your work sits where mobile software, cloud services and physical hardware meet \- flows that have to hold up when connectivity is poor, the hardware is not in a known state, and the person holding the phone is a technician on a noisy plant floor rather than a power user at a desk.  



You join a product team (Product Owner, UX/UI designer, Flutter and .NET developers, test engineers) that owns the whole mobile experience from discovery to production.


You work across the whole product lifecycle rather than implementing requirements handed to you. You help understand the problem, validate the solution, build production software, and then look at whether it actually changed anything for the user.  



  

You move between product discussions, Flutter development, backend services, APIs design and implementation, analytics and troubleshooting. One day is user journeys with the Product Owner and designer; the next is a Flutter feature, an ASP.NET Core endpoint, or working out from Mixpanel why a commissioning flow is being abandoned at step three.  



  

You will be comfortable in a codebase with history and constraints, and you care as much about the problem as the solution \- what frustrates the user in the field is as interesting to you as the architecture behind it.  



**In this role, you will:**

* Build new capabilities for SMARTLINK Mobile in Flutter and Dart, and extend ASP.NET Core services and APIs behind them \- owning a capability end to end rather than one side of it.
* Take part in discovery and refinement: understand the persona and the journey, apply jobs\-to\-be\-done thinking, and challenge a requirement before it is built rather than after.

jobs.description:
Job Description
**Your role**
-------------

Connectivity is KEY! And within Atlas Copco, it has become one of the fastest\-growing strategic domains. A decade of investment has given us an industry\-leading fleet of more than 300,000 connected machines and 100,000 users, whose data powers SMARTLINK and drives our sales, service and operational processes worldwide. Behind it sits our IoT platform: the cloud\-agnostic, event\-driven backbone that ingests device telemetry, holds the model of every connected asset, and serves the portal, the mobile apps and a growing number of internal consumers. We are expanding our platform team with a senior .NET developer who builds that backbone.
  

  

You build the platform itself, not the screens in front of it. Your working level is domain models, APIs, messages and data: what a service owns, what its contract promises, which events it publishes, and how its data is shaped so that it still answers the questions we will ask of it in three years. You work in an agile team of 14 people with developers, architects, test engineers and product owner, shaping design decisions rather than only implementing them.  



The work here is engineering, not configuration. We build on . **NET 10** and C\#, with **PostgreSQL** for domain data, **Apache Kafka** for events, **Redis** for caching and **ClickHouse** for high\-volume telemetry. Services are containerised and run on Kubernetes, brought up locally with .NET Aspire and tested against real dependencies with Testcontainers, shipped through Azure DevOps pipelines and instrumented with **OpenTelemetry** .  



We are building a new back\-end, designed around domain\-driven design rather than carried over from what came before. The interesting questions are still open: where the domain boundaries lie, what each service owns, which events carry the truth. You get to answer them, on a fleet that is already global and still growing.  



In this role, you will:  



  

* Design and build domain services: bounded contexts, aggregates and a language the business recognises, in cloud\-native .NET services that own their own data.
* Own your API contracts: design APIs that others build on, version them deliberately, and treat breaking a consumer as a decision rather than an accident.
* Design events, not just messages: Avro schemas in a registry, schema evolution, idempotency and replay, and a clear answer for the message that cannot be processed.
* Model data for the questions it will be asked: relational design in PostgreSQL where the structure is known, JSONB where it has to stay flexible, and query patterns that still hold when the fleet doubles.
* Engineer for fleet scale: hundreds of thousands of devices reporting continuously, where an unbounded consumer or a missing index is not a slow page but an outage.
* Make your services observable and operable: OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs, health checks, and alerts worth being woken up for.
* Test your own work, with unit and integration tests next to the product code against containerised dependencies rather than mocks, alongside the test engineers who build our shared framework.
* Shape the design upstream and raise the bar around you: turn requirements into a workable domain model during refinement, say so when something cannot be built cleanly, and lead through review and standards people actually follow.

The total platform team is 14 people.  



Test automation here is real engineering. Our suites are written in **C\# on .NET** by the same standards as the product code: **xUnit, Testcontainers** to spin up Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis and ClickHouse per run, **.NET Aspire** to bring up the distributed application, and a shared helper library published as a NuGet package so every service team tests against the same building blocks. Suites run in **Azure DevOps** pipelines per component and per environment, reporting into **Xray** .  



Your first months land in the middle of a platform generation change, with two generations running side by side while we migrate. It is a demanding start and the fastest way to learn the platform inside out, but it is not the whole job: the migration will finish, the platform will keep growing, and so will your scope.  



In this role, you will:  



  

* Test the platform where it lives: contract, schema and integration testing of domain services and APIs, message and event flows, and the persistence behind them.
* Validate the data, not just the code: event streams, time\-series and aggregated telemetry, from the message a device sends to the value the platform serves to its consumers.
* Extend the shared test framework the other service teams build on, and keep those suites running as quality gates in CI/CD rather than by hand.
* Solve testability as a design problem. Where a service cannot be validated on its own, work out what is needed (governed test data, stubs, simulators, contract tests, observability) and get it into the backlog before the feature is built, instead of testing on production machines.
* Hold the platform to what it promises its consumers. The portal, the mobile apps and internal consumers depend on your services, so you own those contracts and work with those teams on the flows that cross the boundary.

* Generación de la documentación de los proyectos en los que se participa.

* Experiencia en el desarrollo de aplicaciones en C\# .NET y/o JAVA.

* Capacidad para ser perseverante, trabajar en equipo y tener amplia curiosidad por el aprendizaje y la formación continua.

* Contrato indefinido.
* Formato de trabajo híbrido.
* Flexibilidad horaria.
* Trabajar en una empresa referente en su sector que apuesta por la innovación de manera constante.
* Formar parte de un equipo de trabajo dinámico y altamente cualificado.

  

*Si quieres incorporarte a una corporación dinámica y en un periodo de fuerte expansión, dentro de un sector con gran potencial de desarrollo a nivel global, ¡aquí tienes tu mejor oportunidad! ¡Te esperamos!*

jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer Platform
jobs.description:
### **Descripción**


? **¿Fullstack, Platform Engineering, Cloud y Developer Experience en una misma posición?**


Desde **Q\-tech** estamos colaborando con una gran compañía tecnológica internacional para incorporar un/a **Platform Fullstack Engineer** a su hub tecnológico de **Barcelona**.


Pero ojo: no buscamos simplemente a alguien que haga frontend \+ backend.


? Buscamos un perfil con verdadera mentalidad de **Platform Engineering**.


Alguien que entienda que su "usuario" también son los propios developers y que disfrute creando herramientas, APIs, automatizaciones y soluciones **self\-service** que permitan a otros equipos trabajar con mayor autonomía y menos fricción.


? **¿Con qué trabajarás?**


? **Frontend:** React, TypeScript, Next.js y arquitecturas Micro\-Frontend
  

? **Backend:** .NET Core / C\# \+ Node.js (NestJS / Express)
  

? **APIs:** REST, resilience patterns, OAuth2 / OIDC
  

? **Containers:** Docker \+ Kubernetes
  

? **CI/CD \& GitOps:** pipelines, testing, registries y ArgoCD
  

? **Cloud:** entornos Multicloud / GCP
  

? **IaC:** Terraform
  

? **Observability:** OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, K6
  

? **Platform tooling:** Backstage, Feature Flags, developer portals y boilerplates
  

? **AI\-assisted development:** Copilot, Cursor, Gemini, agentes y nuevas formas de automatizar tareas de desarrollo


El stack es amplio, sí. **No esperamos que seas especialista en absolutamente todo.**


Nos interesa especialmente alguien **hands\-on y pragmático**, capaz de moverse entre frontend, backend e infraestructura y, sobre todo, que entienda el propósito de Platform Engineering: **hacer que otros equipos de desarrollo puedan trabajar mejor.**


Buscamos personas capaces de detectar problemas en los workflows de desarrollo, proponer soluciones, construirlas y explicar después cómo utilizarlas mediante documentación, workshops y buenas prácticas.


? **Barcelona – modelo híbrido (\~8 días/mes en oficina)**

At **Nextlane**, we don’t just develop software solutions – we **create the future** of the automotive industry.


We are a company that combines **advanced technology** with a clear vision: **simplifying and digitizing** every step of the automotive customer journey, empowering manufacturers and dealerships to thrive in a constantly evolving market.


We believe in the value of every team member, offering opportunities for you to **develop** and contribute to meaningful solutions.


So… What does it mean to be a \#Nextlaner?

* Be part of a **growth\-oriented culture**.
* Collaborate with **colleagues from all over the world.**
* Believe in **the Power of ideas** and the **diversity of thought**.

Join **Nextlane** and become part of the technological revolution in the automotive industry.


Discover why we are a great place to develop your talent!

jobs.title: Software Test Engineer
jobs.description:
At Materialise Medical, we believe that better healthcare starts with solutions designed around the individual patient. If you’re passionate about bringing personalized care to every patient, you’ll love being a part of this team. Through the technology we develop, researchers, engineers, and clinicians are revolutionizing personalized treatment — helping improve and save lives daily.  



  

**Job Title** : Software Automation Test Engineer  



  

**Job Description Summary**  

We are looking for an experienced Test Automation Engineer who will help us further develop and maintain our test automation framework.


The framework is already actively developed and has a strong technical foundation. We are looking for someone who can bring additional experience, ideas and engineering perspective to the area and work closely with the current owner to drive it further.  



  

**What we are looking for:**

* Strong experience in test automation and automation framework development
* Strong C\# / .NET skills
* Hands\-on experience with Playwright or similar modern browser automation frameworks
* Good experience with API and integration testing
* Good understanding of test architecture and different testing levels — Unit/Integration, Endpoint/API, Frontend and E2E
* Experience with Azure DevOps
* Experience with BDD and data\-driven testing
* Ability to work with complex systems, configurations, test environments and test data
* Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills
* AI\-oriented mindset — practical experience with AI\-assisted development and genuine interest in exploring how AI can improve test automation, maintenance, failure analysis and testing workflows
* Strong ownership and initiative — not only implementing requested tests, but identifying problems, proposing improvements and following them through
* Curiosity and willingness to challenge existing approaches constructively
* Comfortable with technically challenging problems and areas where the solution is not yet obvious
Good collaboration skills — able to work closely with the current framework owner, developers and other engineers  
* 

  

**Preferred Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Mathematics, IT, Physics, or related fields (IT preferred).
* At least 4 years of experience in QA, with 2\+ years in test automation.
At least 2 years of experience testing web or desktop applications.  
* 

  

**Required Skills**

*Technical Skills:*

* Programming skills in any object\-oriented language and a willingness to switch to C\#.
* Knowledge of common principles of testing and test automation framework design.
* Familiarity with Playwright or Cypress for C\# UI automation (optional).
* Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (optional).

*Soft Skills:*

* Strong problem\-solving and bug\-identification skills, with the ability to clearly articulate issues.
* Results\-oriented mindset with attention to detail.
* Clear, structured communication skills.
* Team player with system thinking and an Agile/Scrum mindset.

*Language Skills:*

English: Upper\-intermediate level or higher.  

* 

  

**What We Offer**

At our company, we are on a mission to create a better and healthier world. By rapidly expanding our medical software teams, we are driving innovation in 3D planning and 3D printing technologies to make advanced, personalized care accessible to more patients—at a more affordable price.


Joining our team means becoming part of a forward\-thinking organization that values impact, collaboration, and excellence. Here’s what we offer:  



  

* **Purpose\-Driven Work** : Be part of a team that’s transforming healthcare by empowering surgeons and improving patient outcomes with cutting\-edge 3D technologies.
* **Hybrid Work Policy** : Enjoy the flexibility of working from home up to three days a week while staying connected to your team at the office at least two days per week.
* **A Growing Environment** : Work in a dynamic, rapidly expanding team where innovation and personal growth are encouraged.
* **Collaborative Culture** : Join a supportive, diverse team of experts passionate about making a tangible difference in the medical field.
* **Professional Development** : Opportunities to grow your skills and expertise while working with the latest technologies in medical software.

Together, we’re shaping the future of personalized medicine—one patient at a time.  



  

**What’s waiting for you**

**Work that matters**  

The technology we build at Materialise pushes the boundaries. You’ll find pride in building something that matters, whether you designed it, printed it, or shipped it. No matter your role, we unlock new possibilities to build a better and healthier world every day.


At Materialise, we expect you to think about the customer, not just the task. You push for better solutions and care about the difference your work makes.  



**A people\-centered space**  

When you join Materialise, you join a group of colleagues invested in you, not just your work. From your own team to a department across the world, you’ll find a sense of belonging with people who help without being asked, challenge you, and have your back.


At the same time, we expect you to invest in the people around you — not just your own work — to make the group stronger than the sum of its parts.  



**An environment of trust**  

As a company of innovators, we know how crucial autonomy is in your work. When we hire you, we trust in your expertise, giving you space to organize your tasks, work flexibly, and make your own calls.


At Materialise, we expect you to deliver on that trust and keep your commitments.  



**A career ready to build**  

When you see opportunities for your career to grow at Materialise, we encourage you to go for them. People shape a fulfilling career at their own pace here.


At Materialise, we expect you to take initiative in your own development. Don’t wait for someone else to plan your career. Step into the space and make it count.  



  

Make a difference together with the Medical team.

jobs.title: IAM Developer
jobs.description:
Who are we?
  

  

We are South Europe Technologies (SET Iberia); the IT, Data and Operations Shared Service Center of BNP Paribas Personal Finance, with delivery centers in Spain and Portugal, providing the best solutions to BNPP PF entities around the world such as Cetelem (specialized, between others, in financial partnership of major retailers, consumer goods companies and car dealerships).
  

  

Among Other Services, Our Portfolio Is Composed Of:
  

  

* Applications Management (Architecture, Project Management, Development, and Quality Assurance).
* IT Risks \& Cybersecurity Services.
* Platforms Management.
* Data Analytics and AI.
* Operations.

  

Our offices are in Spain (Madrid) and Portugal (Lisbon, Porto). The company brings together over 200\+ employees, with expertise in various technologies (Java, .Net, Python, Tibco, APIGee) and other operational roles (Functional Analyst, Project Manager, Business Analyst, Auto Stock Financing operators). We keep growing!
  

  

Our consistent track record of services delivery means comfort for our customers and opportunities for our employees.
  

  

You will find SE.T to be full of energy and an Inclusive Workplace in which you truly can make a difference.
  

  

Would you like to join our international team that delivers end\-to\-end solutions (applications and operations activities) to businesses of BNP Paribas Personal Finance Group entities around the world?
  

  

In a context, we are looking for a Developer responsible for the development, configuration, integration and operational support of Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions within an international environment.
Main responsibilities:


* Provide **L1/L2 support** for IAM incidents, service requests, and technical issues.
* Troubleshoot authentication, authorization, MFA, token, directory, and integration issues.
* Design and configure **PingFederate** authentication and onboarding flows.
* Work with **PingOne MFA**, implementing and troubleshooting authentication methods such as **FIDO2, OTP/TOTP, Push and SMS**.
* Configure and troubleshoot **PingDirectory and PingFederate** integrations.
* HTML basic undertanding.
* Implement and support **OAuth 2\.0 / OpenID Connect**, PKCE, JWT, JWKS and token introspection/revocation.
* Manage **identity provisioning and deprovisioning** and identity data flows.
* Analyze logs, traces, and API requests/responses to identify root causes.
* Collaborate with application, security, infrastructure and vendor teams across multiple European markets.
* Create technical documentation and participate in Agile methodologies and incident/change management.

IT Tools


* PingFederate, PingOne, PingDirectory, PingDirectory Proxy.
* OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, PKCE, JWT, JWKS.
* MFA: **FIDO2, Push, OTP/TOTP, SMS.**
* Identity Lifecycle, Provisioning \& Deprovisioning.
* LDAP, REST APIs, SCIM, Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC).
* **Git/GitLab**, Docker, Ansible, Bruno.

Profile:


* Hands\-on experience in **IAM / Ping Identity** technologies.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with L1/L2 operational experience.
* Experience across development, project implementation, and production support activities.
* **Fluent professional English** and experience working with international teams.
  

  

Skills


BUSINESS


* Knowledge of banking and banking processes will be an asset.
* Business logic knowledge and IT Relations.

TRANSVERSAL SKILLS


* Experience in Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).

BEHAVIORAL SKILLS


* Ability to understand, explain, and support solution evolutions.
* Ability to meet objectives / Result orientation.
* With attention to detail/ Rigorous.
* Collaboration and teamwork.
* Problem/incident resolution.
* Client focused.
* Effective communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Proactivity.

LANGUAGES


English level B2 or higher.
  

  

Benefits:
  

* Training programs, career plans and internal mobility opportunities, national and international thanks to our presence in different countries.
* Diversity and Inclusion Committee that ensures an inclusive work environment. In recent years, several employee communities have been created to organize diversity and inclusion awareness actions (PRIDE, We Generations and MixCity).
* Corporate volunteering program (1 Million Hours 2 Help) in which employees can dedicate time out of their working hours to volunteer activities.
* Flexible compensation plan
* Hybrid telecommuting model (50%)
* 31 vacation days.

  

Diversity and Inclusion commitment
  

  

BNP Paribas Group in Spain is an equal opportunity employer and proud to provide equal employment opportunity to all job seekers. We are actively committed to ensuring that no individual is discriminated against on the grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership status, pregnancy and maternity/paternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. Equity and diversity are at the core of our recruitment policy because we believe that they foster creativity and efficiency, which in turn increase performance and productivity. We strive to reflect the society we live in, while keeping with the image of our clients.
About Our Culture
  

  

We are proud to create, maintain, and develop strategic business applications for BNP Paribas Personal Finance entities worldwide, maintaining high service levels and delivering added value to our customers. In our multicultural environment, we encourage all team members to develop their talents and skills, providing a wide variety of career opportunities and internal mobility programs within local SET teams or across other entities in the Group, both in Spain and globally.
  

  

We value the experience of our employees and work to maintain a balanced environment, offering flexibility regarding work schedules and respect for personal time. Our hybrid working model is a testament to our belief that social connection enhances our daily activities.

* **Incident Management:** Troubleshoot and resolve technical incidents related to the API Gateway and identity layers.

* **Security Protocols:** Deep understanding of **HTTPS** and **TLS** encryption for secure communication.
* **Identity \& Access Management (IAM):** Proficiency in **OAuth 2\.0** flows, including the management of **Client IDs**, **Client Secrets**, and **Token Introspection**.
* **Network Security:** Basic knowledge of **WAF (Web Application Firewall)**
* **Infrastructure:** Familiarity with **CyberArk** for privileged access management.

Profile:

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer · AI & Agentic Development
jobs.description:
Senior Full Stack Developer · AI \& Agentic Development

Buscamos un/a Senior Full Stack Developer con sólida experiencia en desarrollo web, mobile y cloud, y especial interés en la aplicación de IA y agentes al proceso de desarrollo de software.

Funciones:

Desarrollo y evolución de aplicaciones Web con React y aplicaciones mobile con React Native, junto con APIs y servicios backend. Diseño e implementación de arquitecturas cloud sobre AWS, especialmente Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, EC2 y CloudWatch, además de otros servicios habituales de AWS.

Participación en todo el ciclo de desarrollo, incluyendo arquitectura, programación, integración, testing automatizado, CI/CD, revisión y calidad del código.

Se busca experiencia o interés avanzado en AI\-assisted Development / Agentic Coding, utilizando herramientas como Claude Code, Cursor, Codex u otras equivalentes. Se valorará especialmente la capacidad para orquestar varios agentes especializados en análisis, programación, testing, revisión, documentación y refactoring, integrándolos en un proceso de desarrollo controlado y automatizado.

Perfil técnico:

Experiencia senior en React, React Native, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, APIs REST, Git y testing automatizado, así como experiencia práctica en AWS y conocimientos de arquitectura, seguridad, escalabilidad y CI/CD.

Se valorará experiencia con herramientas como Jest/Vitest, Playwright/Cypress, React Testing Library, AWS SAM/CDK/CloudFormation y sistemas de automatización y calidad de código.

Se valorará adicionalmente:

Experiencia en Unity/C\#, Unreal Engine, 3D, XR o desarrollo interactivo.

Formación:

Preferiblemente Grado en Ingeniería Informática, Ingeniería del Software o equivalente. Se valorará disponer de Máster universitario en desarrollo de software/ingeniería informática y especialmente formación de posgrado o Máster oficial en Inteligencia Artificial, así como titulaciones de experto o especializaciones acreditadas en IA aplicada al desarrollo, LLMs o sistemas multiagente.

Buscamos:

Un perfil con autonomía y capacidad de decisión técnica, orientación a la calidad, pensamiento crítico y capacidad para utilizar la IA como parte integral del proceso de ingeniería, no únicamente como herramienta de generación de código.

Sueldo: 28\.000,00€\-32\.000,00€ al año

Beneficios:

* Flexibilidad horaria
* Jornada intensiva en verano
* Jornada intensiva los viernes

Ubicación del trabajo: Empleo remoto

jobs.description:
En **Recambios Frain** buscamos incorporar una persona al equipo de IT para ayudarnos a avanzar en nuevos desarrollos, mejorar aplicaciones que ya tenemos y participar en proyectos relacionados con ERP, logística, gestión interna y comercio B2B.

No buscamos necesariamente a alguien que domine todas las tecnologías que utilizamos. Buscamos una persona con experiencia en desarrollo, resolutiva y con capacidad para entender un negocio real y convertir necesidades en soluciones.

**¿En qué trabajarás?**

* Desarrollo y mejora de aplicaciones internas y aplicaciones web.
* Integraciones entre nuestros diferentes sistemas, ERP, SGA y otras herramientas.
* Automatización y mejora de procesos.
* Trabajo con bases de datos y optimización de consultas y procesos.
* Evolución y modernización de aplicaciones existentes.
* Uso de herramientas de IA como apoyo al desarrollo, análisis, documentación y automatización.

Nos interesa especialmente experiencia en algunas de estas tecnologías o entornos:

* PHP y/o Python.
* SQL y bases de datos relacionales.

* ERP, SGA, Odoo o aplicaciones de gestión empresarial.

La idea no es desarrollar software aislado del negocio. Trabajarás directamente sobre procesos que utilizan diariamente diferentes áreas de una empresa de más de 160 personas: logística, almacén, compras, ventas, administración, e\-commerce, etc.

jobs.title: Senior Playable Ads Programmer
jobs.description:
At **Naphora Games Group**, we're building more than games, we're building a global team of ambitious, driven people who are hungry to learn, experiment, and raise the bar for the next generation of games.



We collaborate openly, move fast, and challenge ourselves every day to build better, smarter, and faster.



Our goal is to create world\-class games that players around the globe love and remember. If you thrive in a high\-performance, ownership\-driven environment and want to make a real impact, you'll fit right in with us.

**Role Summary:**



We're looking for a **Mid\-Senior Playable Programmer / Creative Technical Artist to join our growing team at Naphora Games Group** and help us create high\-performing playable ads and creative content for our mobile games.



This is a **fully remote position open to candidates from any location**, with availability to work in alignment with our Saudi Arabia working schedule (Sunday–Thursday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM KSA time).



The role combines technical development and creative production, using Unity, C\#, Luna Playable, and other relevant technologies to build, iterate, and optimize interactive playable experiences and performance\-focused video creatives.



Working closely with AI Engineering, Design, Marketing, UA, Product, Art, and Engineering, you'll be part of a fast\-paced environment where rapid experimentation, high\-volume testing, and iteration are a big part of how we work.



You'll also have the opportunity to contribute to our internal creative production and AI\-assisted tools and workflows, helping us find faster and more scalable ways to produce and test creatives.


### **Responsibilities**


**Playable Development \& Prototyping**


* Develop and maintain playable ads and gameplay prototypes using Unity, C\#, Luna Playable, and other relevant technologies
* Build responsive gameplay interactions, UI flows, animations, visual feedback, and creative effects
* Rapidly prototype and iterate on gameplay and interactive creative concepts
* Build reusable gameplay systems, modular templates, components, and scalable architectures
* Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code where applicable
* Optimize playables for performance, loading time, file size, and cross\-device/platform compatibility


**Creative Production \& Performance**


* Create and iterate on video advertising creatives, gameplay\-based videos, and performance marketing assets
* Produce a high volume of playable and video creative variations for testing
* Iterate on creatives based on testing results, analytics, and UA performance
* Experiment with different gameplay concepts, creative formats, hooks, interactions, and technical approaches
* Support debugging, testing, analytics integrations, creative validation, and quality control


**AI, Tools \& Automation**


* Collaborate with AI Engineers on AI\-generated playable, video creative, and automation workflows
* Help develop, test, validate, and improve internal tools used for playable and creative production
* Explore AI\-assisted development and creative production workflows
* Experiment with new tools, engines, technologies, and approaches that can improve the speed and scale of creative production


**Collaboration**


* Work closely with Marketing, UA, Product, Design, Art, AI, and Engineering teams
* Translate creative concepts into technically feasible and engaging playable experiences
* Collaborate on creative testing and iteration based on performance data and learnings
* Contribute ideas and technical solutions throughout the creative development process

### **Success Looks Like**


* Building polished, responsive, and technically reliable playable ads
* Producing and iterating on playable and video creatives quickly and at high volume
* Creating reusable systems and templates that make creative production faster and more scalable
* Delivering playables that meet performance, loading time, file size, and platform requirements
* Using creative performance data and testing results to continuously improve concepts and execution
* Combining strong technical implementation with creative thinking and experimentation
* Contributing to AI\-assisted tools and workflows that improve creative production
* Collaborating effectively across creative, technical, product, and UA teams
* Taking strong ownership of creative concepts from prototype through testing and iteration

### **Qualifications**


* 4\+ years of experience in Unity game development, technical art, creative development, or a related field
* Strong proficiency in Unity and C\# and/or JavaScript
* Experience building gameplay systems, prototypes, playable ads, or interactive advertising experiences
* Strong understanding of mobile optimization, performance, and technical constraints
* Ability to combine technical implementation with creative thinking and fast prototyping
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, iterative, and performance\-driven environment

### **Bonus Points For**


* Experience with Luna Playable and playable ad platforms such as AppLovin, Unity Ads, Meta, or Google
* Experience creating playable ads, hypercasual/hybrid\-casual prototypes, or video creatives for mobile game UA
* Experience with motion graphics, animation, VFX, shaders, or technical art, using tools such as After Effects, Blender, or Unity Timeline
* Experience with AI\-assisted creative production, automation tools, or workflows
* A portfolio, GitHub, playable examples, or video creatives demonstrating relevant work


If this role excites you and you're ready to help shape the future of game development at Naphora, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Senior SW Engineer for Lab Connectivity
jobs.location: Sant Cugat del Vallès, CT, ES
jobs.description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

Who We Are
  
  

At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action \- we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.
  
  

The Opportunity
  
  

You will be joining one of the Agile organisations in charge of designing, implementing, delivering and maintaining Reusable solution to simplify interoperability between diagnostics solutions (Roche and non\-Roche instrumentation, LIS, HIS, Edge Systems…) to simplify the development to reduce complexity, time to market, cost of ownership and quality of our internal customers within R Departments at Roche Diagnostics.
  
  

This position will play a critical role in the team, leveraging deep expertise in Connectivity protocols and solutions and supporting the design, development, deployment and validation of future connectivity solutions while maintaining the current base of deployments across Roche. As a Software Engineer, you will be also lead the ASDLC adoption and Ways of working in your team while preserving quality standards and good software practices. You are expected to show a good customer centric mindset.
  
  

For this you will prove experience in .NET Software Development, Instrument connectivity protocols and Interoperability in general. You can communicate effectively in English with people of different profiles, cultures and your mentoring skills shall contribute to continuous improvement and delivering excellent software efficiently.
  
  

You will be responsible
  
  

You care about your team, leading technical discussions and complex initiatives. You can influence decisions within your area of responsibility and connect naturally with business and architecture representatives to provide solutions to our customers. You are able to manage technology, business and reality to design future feasible and efficient solutions.
  
  

**Who you are:**  

* Healthcare Interoperability\& Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of healthcare and laboratory integration standards (e.g., HL7, POCT1\-A, ASTM, LIS/HIS) and connectivity solutions for diagnostics environments.
* Software Development\& Quality Practices: Proven hands\-on C\# .NET development background with strong expertise in software design patterns, object\-oriented design, TDD/BDD, unit/integration testing, and maintainable code.
* End\-to\-End Ownership\& AI Integration: Track record of full SDLC responsibility (from requirements to deployment), including integrating AI toolsets into development workflows and understanding cloud/frontend technologies.
* Technical Leadership\& Architecture: Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, mentor developers, design robust components, and guide architecture/AI strategy alongside product managers and stakeholders.
* Education, Communication\& Soft Skills: Degree in CS or related field (Bachelor's \+ 6 years or Master's \+ 4 years), with strong problem\-solving skills, independence, and fluent communication in English and Spanish for agile, cross\-functional collaboration.


Locations
  
  

You will be based in Sant Cugat, Spain.
  
  

Leadership Skills
  
You are also responsible for building, and then providing effective leadership for your team. Doing so in a manner that is consistent with the Roche Values and leadership capabilities. You will seek to inspire and lead your team to create transformative solutions, and to influence their prioritization and uptake in the wider organization, in order to ensure that customer solutions are at the forefront of the market and deliver its optimal contribution to the Roche Diagnostics Vision.
  
  

Both Diagnostics and Diabetes Care Leadership teams usethese skills when referring to leadership. Consider bringing them into the job description.
  
  

The Expert SW Engineer in Mobile is expected to demonstrate the Roche Operating Principles and contribute to the Roche Group. The Roche Operating Principles are:
  
  

* Put patients first
* Follow the science
* Act as one team
* Embrace differences
* Accelerate learning
* Simplify radically
* Make impact now
* Think long term


Wer wir sind
  
  

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  

Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

* Education, Communication\& Soft Skills: Degree in CS or related field (Bachelor's \+ 6 years or Master's \+ 4 years), with strong problem\-solving skills, independence, and fluent communication in English and Spanish for agile, cross\-functional collaboration.


Locations
  
You will be based in Sant Cugat, Spain.
  
  

Leadership Skills
  
You are also responsible for building, and then providing effective leadership for your team. Doing so in a manner that is consistent with the Roche Values and leadership capabilities. You will seek to inspire and lead your team to create transformative solutions, and to influence their prioritization and uptake in the wider organization, in order to ensure that customer solutions are at the forefront of the market and deliver its optimal contribution to the Roche Diagnostics Vision.
  
  

Both Diagnostics and Diabetes Care Leadership teams usethese skills when referring to leadership. Consider bringing them into the job description.
  
  

The Expert SW Engineer in Mobile is expected to demonstrate the Roche Operating Principles and contribute to the Roche Group. The Roche Operating Principles are:
  
  

* Put patients first
* Follow the science
* Act as one team
* Embrace differences
* Accelerate learning
* Simplify radically
* Make impact now
* Think long term


Wer wir sind
  
  

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  

Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.
