jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
LanguageWire is a global leader in language and content services, dedicated to helping brands achieve their full global potential. Since our founding in 2000, we have continuously evolved and developed unique technology to facilitate seamless multilingual communication. Our worldwide network of language experts, coupled with an intuitive online platform, makes it effortless for brands to translate and manage multilingual content.

**The role you'll play**


We're launching a new team dedicated to modernizing and expanding one of our customer\-facing tools — and we're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to help build it from the ground up. This isn't a legacy product handoff: you'll be joining at the very start, shaping both the technical direction and the team culture from day one.


The current stack is Vue.js on the frontend and Python on the backend, but we're planning a migration to .NET in the near future. Because of this, we're looking for someone comfortable working across all three — Vue, Python, and .NET — who can help drive that transition while continuing to ship new features. As the senior engineer, you'll take a leading role in architecture decisions, technical direction, and mentoring as the team grows.

**The team you'll be a part of**


You'll be one of the founding members of a brand\-new team, led by our Tech Team Lead. We're actively growing the team and expect to bring on a Product Manager and one additional Engineer alongside you. This means you'll have real influence over how the team is structured, how we work, and the technical foundations we build on — it's a rare chance to help define a team's culture and practices from the very beginning, rather than stepping into something already set.

**If you want to make a difference, make it with us by...**

* Developing and maintaining applications, including front\-end interfaces, back\-end services, and databases
* Contributing to the architecture, design and implementation of new features and improvements
* Implementing best practices for code quality, testing and deployment automation
* Ensuring high\-quality software through active participation in code reviews
* Actively engaging in sprint retrospectives, refinements, daily stand\-ups, and other team processes
* Taking full ownership of the products and solutions you develop, eliminating bugs early in the process through TDD/BDD and other tests
* Leveraging AI\-assisted development tools and workflows to increase engineering velocity, while maintaining code quality and rigor
* Sharing knowledge and supporting fellow developers, QA professionals, and support teams
* Supporting team leaders with your expertise and assist in customer meetings
* Owning CI/CD pipelines to ensure seamless operations

**In one year, you'll know you were successful if...**

* You are fully integrated as part of the team and have built strong working relationships.
* You actively contribute to maintaining a positive, collaborative, and knowledge\-sharing team atmosphere.
* You take full ownership of products and solutions, having delivered several major features to production with measurable impact.
* You share your expertise by mentoring mid\-level and junior developers, helping them grow and succeed.
* You contribute to improving team processes, code quality, and technical decision\-making.

**Desired Experience And Competencies**

**What does it take to work for LanguageWire?**

**What you'll need to bring**

* Motivational and engaging with a "can do" attitude, fostering a positive team environment.
* Strong problem\-solving and communication skills.
* Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and best practices.
* Extensive experience with C\# and the .NET ecosystem (.NET Core/.NET 6\+, ASP.NET Web API, etc.)
* Experience with Python
* Solid understanding of RESTful API design and integration
* Familiarity with asynchronous programming and performance optimization in .NET
* Responsible for front\-end codebases using Vue.js and/or TypeScript, collaborating closely with full\-stack and frontend developers
* Sound understanding of frontend build tools and state management (Vuex, Pinia, or similar).
* Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD practices
* Experience with automated testing frameworks (unit, integration, and end\-to\-end).
* Comfortable working in agile development environments and participating in sprint planning, code reviews, and peer mentoring
* Ability to collaborate effectively in cross\-functional teams, including product, design, and QA.
* DevOps experience: CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm, etc.), Docker, Kubernetes, cloud services (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

**This will make you stand out**

* Knowledge of microservices architecture and event\-driven systems
* Proficiency with relational databases, particularly MSSQL and/or PostgreSQL
* Hands\-on experience with Entity Framework (EF Core) and LINQ
* Familiarity with message brokers (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus)
* Strong focus on testing practices (unit testing, integration testing, test automation)
* Awareness of security best practices in software development
* Ability to mentor others and foster knowledge\-sharing within the team

**Our perks**

* Enjoy flat hierarchies, responsibility and freedom, direct feedback, and room to stand up for your own ideas
* Internal development opportunities, ongoing support from your People Partner, and an inclusive and fun company culture
* International company with over 300 employees. Offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus, Stockholm, Varberg, London, Leuven, Lille, Paris, Munich, Hamburg, Kiev, Gdansk, Atlanta, Finland and Valencia
* We take care of our people and initiate many social get\-togethers from Friday Bars a to Summer or Christmas parties. We have fun!
* 150 great colleagues in the Valencia office belonging to different business departments
* Excellent location in cool and modern offices in the city center, with a great rooftop terrace and a view over the Town Hall Square
* Private health insurance
* We have a hybrid work model called FlexiWire. We offer weekly flexibility, working three days in the office and two days from home. Together with your team, you can coordinate which days to collaborate in the office.
* Working in an international environment—more than 20 different nationalities
* A dog friendly atmosphere
* Big kitchen with access to organic fruits, nuts and biscuits and coffee.
* Social area and game room (foosball table, darts, and board games)
* Bike and car parking

  



**About LanguageWire**
At LanguageWire, we want to wire the world together with language. Why? Because we want to help people \& businesses simplify communication. We are fueled by the most advanced technology (AI) and our goal is to make customer's lives easier by simplifying their communication with any audience across the globe.  



**Our values drive our behavior**

**We are curious. We are trustworthy. We are caring. We are ambitious.**

At LanguageWire, we are curious and intrigued by what we don’t understand. We believe relationships are based on honesty and responsibility, and being trustworthy reinforces an open, humble, and honest way of communicating. We care and respect each other personally and professionally. We encourage authentic collaboration, invite feedback, and a positive social environment. Our desire to learn, build, and share knowledge is a natural part of our corporate culture.

  



**Working at LanguageWire — why we like it:**


"Once the purpose \& values project had been rolled out, I felt a stronger connection and more engaged. Within our team, we care for each other, help each other on tasks, projects and we value different opinions. We truly lift each other up to be our best and ambitiously strive towards constantly improving on a professional and personal level."


(Arpi, Application Support Team Lead, Valencia)

  



**Yes, to diversity, equity \& inclusion**

In LanguageWire, we believe diversity in gender, age, background, and culture is essential for our growth. Therefore, we are committed to creating a culture that incorporates diverse perspectives and expertise in our everyday work.


LanguageWire’s recruitment process is designed to be transparent and fair for all candidates. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply, and we ensure that candidates are provided with an equal opportunity to demonstrate their competencies and skills.

  



Want to know more?


We can’t wait to meet you! So, why wait 'til tomorrow? Apply today!


If you want to know more about LanguageWire, we encourage you to visit our *website!*

jobs.title: Senior Java Developer (IR-551)
jobs.description:
Intellectsoft is a software development company delivering innovative solutions since 2007\. We operate across North America, Latin America, the Nordic region, the UK, and Europe.We specialize in industries like Fintech, Healthcare, EdTech, Construction, Hospitality, and more, partnering with startups, mid\-sized businesses, and Fortune 500 companies to drive innovation and scalability. Our clients include Jaguar Motors, Universal Pictures, Harley\-Davidson, and many more where our teams are making daily impactTogether, our team delivers solutions that make a difference. Learn more at www.intellectsoft.net/


We are developing a modern ERP platform designed to digitize end\-to\-end communication and operational workflows across the dental healthcare sector. The solution connects clinical practices with specialized service providers, streamlining order tracking, custom product fulfillment, and secure digital asset exchange.


As a Senior Java Developer, you will lead backend engineering efforts to build scalable, high\-availability services that manage dynamic workflow states, business\-critical integrations, and high\-volume transaction data.

 **Requirements**  

* 5\+ Years of Experience: Solid background in core backend software development using Java (11/17\+).
* Spring Ecosystem Expertise: In\-depth knowledge of Spring Boot 3, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, and Spring Web.
* Relational Databases: Strong relational data modeling and SQL performance tuning skills (PostgreSQL or MySQL).
* API Design \& Security: Proven ability to build RESTful APIs, manage OAuth2/JWT authentication, and design clean interface contracts.
* Architectural Foundations: Experience with microservices, domain\-driven design concepts, and transactional state management.
* Testing \& CI/CD: Proficiency with automated testing frameworks (JUnit, Mockito) and containerization tools (Docker, CI/CD pipelines).

**Nice\-to\-have:**

* Healthcare / MedTech Exposure: General familiarity with health\-tech software requirements, data privacy standards, or digital medical record workflows.
* Asynchronous Messaging: Experience with event streaming platforms like Kafka or RabbitMQ for asynchronous processing.
* Cloud \& Large File Management: Familiarity with AWS/GCP.
* Caching \& Search: Hands\-on experience with Redis, Elasticsearch, or distributed caching systems.
* Monitoring \& Observability: Exposure to Prometheus, Grafana, or central logging tools (ELK stack) for microservice monitoring.

**Responsibilities:**

* Backend Architecture: Architect, implement, and maintain scalable architecture and RESTful APIs using Java and Spring.
* Workflow Engine Design: Engineer reliable backend services to manage multi\-step business logic, status lifecycles, and event\-driven notifications.
* Integration \& Security: Design secure interfaces to connect internal modules with external systems, ensuring strict adherence to healthcare data privacy principles.
* Performance \& Data Storage: Optimize relational database schemas and query performance.
* Code Quality \& Leadership: Enforce software engineering best practices through code reviews, automated testing (unit/integration), and technical mentoring.

  

**Benefits**  

* Awesome projects with an impact
* Udemy courses of your choice
* Team\-buildings, events, marathons \& charity activities to connect and recharge
* Workshops, trainings, expert knowledge\-sharing that keep you growing
* Clear career path
* Absence days for work\-life balance
* Flexible hours \& work setup \- work from anywhere and organize your day your way

5\+ years of experience as a .NET Developer.

As a Full Stack Developer, you will design and maintain responsive web applications to support operational security solutions. You will work within our Production Security service to ensure the efficient control of network, server, and endpoint infrastructures.

* Design and develop responsive web applications using HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks.

jobs.title: Mid/Senior .NET Backend Engineer [working in Portugal's time zone]
jobs.description:
We are one of the fastest\-growing technology and innovation groups in Latin America, and since 2021, we’ve been operating in Portugal.


We are currently collaborating with a leading global e\-commerce group, present in Asia, Europe and in the Americas. In this context, we are looking for someone with energy, a sense of responsibility, and motivation to take on the role of Mid/Senior .NET Backend Engineer , in one of the strategic initiatives we are leading with this client.


We work across various domains, including Unified Commerce, Application Development, AI (of course), and Cybersecurity, with over 1,700 professionals distributed across 12 companies in Brazil, Portugal, and the United Kingdom – through projects, managed services, squads, and staff augmentation.


Portugal serves as our service hub for the Northern Hemisphere. From here, our team supports clients in Portugal, the European Union, the United Kingdom, and the United States.


In Europe, in addition to the FCamara brand as a technology service provider, we are also the main investor and shareholder of Beta\-i, a leading name in the field of open and collaborative innovation.


At FCamara, members of our consulting and service teams – proudly known as Orange Blood – find a space to grow and develop their skills. We work on challenging initiatives with real impact, creating the conditions for a true professional leap.


Whether joining with prior experience or through our Orange Juice programme, we are proud that many of our talents have gone on to become entrepreneurs or have progressed into leadership roles such as CTOs, IT Directors, Innovation Leads, or other senior positions in companies around the world.


"Those who join FCamara usually leave much better than when they arrived." – said by former Orange Bloods, not by us.

  

  

**Responsabilidades e atribuições**  

As a Backend Engineer, you will join our Porto Team to develop internal products that power our business areas. You will pair with Product Managers and other Engineers to define, plan, execute, and foster a culture of technical excellence.  

  

WHAT YOU’LL DO

* Help the team define, plan, and execute complex features. Help the team through the full lifecycle, from initial design to production monitoring, ensuring high availability and performance.
* Pair with the Product Manager and other Engineers on discovery and prioritisation. You don't just execute tasks, you translate high\-level business requirements into scalable technical specifications.
* Design and implement sophisticated event\-driven architectures and distributed systems.
* Create and maintain high\-quality architectural diagrams and system documentation, ensuring the "technical source of truth" is always accurate and accessible.
* Act as the subject matter expert in .NET (C\#), PostgreSQL/SQL Server, REST APIs

  

  

  

**Requisitos e qualificações**  

* You have 4\+ years of experience building, deploying, and scaling distributed systems and high\-traffic web applications.
* You possess deep proficiency in .NET (C\#) and a mastery of Object\-Oriented Programming and Domain\-Driven Design (DDD).
* You are proficient in relational databases, with experience in optimizing complex queries and managing large\-scale data sets.
* You have hands\-on experience architecting background processing (Hangfire) and event\-driven systems using message brokers (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, or Kafka).
* You view automated testing as a baseline and have experience designing CI/CD pipelines that ensure high\-quality, frequent deployments.
* You thrive in a global, asynchronous environment. Your English and Portuguese fluency and communication skills allow you to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across time zones.


* Demonstrated ability to translate complex business requirements into high\-performance technical specifications.

  

  

  

**Informações adicionais**  

* This is a remote position aligned with the time zone for Portugal, in a 9h to 18h working schedule. If local to Porto, Portugal, you might be invited to sporadic visits to the client's office.
* This position is part of a long\-term project.
* Languages: In this role, work with both the FCamara team and the client will be conducted in English and Portuguese. As these will be your working languages, it is a requirement that you are professionally proficient in these languages.
* Contract Model: We offer flexibility in the contract model. Our recruitment team will provide all details regarding contract type, remuneration, and benefits, tailored to your location and professional situation.
* Nationality, Residency and Visa: We welcome professionals of any nationality, provided they are fluent in the required language and hold the necessary documentation for hiring in Portugal or Brazil. This position does not include any VISA sponsorship or arrangements by FCamara.

Estamos há 17 anos no mercado, lado a lado com nossos clientes, proporcionando experiências transformadoras.


Somos um ecossistema de tecnologia e inovação, com expansão global; Além do Brasil estamos presentes na Europa e Reino Unido com escritórios em Portugal, Londres, Dubai e Holanda.

nossa escola de liderança e diversas parcerias com ONGs e Edtechs.

jobs.title: Senior Playable Ads Programmer
jobs.description:
At **Naphora Games Group**, we're building more than games, we're building a global team of ambitious, driven people who are hungry to learn, experiment, and raise the bar for the next generation of games.



We collaborate openly, move fast, and challenge ourselves every day to build better, smarter, and faster.



Our goal is to create world\-class games that players around the globe love and remember. If you thrive in a high\-performance, ownership\-driven environment and want to make a real impact, you'll fit right in with us.

**Role Summary:**



We're looking for a **Mid\-Senior Playable Programmer / Creative Technical Artist to join our growing team at Naphora Games Group** and help us create high\-performing playable ads and creative content for our mobile games.



This is a **fully remote position open to candidates from any location**, with availability to work in alignment with our Saudi Arabia working schedule (Sunday–Thursday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM KSA time).



The role combines technical development and creative production, using Unity, C\#, Luna Playable, and other relevant technologies to build, iterate, and optimize interactive playable experiences and performance\-focused video creatives.



Working closely with AI Engineering, Design, Marketing, UA, Product, Art, and Engineering, you'll be part of a fast\-paced environment where rapid experimentation, high\-volume testing, and iteration are a big part of how we work.



You'll also have the opportunity to contribute to our internal creative production and AI\-assisted tools and workflows, helping us find faster and more scalable ways to produce and test creatives.


### **Responsibilities**


**Playable Development \& Prototyping**


* Develop and maintain playable ads and gameplay prototypes using Unity, C\#, Luna Playable, and other relevant technologies
* Build responsive gameplay interactions, UI flows, animations, visual feedback, and creative effects
* Rapidly prototype and iterate on gameplay and interactive creative concepts
* Build reusable gameplay systems, modular templates, components, and scalable architectures
* Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code where applicable
* Optimize playables for performance, loading time, file size, and cross\-device/platform compatibility


**Creative Production \& Performance**


* Create and iterate on video advertising creatives, gameplay\-based videos, and performance marketing assets
* Produce a high volume of playable and video creative variations for testing
* Iterate on creatives based on testing results, analytics, and UA performance
* Experiment with different gameplay concepts, creative formats, hooks, interactions, and technical approaches
* Support debugging, testing, analytics integrations, creative validation, and quality control


**AI, Tools \& Automation**


* Collaborate with AI Engineers on AI\-generated playable, video creative, and automation workflows
* Help develop, test, validate, and improve internal tools used for playable and creative production
* Explore AI\-assisted development and creative production workflows
* Experiment with new tools, engines, technologies, and approaches that can improve the speed and scale of creative production


**Collaboration**


* Work closely with Marketing, UA, Product, Design, Art, AI, and Engineering teams
* Translate creative concepts into technically feasible and engaging playable experiences
* Collaborate on creative testing and iteration based on performance data and learnings
* Contribute ideas and technical solutions throughout the creative development process

### **Success Looks Like**


* Building polished, responsive, and technically reliable playable ads
* Producing and iterating on playable and video creatives quickly and at high volume
* Creating reusable systems and templates that make creative production faster and more scalable
* Delivering playables that meet performance, loading time, file size, and platform requirements
* Using creative performance data and testing results to continuously improve concepts and execution
* Combining strong technical implementation with creative thinking and experimentation
* Contributing to AI\-assisted tools and workflows that improve creative production
* Collaborating effectively across creative, technical, product, and UA teams
* Taking strong ownership of creative concepts from prototype through testing and iteration

### **Qualifications**


* 4\+ years of experience in Unity game development, technical art, creative development, or a related field
* Strong proficiency in Unity and C\# and/or JavaScript
* Experience building gameplay systems, prototypes, playable ads, or interactive advertising experiences
* Strong understanding of mobile optimization, performance, and technical constraints
* Ability to combine technical implementation with creative thinking and fast prototyping
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, iterative, and performance\-driven environment

### **Bonus Points For**


* Experience with Luna Playable and playable ad platforms such as AppLovin, Unity Ads, Meta, or Google
* Experience creating playable ads, hypercasual/hybrid\-casual prototypes, or video creatives for mobile game UA
* Experience with motion graphics, animation, VFX, shaders, or technical art, using tools such as After Effects, Blender, or Unity Timeline
* Experience with AI\-assisted creative production, automation tools, or workflows
* A portfolio, GitHub, playable examples, or video creatives demonstrating relevant work


If this role excites you and you're ready to help shape the future of game development at Naphora, we encourage you to apply.

D365 Developer
jobs.description:
**Job Type:**


Permanent**Build a brilliant future with Hiscox**

  

Role Overview

  

Hiscox is expanding its use of Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform to enhance business agility and operational efficiency across global units.

  

This role sits within the Group Platform Engineering team and is pivotal in delivering scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions using low/no code approaches, with a focus on Dynamics 365 and/or Power Apps Model Driven solutions.

  

You will work closely with solution architects, in\-house teams, third party partners, and business stakeholders to help design, configure, deliver, and support robust solutions aligned to architectural principles, policies, and guidelines.  



  

About You

  

You are a pragmatic and delivery\-focused specialist who can translate business needs into well\-structured solutions, communicating confidently with both technical and non technical stakeholders.


You’re motivated to stay current with emerging capabilities, trends, best practices, and security considerations that can improve the roadmap and team outcomes.

  

You enjoy collaborating with others, contributing to shared standards, and supporting capability uplift across teams and “community of practice” activities.  



  

You are ready to act as a “go to” engineer for a functional area or product slice—without formal line management—supporting juniors through collaboration and coaching.

  

Key Responsibilities

  

1\) Solution Delivery (D365 / Model Driven Focus)

* Design, develop, and deploy solutions using Power Platform, including work that supports Dynamics 365 and/or Power Apps (Model Driven) delivery.
* Translate business requirements into technical specifications and deliverables, ensuring solutions are pragmatic and maximise technology benefits.
* Collaborate with the Technical Lead and solution architects to ensure solutions align with architectural principles, policies, guidelines, and the Microsoft upgrade roadmap.
* Ensure alignment with design standards, reusable components, DevOps pipelines, and lifecycle management practices.
* Collaborate with internal teams and Microsoft partners to ensure high\-quality implementations.

  

2\) Requirements \& Stakeholder Collaboration

* Work with business and technology stakeholders to elicit and refine requirements, shaping them into clear solution outcomes.
* Communicate effectively across technical and non technical audiences to drive shared understanding and delivery progress.

  

3\) Platform \& Lifecycle Practices (ALM / Environments / Operability)

* Contribute to application lifecycle management practices, with familiarity across waterfall and agile delivery approaches.
* Support ongoing improvement of platform usage and performance, helping ensure optimal configuration and scalability.
* Provide ongoing support and further development for deployed solutions.

  

4\) Data Model, Non Functional Requirements \& Quality

* Ensure extensions to Dataverse and the Common Data Model are introduced consistently with industry best practice.
* Ensure non functional requirements are identified and addressed, including secure configuration, access controls, appropriate environment sizing, monitoring metrics, and an effective support model.

  

5\) Security, Compliance \& Governance

* Implement and maintain governance policies such as Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and access controls, supporting compliance and security standards.
* Participate in regular reviews with partners and internal teams to ensure compliance and security standards are met.
* Support the development and enforcement of governance models, standards, and policies, contributing to continuous improvement and maturity.

  

6\) Team Enablement \& Knowledge Sharing

* Promote best practices and continuous improvement through knowledge sharing and mentoring in day to day work.
* Support community enablement efforts (e.g., contributing to how to guides, design standards, training content) where appropriate.


Essential Skills \& Experience

* Demonstrated experience defining, designing, developing, testing, and deploying D365 and Power Platform applications and solutions (functional specialist or developer background).
* Strong knowledge of Dynamics 365 CE and/or Power Platform, with understanding of appropriate use cases (e.g., Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio).
* Understanding of Azure cloud technology and the Azure security model.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with technical and non technical stakeholders.
* Self motivated with evidence of staying current on technologies, trends, best practices, and security considerations.
* Collaborative mindset, including experience working with others and contributing to team skill development.

Desirable Skills

* Microsoft certifications at intermediate/advanced level (e.g., Power Platform Functional Specialist Associate, App Maker Associate, Solution Architect Expert).
* Experience extending Power Platform using C\#, JavaScript, etc.

  

Why Hiscox?

* Healthy work\-life balance with our 35h/week and hybrid working system.
* Holidays: 25 days \+ 2 Hiscox Days (Extra two Annual Leave).
* Health insurance, gym allowance, pension plan etc.
* After 5 years work 1\-month sabbatical leave.
* Team spirit with many opportunities to engage and an open culture.

 *Work with amazing people and be part of a unique culture*

1\. Job Purpose

The Senior .NET Developer will be responsible for the design, development, testing, implementation, maintenance, and continuous enhancement of software applications and related systems throughout the two\-year contract period.

The position will support the successful implementation and ongoing development of project requirements by developing reliable, scalable, secure, and maintainable software solutions using Microsoft .NET technologies.

2\. Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software applications using .NET technologies.
* Develop and maintain applications using **C\#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET Core**, and related Microsoft technologies.
* Develop and maintain web applications, RESTful APIs, backend services, and supporting components.
* Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into effective software solutions.
* Design and implement scalable and maintainable application architectures.
* Integrate applications with databases, third\-party systems, APIs, and other enterprise platforms.
* Work with relational databases and develop efficient database queries, stored procedures, and data\-access components.
* Perform unit testing, integration testing, debugging, and troubleshooting of applications.
* Identify and resolve application defects, performance issues, and technical problems.
* Participate in code reviews and maintain coding standards and development best practices.
* Develop secure applications while following appropriate authentication, authorization, data protection, and application security practices.
* Maintain technical documentation, system documentation, source code, and deployment documentation.
* Support application deployment, configuration, upgrades, and production releases.
* Monitor application performance and implement improvements where required.
* Maintain and enhance existing applications based on project requirements and user feedback.
* Collaborate with project managers, business users, system administrators, database administrators, and other technical team members.
* Participate in system integration activities and troubleshoot integration\-related issues.
* Support continuous improvement and modernization of existing software systems.
* Ensure software development activities are completed within agreed timelines and quality standards.
* Provide technical support during implementation, testing, deployment, and post\-deployment activities.
* Perform any other software development and technical duties relevant to the project.

3\. Mandatory Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field**.
* Minimum **2 years of senior\-level experience in .NET development**.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **C\# and .NET / .NET Core**.
* Practical experience with **ASP.NET Core** and web application development.
* Experience in developing and consuming **RESTful APIs and web services**.
* Experience working with relational databases and SQL.
* Experience with software development lifecycle processes, including development, testing, deployment, maintenance, and enhancement.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Good understanding of software development principles, object\-oriented programming, and application architecture.

4\. Preferred Technical Skills

* ASP.NET Core MVC / Web API
* C\#
* .NET / .NET Core
* Entity Framework Core
* REST APIs
* SQL Server or equivalent relational databases
* Git / source control systems
* Unit and integration testing
* Authentication and authorization
* API integration
* CI/CD and deployment practices
* Cloud\-based application deployment
* Application performance optimization
* Secure software development practices

5\. Required Competencies

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to independently analyze technical requirements and develop appropriate solutions.
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a project\-based environment.
* Good communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple development tasks and meet project deadlines.
* Attention to software quality, security, performance, and maintainability.
* Ability to work collaboratively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

6\. Key Deliverables

The Senior .NET Developer will be expected to contribute to:

Als technisch architect speel je een sleutelrol in het vormgeven van de technische koers van het Douanelandschap. In deze context ontwikkel je architectuurvisies en richtinggevende scenario’s voor toekomstbestendige technische oplossingen binnen de kaders van de enterprise architectuur. new_jobs.title: Senior Controls Engineer - Sustaining
new_jobs.description:
Job Description
**Your role**
-------------

As a Senior Controls Engineer \- Sustaining, reporting to a the Controls Engineering Manager, To employ best practice in the writing of control and visualization software for products developed by the Clevedon PC. The engineer is actively engaged in the improvement of software development processes and techniques.  



You will  



* Take responsibility for the preparation of software specifications
* Works safely following agreed test procedures and risk assessments
* Contributes to the preparation of test documents and advises on appropriate test methodologies
* Plans own short\-term actions and reports on progress
* Contributes software plans in the overall project planning process, prioritizes own work. Monitors progress and anticipates obstacles and delays
* Contributes to the development and continual improvement of controls engineering processes
* Investigates quality issues
* Creates supporting documentation for software release and installation
* Provides technical content for manuals, build notes and service instructions. Reviews content produced by others
Supports colleagues by sharing own knowledge  
* 
**To succeed, you will need**
-----------------------------

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. We value diverse experiences and perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the role.  



* HND (or equivalent) or degree in a relevant technical discipline, preferably in a controls or software discipline *(Essential)*
* Minimum of 5 years working in controls and software within relevant industries *(Essential)*
* HMI programming using VB.net or other high level languages *(Essential)*
* Compiling software *(Essential)*
* Communications protocols – Modbus, EdCentra XML *(Essential)*
* Creation of technical documentation *(Essential)*
* Administration of software configuration control tools, version numbering, release process and archiving *(Essential)*
* Safety and design review methods, e.g. HAZOP, FMEA *(Essential)*
* Industry standards – e.g. SEMI S2, S8 *(Desirable)*
**In return, we offer**
-----------------------

* Culture of trust and accountability
* Lifelong learning and career growth
* Innovation powered by people
* Comprehensive compensation and benefits
* Health and well\-being
**Job location**
----------------

  

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on\-site at our office in Bristol, United Kingdom (GB).  

  

  



Apply now
**Uniting curious minds**
-------------------------

Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we are uniting curious minds, and you could be one of them.


Information at a Glance
Edwards is a leader in the vacuum and abatement markets. The brand’s products are essential for industries such as semiconductor, power generation, chemical and food processing. Edwards believes in working with customers to set new standards and creating environments where innovation thrives. This trailblazer prides itself on making a difference in areas that are intrinsic to people’s everyday lives – from the medical care they receive to the coffee they drink. Wherever there is vacuum, Edwards can also be found, leading the way. Edwards is a brand within Atlas Copco Group.

**Your role**
-------------

As a Controls Engineer, your mission is to to write control and visualisation software for products developed by the Clevedon PC in accordance with the functional software specification. To follow the software development procedures, including the creation of design and test documentation.. You will report to the Lead Controls Engineer.  



You will  



* Understand and use software requirement specifications prepared by others.
* Review specifications created by others and provide feedback where necessary.
* Works safely following agreed test procedures and risk assessments.
* Contributes to the preparation of test documents

* Contributes software plans in the overall project planning process.

-----------------------------

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. We value diverse experiences and perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the role.  



* HND (or equivalent) or degree in a relevant technical discipline, preferably in a controls or software discipline (Essential)

new_jobs.title: DevOps Engineer, Engineering Excellence
new_jobs.description:
**Make excellent engineering the easy path, for every squad at If CTP**


If is the biggest insurance company in the Nordics: thousands of skilled colleagues keeping everyday life running for millions of customers, their homes, cars, businesses and more. Behind that promise stands modern engineering, and behind our engineers stands Engineering Excellence: a DevOps\-oriented enablement team whose product is the capability of every other squad. We are now looking for a DevOps Engineer who wants to build shared platforms, coach fellow engineers, and shape safe, human\-approved agentic AI ways of working.

  

**About the role**

This is not a feature\-delivery seat, it is a multiplier role. Instead of shipping one product, you make many squads better at shipping theirs, and your definition of done includes adoption: work is finished when another team can use, own and support it.

  

Day to day, you will:


* Build and evolve our shared engineering backbone: reusable CI/CD pipelines and pipeline libraries, repository practices, platform tooling, integrations and automation on Azure and Azure DevOps.
* Establish and enable engineering standards, guardrails, and branching and naming conventions that make the right way the easy way.
* Strengthen quality and security: validation and testing enablement, software scanning, secure\-engineering practice, reliability, and actionable engineering feedback.
* Untangle material cross\-squad blockers in builds, environments, delivery and platform, making dependencies visible and handing over responsibly.
* Coach engineers and squads, support onboarding, and turn hard\-won knowledge into documentation people actually use.
* Use engineering metrics, discovery and evidence to guide continuous improvement, without overstating what the data proves.
  

You will also be hands\-on in our agentic engineering journey. We are building an AI\-assisted operating model for the team that starts deliberately read\-only and follows a strict loop: agents observe and propose, humans approve, and only then are changes applied. You will help design these proposal\-controlled workflows, the guardrails and least\-privilege access behind them, and the evidence that shows what AI adoption genuinely improves.

  

You will work across every squad rather than inside one, side by side with architects, squad technical leads, Product Management and program stakeholders. It is a rare vantage point that grows your platform depth and your influence at the same time. The team runs on Kanban flow rather than sprints: demand is clarified, work is made ready, delivered, validated, documented and handed over, with blockers made visible instead of hidden.

  

**We offer**


In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:

  

* Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
* Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
* An including work environment where everyone is welcome
* Possibility of hybrid workplace
* Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
Great insurance benefits  
* 

  

**About the team**


Engineering Excellence is six engineers with one shared conviction: great enablement means the job is not done until someone else can use, own and support the outcome. We prefer evidence over assumptions, we make dependencies and risks visible instead of hiding them, and we keep egos low and trust high, coaching each other the same way we coach the squads.

  

Human accountability sits at the core of how we adopt AI: our agents may observe and propose, but people approve, and decision rights always stay with the roles that own them. If’s whole business is keeping promises when it matters most, and we hold our engineering to the same standard, reliable, secure, and easy to build on. We also live If’s customer\-centric, “undifficult” mindset internally: our customers are If’s own squads, and our job is to make their best work feel effortless. You will join an international workplace that is genuinely committed to diversity, and a team where your questions on day one are as welcome as your improvements on day one hundred.

  

**Who are you?**


You are an enabler at heart, you get real energy from making other engineers faster, safer and more confident. You communicate clearly and coach as naturally as you commit code. You are curious and evidence\-driven: you would rather measure than assume, and you separate facts from interpretation. When dependencies tangle and priorities shift, you stay calm, make the situation visible, and keep the flow moving. You treat documentation and handover as part of the craft rather than an afterthought. And whenever automation or AI touches real systems, you exercise sound judgement about access, privacy, least privilege and human approval.

  

**You also have:**


* Practical experience in DevOps, platform engineering, developer productivity or engineering enablement
* Hands\-on skills in CI/CD, Git, repository management, automation and pipeline engineering
* Experience with Azure and/or Azure DevOps
* A track record of improving quality, testing, security scanning, reliability or engineering standards
* Comfort working in a flow\-based / Kanban way, with dependencies, blockers and explicit handover
  

**It’s a plus if you also bring:**


* Development experience in .NET, Java, Kotlin or TypeScript, or full\-stack curiosity
* Experience with agentic or AI\-assisted development, and with measuring its adoption responsibly
* Work with DORA or other engineering metrics, discovery or maturity assessments
* Experience building pipeline libraries, reusable templates or repository governance at scale

**Additional facts and the recruitment process**
------------------------------------------------

**Application deadline:** Screening and interviewing will start immediately. However, application deadline is 14th of October.


**To apply for the position:** Please attach your CV.


**Work location:** Bergshamra


**Start:** By agreement

  

For more information, please contact Burhan Öcüt, DevOps Architect, burhan.ocut@if.se

  

Background checks may be conducted as part of the recruitment process in accordance with applicable legislation and internal policies.

  

**We look forward to your application!**

new_jobs.description:
Roles \& Responsibilities
  
  

ABOUT KRISTAL.AI
  
  

Kristal.AI is a digital private bank and wealth\-tech company built for modern investing. We serve accredited investors and high\-net\-worth families across more than 50 countries, and we are regulated by the Monetary Authority of Singapore, the Securities and Futures Commission in Hong Kong, SEBI in India, and the FSRA in Abu Dhabi.
  
  

Our AI product team builds the systems our relationship managers and operations teams use every day: portfolio optimisation engines, document parsing pipelines, and AI agents that answer client and internal questions from our own knowledge base. We are a small team shipping to real users inside a regulated business.
  
  

THE ROLE
  
  

We are hiring an AI Engineer to build and ship production AI applications for our wealth management platform. You will work on large language model applications, retrieval systems, and AI agents that are used by our relationship managers, operations teams, and clients.
  
  

This is a hands\-on building role. You will own features end to end, from scoping the problem with the business team through to running the system in production. You will report to the AI Product Lead and work alongside our data scientists and engineers.
  
  

WHAT YOU WILL DO
  
  

* Build and ship production applications powered by large language models, including retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems over our internal documents, policies, and client communications.
* Design and build AI agent workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain, including tool calling, multi\-step orchestration, and memory.
* Build evaluation harnesses and test sets for AI features, and use them to measure quality before and after every change. We treat evaluation as a first\-class part of the work, not an afterthought.
* Write backend services and APIs in Python to support AI workloads, and integrate with our internal platforms and third\-party systems.
* Work directly with operations and relationship management teams to scope problems, agree what “good” looks like, and deliver solutions that remove real manual effort.
* Monitor accuracy, latency, and cost in production, and improve them over time.
* Apply our controls for data privacy, auditability, and regulatory compliance to every AI feature you build.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
  
  

* A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.
* At least 1 year of hands\-on experience building software or AI applications. This can include internships, contract work, or substantial project work.
* Strong Python. You can write code that other people can read, test, and run in production.
* Practical experience building applications with large language models. You understand prompting, retrieval, embeddings, and where these systems fail.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
* The ability to take an unclear problem, break it down, and come back with a working result. Much of our work starts as a rough business need, not a written spec.
* Clear written and spoken English. You will work directly with non\-technical colleagues.
* A genuine interest in finance, investing, or wealth management. You do not need prior finance experience, but you should want to learn the domain.


GOOD TO HAVE

Job Description
**Your role**
-------------

We are looking for a passionate and committed Senior Backend .NET Developer.  



You will be part of our internal software development team working in the Aftermarket domain. This surrounds applications for providing technical support, processing warranty, tools for our Field Service Engineer, our back office (planning and order processing), spare part list applications and Serialized Information Management.  



As such you will be responsible for technical application ownership and developments. Next to this you will be involved in the full redesign of our existing applications and creation of new applications as business needs arise in our Customer Centers.  



You will have the opportunity to work with a highly motivated international business and software developer team in a challenging and very dynamic environment.  



You build the back\-end behind our operational applications, not the screens in front of it. Your initial focus is the system that links as\-built documentation, bills of material and product definitions to serialized equipment and the installed base which is used by internal teams, by Customer Centers and by dealers, with a growing number of applications depending on its APIs. From there you work across the rest of our backend landscape: warranty automation and order evaluation, engineering change bulletins, maintenance engines and the shared services the whole portfolio runs on.  



Your working level is domain models, APIs, events and data: what a service owns, what its contract promises, which events it publishes, and how its data is shaped so that it still answers the questions we will ask of it in three years. You work in an agile team with developers, architects and a product owner, shaping design decisions rather than only implementing them.  



The work here is engineering, not configuration. We build on C\# and .NET (8 or later) on Azure: Function Apps and App Services for compute, Kafka and Azure Service Bus for the event streams that feed us, and a deliberately mixed data layer SQL for the queryable subset, a graph store for the relationships between equipment, components and product definitions. Services run behind private endpoints with managed identity and RBAC, ship through Azure DevOps pipelines with infrastructure as code, and are instrumented with Application Insights.


**To succeed, you will need**
-----------------------------

You have built back\-end systems that other teams and other applications depend on, ideally in an operational or business\-critical context where downtime is measured in stopped work rather than a slow page. You think in trade\-offs rather than absolutes, and you keep digging until you know why something failed, not just that it did. You work comfortably in an agile team, have the confidence to say in refinement that something cannot be built the way it is specified, and use AI tooling with the judgement to verify what it produces. This is a senior role: we expect you to own a domain end to end and make decisions the rest of the team builds on.  



You will not have every item on the list below. Cover most of the must\-haves and be genuinely curious about the rest.  



**Must\-have**

* **C\# / .NET (8 or later, moving to .NET 10\):** recent, hands\-on experience building production\-grade applications, not prototypes, at a level where you own a service end to end.
* **Azure:** practical experience with several of: Function Apps, App Services, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Blob Storage, Azure SQL, Key Vault, API Management, Application Insights.
* **REST API design and implementation:** designing and consuming well\-structured, versioned APIs, and thinking about the contract before the code.
* **SQL databases:** data modelling, query performance, and integrating relational data into cloud applications.
* **Testing as part of development:** unit and integration testing as a habit, not a separate phase handed to someone else.
* **Experience migrating .NET Framework systems to modern .NET and retiring what they replaced.**

**Strong plus**

* **Apache Kafka:** consuming event streams from systems you do not control, and living with what they send you.
* **Graph databases:** Neo4j or equivalent, and the modelling instinct for when a relationship belongs in a graph rather than a join table.
* **Secure\-by\-default cloud development:** managed identity, private endpoints, RBAC and secret management as normal practice.
* **Observability:** structured logging, tracing, alerting, and being on the hook for a system you built.
* **Domain\-driven design:** bounded contexts and aggregates applied to a real domain rather than a textbook one.
* **Microservice architecture:** service boundaries, inter\-service contracts, and the operational cost of getting them wrong.
* **Event\-driven and message\-based architecture:** queues, topics, event streams, and the practical problems that come with them: ordering, idempotency, at\-least\-once delivery, replay, poison messages.

**Your role**
-------------

SMARTLINK is Atlas Copco's connectivity and monitoring platform for compressed air installations: more than 300,000 connected assets, over 100,000 users worldwide, billions of data points a day. For a large share of those users the mobile app is the connected ecosystem \- commissioning equipment, troubleshooting a gateway that will not come online, acting on an alert \- so it decides how our mobile experience is perceived, often before anyone opens the portal.  



  

A growing part of the roadmap is device onboarding, and that makes this more than a business app: users in the field discover sensors and gateways, connect them over Bluetooth Low Energy, configure WiFi, provision equipment and troubleshoot when communication fails. Your work sits where mobile software, cloud services and physical hardware meet \- flows that have to hold up when connectivity is poor, the hardware is not in a known state, and the person holding the phone is a technician on a noisy plant floor rather than a power user at a desk.  



You join a product team (Product Owner, UX/UI designer, Flutter and .NET developers, test engineers) that owns the whole mobile experience from discovery to production.


You work across the whole product lifecycle rather than implementing requirements handed to you. You help understand the problem, validate the solution, build production software, and then look at whether it actually changed anything for the user.
